text_en: All wisdom is from the Lord God , and has been always with him, and is before all time.
text_la: Omnis sapientia a Domino Deo est : et cum illo fuit semper, et est ante ævum.
text_pt: Palavra do SENHOR, que foi dirigida a Oséias, filho de Beeri, nos dias de Uzias, Jotão, Acaz, Ezequias, reis de Judá, e nos dias de Jeroboão, filho de Joás, rei de Israel.
text_el: πᾶσα σοφία παρὰ κυρίου καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐστιν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Who has numbered the sand of the sea, and the drops of rain, and the days of the world? Who has measured the height of heaven , and the breadth of the earth, and the depth of the abyss ?
text_la: Arenam maris, et pluviæ guttas, et dies sæculi, quis dinumeravit? altitudinem cæli, et latitudinem terræ, et profundum abyssi, quis dimensus est?
text_pt: O princípio da palavra do Senhor por meio de Oséias. Disse, pois, o Senhor a Oséias: Vai, toma uma mulher de prostituições, e filhos de prostituição; porque a terra certamente se prostitui, desviando-se do Senhor.
text_el: ἄμμον θαλασσῶν καὶ σταγόνας ὑετοῦ καὶ ἡμέρας αἰῶνος τίς ἐξαριθμήσει

text_en: Who has searched out the wisdom of God that goes before all things?
text_la: sapientiam Dei præcedentem omnia, quis investigavit?
text_pt: Foi, pois, e tomou a Gômer, filha de Diblaim, e ela concebeu, e lhe deu um filho.
text_el: ὕψος οὐρανοῦ καὶ πλάτος γῆς καὶ ἄβυσσον καὶ σοφίαν τίς ἐξιχνιάσει

text_en: Wisdom has been created before all things, and the understanding of prudence from everlasting.
text_la: Prior omnium creata est sapientia, et intellectus prudentiæ ab ævo.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o Senhor: Põe-lhe o nome de Jizreel; porque daqui a pouco visitarei o sangue de Jizreel sobre a casa de Jeú, e farei cessar o reino da casa de Israel.
text_el: προτέρα πάντων ἔκτισται σοφία καὶ σύνεσις φρονήσεως ἐξ αἰῶνος

text_en: The word of God on high is the fountain of wisdom, and her ways are everlasting commandments.
text_la: Fons sapientiæ verbum Dei in excelsis, et ingressus illius mandata æterna.
text_pt: E naquele dia quebrarei o arco de Israel no vale de Jizreel.

text_en: To whom has the root of wisdom been revealed, and who has known her wise counsels?
text_la: Radix sapientiæ cui revelata est? et astutias illius quis agnovit?
text_pt: E tornou ela a conceber, e deu à luz uma filha. E Deus disse: Põe-lhe o nome de Lo-Ruama; porque eu não tornarei mais a compadecer-me da casa de Israel, mas tudo lhe tirarei.
text_el: ῥίζα σοφίας τίνι ἀπεκαλύφθη καὶ τὰ πανουργεύματα αὐτῆς τίς ἔγνω

text_en: To whom has the discipline of wisdom been revealed and made manifest? And who has understood the multiplicity of her steps?
text_la: disciplina sapientiæ cui revelata est et manifestata? et multiplicationem ingressus illius quis intellexit?
text_pt: Mas da casa de Judá me compadecerei, e os salvarei pelo Senhor seu Deus, pois não os salvarei pelo arco, nem pela espada, nem pela guerra, nem pelos cavalos, nem pelos cavaleiros.

text_en: There is one most high Creator Almighty , and a powerful king, and greatly to be feared, who sits upon his throne, and is the God of dominion.
text_la: Unus est altissimus, Creator omnipotens, et rex potens et metuendus nimis, sedens super thronum illius, et dominans Deus.
text_pt: E, depois de haver desmamado a Lo-Ruama, concebeu e deu à luz um filho.
text_el: εἷς ἐστιν σοφός φοβερὸς σφόδρα καθήμενος ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ

text_en: He created her in the Holy Ghost , and saw her, and numbered her, and measured her.
text_la: Ipse creavit illam in Spiritu Sancto, et vidit, et dinumeravit, et mensus est :
text_pt: E Deus disse: Põe-lhe o nome de Lo-Ami; porque vós não sois meu povo, nem eu serei vosso Deus.
text_el: κύριος αὐτὸς ἔκτισεν αὐτὴν καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐξηρίθμησεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐξέχεεν αὐτὴν ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he poured her out upon all his works, and upon all flesh according to his gift, and has given her to them that love him.
text_la: et effudit illam super omnia opera sua, et super omnem carnem, secundum datum suum, et præbuit illam diligentibus se.
text_pt: Todavia o número dos filhos de Israel será como a areia do mar, que não pode medir-se nem contar-se; e acontecerá que no lugar onde se lhes dizia: Vós não sois meu povo, se lhes dirá: Vós sois filhos do Deus vivo.
text_el: μετὰ πάσης σαρκὸς κατὰ τὴν δόσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐχορήγησεν αὐτὴν τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν

text_en: The fear of the Lord is honour , and glory , and gladness , and a crown of joy .
text_la: Timor Domini gloria, et gloriatio, et lætitia, et corona exsultationis.
text_pt: E os filhos de Judá e os filhos de Israel juntos se congregarão, e constituirão sobre si uma só cabeça, e subirão da terra; porque grande será o dia de Jizreel.
text_el: φόβος κυρίου δόξα καὶ καύχημα καὶ εὐφροσύνη καὶ στέφανος ἀγαλλιάματος

text_en: The fear of the Lord shall delight the heart, and shall give joy , and gladness , and length of days.
text_la: Timor Domini delectabit cor, et dabit lætitiam, et gaudium, et longitudinem dierum.
text_el: φόβος κυρίου τέρψει καρδίαν καὶ δώσει εὐφροσύνην καὶ χαρὰν καὶ μακροημέρευσιν

text_en: With him that fears the Lord , it shall go well in the latter end, and in the day of his death he shall be blessed .
text_la: Timenti Dominum bene erit in extremis, et in die defunctionis suæ benedicetur.
text_el: τῷ φοβουμένῳ τὸν κύριον εὖ ἔσται ἐπ' ἐσχάτων καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τελευτῆς αὐτοῦ εὐλογηθήσεται

text_en: The love of God is honourable wisdom.
text_la: Dilectio Dei honorabilis sapientia :

text_en: And they to whom she shall show herself love her by the sight, and by the knowledge of her great works.
text_la: quibus autem apparuerit in visu diligunt eam in visione, et in agnitione magnalium suorum.

text_en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and was created with the faithful in the womb, it walks with chosen women , and is known with the just and faithful.
text_la: Initium sapientiæ timor Domini : et cum fidelibus in vulva concreatus est : cum electis feminis graditur, et cum justis et fidelibus agnoscitur.
text_el: ἀρχὴ σοφίας φοβεῖσθαι τὸν κύριον καὶ μετὰ πιστῶν ἐν μήτρᾳ συνεκτίσθη αὐτοῖς

text_en: The fear of the Lord is the religiousness of knowledge .
text_la: Timor Domini scientiæ religiositas :
text_el: μετὰ ἀνθρώπων θεμέλιον αἰῶνος ἐνόσσευσεν καὶ μετὰ τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτῶν ἐμπιστευθήσεται

text_en: Religiousness shall keep and justify the heart, it shall give joy and gladness .
text_la: religiositas custodiet et justificabit cor; jucunditatem atque gaudium dabit.

text_en: It shall go well with him that fears the Lord , and in the days of his end he shall be blessed .
text_la: Timenti Dominum bene erit, et in diebus consummationis illius benedicetur.

text_en: To fear God is the fullness of wisdom, and fullness is from the fruits thereof.
text_la: Plenitudo sapientiæ est timere Deum, et plenitudo a fructibus illius.
text_el: πλησμονὴ σοφίας φοβεῖσθαι τὸν κύριον καὶ μεθύσκει αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν αὐτῆς

text_en: She shall fill all her house with her increase, and the storehouses with her treasures.
text_la: Omnem domum illius implebit a generationibus, et receptacula a thesauris illius.
text_el: πάντα τὸν οἶκον αὐτῶν ἐμπλήσει ἐπιθυμημάτων καὶ τὰ ἀποδοχεῖα ἀπὸ τῶν γενημάτων αὐτῆς

text_en: The fear of the Lord is a crown of wisdom, filling up peace and the fruit of salvation :
text_la: Corona sapientiæ timor Domini, replens pacem et salutis fructum :
text_el: στέφανος σοφίας φόβος κυρίου ἀναθάλλων εἰρήνην καὶ ὑγίειαν ἰάσεως

text_en: And it has seen, and numbered her: but both are the gifts of God .
text_la: et vidit, et dinumeravit eam : utraque autem sunt dona Dei.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐξηρίθμησεν αὐτήν

text_en: Wisdom shall distribute knowledge , and understanding of prudence : and exalts the glory of them that hold her.
text_la: Scientiam et intellectum prudentiæ sapientia compartietur, et gloriam tenentium se exaltat.
text_el: ἐπιστήμην καὶ γνῶσιν συνέσεως ἐξώμβρησεν καὶ δόξαν κρατούντων αὐτῆς ἀνύψωσεν

text_en: The root of wisdom is to fear the Lord : and the branches thereof are long-lived.
text_la: Radix sapientiæ est timere Dominum, et rami illius longævi.
text_el: ῥίζα σοφίας φοβεῖσθαι τὸν κύριον καὶ οἱ κλάδοι αὐτῆς μακροημέρευσις

text_en: In the treasures of wisdom is understanding, and religiousness of knowledge : but to sinners wisdom is an abomination.
text_la: In thesauris sapientiæ intellectus et scientiæ religiositas : execratio autem peccatoribus sapientia.

text_en: The fear of the Lord drives out sin :
text_la: Timor Domini expellit peccatum :

text_en: For he that is without fear, cannot be justified: for the wrath of his high spirits is his ruin.
text_la: nam qui sine timore est non poterit justificari : iracundia enim animositatis illius subversio illius est.
text_el: οὐ δυνήσεται θυμὸς ἄδικος δικαιωθῆναι ἡ γὰρ ῥοπὴ τοῦ θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ πτῶσις αὐτῷ

text_en: A patient man shall bear for a time, and afterwards joy shall be restored to him.
text_la: Usque in tempus sustinebit patiens, et postea redditio jucunditatis.
text_el: ἕως καιροῦ ἀνθέξεται μακρόθυμος καὶ ὕστερον αὐτῷ ἀναδώσει εὐφροσύνη

text_en: A good understanding will hide his words for a time, and the lips of many shall declare his wisdom.
text_la: Bonus sensus usque in tempus abscondet verba illius, et labia multorum enarrabunt sensum illius.
text_el: ἕως καιροῦ κρύψει τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ καὶ χείλη πολλῶν ἐκδιηγήσεται σύνεσιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: In the treasures of wisdom is the signification of discipline:
text_la: In thesauris sapientiæ significatio disciplinæ :
text_el: ἐν θησαυροῖς σοφίας παραβολαὶ ἐπιστήμης

text_en: But the worship of God is an abomination to a sinner.
text_la: execratio autem peccatori cultura Dei.
text_el: βδέλυγμα δὲ ἁμαρτωλῷ θεοσέβεια

text_en: Son, if you desire wisdom, keep justice , and God will give her to you.
text_la: Fili, concupiscens sapientiam, conserva justitiam, et Deus præbebit illam tibi.
text_el: ἐπιθυμήσας σοφίαν διατήρησον ἐντολάς καὶ κύριος χορηγήσει σοι αὐτήν

text_en: For the fear of the Lord is wisdom and discipline: and that which is agreeable to him,
text_la: Sapientia enim et disciplina timor Domini : et quod beneplacitum est illi,
text_el: σοφία γὰρ καὶ παιδεία φόβος κυρίου καὶ ἡ εὐδοκία αὐτοῦ

text_en: is faith , and meekness: and he will fill up his treasures.
text_la: fides et mansuetudo, et adimplebit thesauros illius.
text_el: πίστις καὶ πραότης

text_en: Be not incredulous to the fear of the Lord : and come not to him with a double heart.
text_la: Ne sis incredibilis timori Domini, et ne accesseris ad illum duplici corde.
text_el: μὴ ἀπειθήσῃς φόβῳ κυρίου καὶ μὴ προσέλθῃς αὐτῷ ἐν καρδίᾳ δισσῇ

text_en: Be not a hypocrite in the sight of men , and let not your lips be a stumbling-block to you.
text_la: Ne fueris hypocrita in conspectu hominum, et non scandalizeris in labiis tuis.
text_el: μὴ ὑποκριθῇς ἐν στόμασιν ἀνθρώπων καὶ ἐν τοῖς χείλεσίν σου πρόσεχε

text_en: Watch over them, lest you fall, and bring dishonour upon your soul ,
text_la: Attende in illis, ne forte cadas, et adducas animæ tuæ inhonorationem :
text_el: μὴ ἐξύψου σεαυτόν ἵνα μὴ πέσῃς καὶ ἐπαγάγῃς τῇ ψυχῇ σου ἀτιμίαν

text_en: and God discover your secrets, and cast you down in the midst of the congregation.
text_la: et revelet Deus absconsa tua, et in medio synagogæ elidat te :
text_el: καὶ ἀποκαλύψει κύριος τὰ κρυπτά σου καὶ ἐν μέσῳ συναγωγῆς καταβαλεῖ σε

text_en: Because you came to the Lord wickedly , and your heart is full of guile and deceit .
text_la: quoniam accessisti maligne ad Dominum, et cor tuum plenum est dolo et fallacia.
text_el: ὅτι οὐ προσῆλθες φόβῳ κυρίου καὶ ἡ καρδία σου πλήρης δόλου

text_en: Son, when you come to the service of God , stand in justice and in fear, and prepare your soul for temptation .
text_la: Fili, accedens ad servitutem Dei sta in justitia et timore, et præpara animam tuam ad tentationem.
text_pt: Dizei a vossos irmãos: Ami; e a vossas irmãs: Ruama.
text_el: τέκνον εἰ προσέρχῃ δουλεύειν κυρίῳ ἑτοίμασον τὴν ψυχήν σου εἰς πειρασμόν

text_en: Humble your heart, and endure: incline your ear, and receive the words of understanding: and make not haste in the time of clouds.
text_la: Deprime cor tuum, et sustine : inclina aurem tuam, et suscipe verba intellectus : et ne festines in tempore obductionis.
text_pt: Contendei com vossa mãe, contendei, porque ela não é minha mulher, e eu não sou seu marido; e desvie ela as suas prostituições da sua vista e os seus adultérios de entre os seus seios.
text_el: εὔθυνον τὴν καρδίαν σου καὶ καρτέρησον καὶ μὴ σπεύσῃς ἐν καιρῷ ἐπαγωγῆς

text_en: Wait on God with patience: join yourself to God , and endure, that your life may be increased in the latter end.
text_la: Sustine sustentationes Dei : conjungere Deo, et sustine, ut crescat in novissimo vita tua.
text_pt: Para que eu não a despoje, ficando ela nua, e a ponha como no dia em que nasceu, e a faça como um deserto, e a torne como uma terra seca, e a mate à sede;
text_el: κολλήθητι αὐτῷ καὶ μὴ ἀποστῇς ἵνα αὐξηθῇς ἐπ' ἐσχάτων σου

text_en: Take all that shall be brought upon you: and in your sorrow endure, and in your humiliation keep patience.
text_la: Omne quod tibi applicitum fuerit accipe : et in dolore sustine, et in humilitate tua patientiam habe :
text_pt: E não me compadeça de seus filhos, porque são filhos de prostituições.
text_el: πᾶν ὃ ἐὰν ἐπαχθῇ σοι δέξαι καὶ ἐν ἀλλάγμασιν ταπεινώσεώς σου μακροθύμησον

text_en: For gold and silver are tried in the fire, but acceptable men in the furnace of humiliation.
text_la: quoniam in igne probatur aurum et argentum, homines vero receptibiles in camino humiliationis.
text_pt: Porque sua mãe se prostituiu; aquela que os concebeu houve-se torpemente, porque diz: Irei atrás de meus amantes, que me dão o meu pão e a minha água, a minha lã e o meu linho, o meu óleo e as minhas bebidas.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν πυρὶ δοκιμάζεται χρυσὸς καὶ ἄνθρωποι δεκτοὶ ἐν καμίνῳ ταπεινώσεως

text_en: Believe God , and he will recover you: and direct your way, and trust in him. Keep his fear, and grow old therein.
text_la: Crede Deo, et recuperabit te : et dirige viam tuam, et spera in illum : serva timorem illius, et in illo veterasce.
text_pt: Portanto, eis que cercarei o teu caminho com espinhos; e levantarei um muro de sebe, para que ela não ache as suas veredas.
text_el: πίστευσον αὐτῷ καὶ ἀντιλήμψεταί σου εὔθυνον τὰς ὁδούς σου καὶ ἔλπισον ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: You that fear the Lord , wait for his mercy: and go not aside from him lest you fall.
text_la: Metuentes Dominum, sustinete misericordiam ejus : et non deflectatis ab illo, ne cadatis.
text_pt: Ela irá atrás de seus amantes, mas não os alcançará; e buscá-los-á, mas não os achará; então dirá: Ir-me-ei, e tornar-me-ei a meu primeiro marido, porque melhor me ia então do que agora.
text_el: οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον ἀναμείνατε τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ ἐκκλίνητε ἵνα μὴ πέσητε

text_en: You that fear the Lord , believe him: and your reward shall not be made void.
text_la: Qui timetis Dominum, credite illi, et non evacuabitur merces vestra.
text_pt: Ela, pois, não reconhece que eu lhe dei o grão, e o mosto, e o azeite, e que lhe multipliquei a prata e o ouro, que eles usaram para Baal.
text_el: οἱ φοβούμενοι κύριον πιστεύσατε αὐτῷ καὶ οὐ μὴ πταίσῃ ὁ μισθὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: You that fear the Lord hope in him, and mercy shall come to you for your delight.
text_la: Qui timetis Dominum, sperate in illum, et in oblectationem veniet vobis misericordia.
text_pt: Portanto tornarei a tirar o meu grão a seu tempo e o meu mosto no seu tempo determinado; e arrebatarei a minha lã e o meu linho, com que cobriam a sua nudez.
text_el: οἱ φοβούμενοι κύριον ἐλπίσατε εἰς ἀγαθὰ καὶ εἰς εὐφροσύνην αἰῶνος καὶ ἔλεος

text_en: You that fear the Lord , love him, and your hearts shall be enlightened.
text_la: Qui timetis Dominum, diligite illum, et illuminabuntur corda vestra.
text_pt: E agora descobrirei a sua vileza diante dos olhos dos seus amantes, e ninguém a livrará da minha mão.

text_en: My children behold the generations of men : and know that no one has hoped in the Lord , and has been confounded.
text_la: Respicite, filii, nationes hominum : et scitote quia nullus speravit in Domino et confusus est.
text_pt: E farei cessar todo o seu gozo, as suas festas, as suas luas novas, e os seus sábados, e todas as suas festividades.
text_el: ἐμβλέψατε εἰς ἀρχαίας γενεὰς καὶ ἴδετε τίς ἐνεπίστευσεν κυρίῳ καὶ κατῃσχύνθη ἢ τίς ἐνέμεινεν τῷ φόβῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγκατελείφθη

text_en: For who has continued in his commandment, and has been forsaken? Or who has called upon him, and he despised him?
text_la: Quis enim permansit in mandatis ejus, et derelictus est? aut quis invocavit eum, et despexit illum?
text_pt: E devastarei a sua vide e a sua figueira, de que ela diz: É esta a minha paga que me deram os meus amantes; eu, pois, farei delas um bosque, e as feras do campo as devorarão.
text_el: ἢ τίς ἐπεκαλέσατο αὐτόν καὶ ὑπερεῖδεν αὐτόν

text_en: For God is compassionate and merciful, and will forgive sins in the day of tribulation: and he is a protector to all that seek him in truth .
text_la: Quoniam pius et misericors est Deus, et remittet in die tribulationis peccata, et protector est omnibus exquirentibus se in veritate.
text_pt: Castigá-la-ei pelos dias dos Baalins, nos quais lhes queimou incenso, e se adornou dos seus pendentes e das suas jóias, e andou atrás de seus amantes, mas de mim se esqueceu, diz o SENHOR.
text_el: διότι οἰκτίρμων καὶ ἐλεήμων ὁ κύριος καὶ ἀφίησιν ἁμαρτίας καὶ σῴζει ἐν καιρῷ θλίψεως

text_en: Woe to them that are of a double heart and to wicked lips, and to the hands that do evil , and to the sinner that goes on the earth two ways.
text_la: Væ duplici corde, et labiis scelestis, et manibus malefacientibus, et peccatori terram ingredienti duabus viis!
text_pt: Portanto, eis que eu a atrairei, e a levarei para o deserto, e lhe falarei ao coração.
text_el: οὐαὶ καρδίαις δειλαῖς καὶ χερσὶν παρειμέναις καὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ ἐπιβαίνοντι ἐπὶ δύο τρίβους

text_en: Woe to them that are fainthearted, who believe not God : and therefore they shall not be protected by him.
text_la: Væ dissolutis corde, qui non credunt Deo, et ideo non protegentur ab eo!
text_pt: E lhe darei as suas vinhas dali, e o vale de Acor, por porta de esperança; e ali cantará, como nos dias de sua mocidade, e como no dia em que subiu da terra do Egito.
text_el: οὐαὶ καρδίᾳ παρειμένῃ ὅτι οὐ πιστεύει διὰ τοῦτο οὐ σκεπασθήσεται

text_en: Woe to them that have lost patience, and that have forsaken the right ways, and have gone aside into crooked ways.
text_la: Væ his qui perdiderunt sustinentiam, et qui dereliquerunt vias rectas, et diverterunt in vias pravas!
text_pt: E naquele dia, diz o SENHOR, tu me chamarás: Meu marido; e não mais me chamarás: Meu senhor.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς ἀπολωλεκόσιν τὴν ὑπομονήν

text_en: And what will they do, when the Lord shall begin to examine?
text_la: Et quid facient cum inspicere cœperit Dominus?
text_pt: E da sua boca tirarei os nomes dos Baalins, e não mais se lembrará desses nomes.
text_el: καὶ τί ποιήσετε ὅταν ἐπισκέπτηται ὁ κύριος

text_en: They that fear the Lord , will not be incredulous to his word: and they that love him, will keep his way.
text_la: Qui timent Dominum non erunt incredibiles verbo illius : et qui diligunt illum conservabunt viam illius.
text_pt: E naquele dia farei por eles aliança com as feras do campo, e com as aves do céu, e com os répteis da terra; e da terra quebrarei o arco, e a espada, e a guerra, e os farei deitar em segurança.
text_el: οἱ φοβούμενοι κύριον οὐκ ἀπειθήσουσιν ῥημάτων αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀγαπῶντες αὐτὸν συντηρήσουσιν τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: They that fear the Lord , will seek after the things that are well pleasing to him: and they that love him, shall be filled with his law.
text_la: Qui timent Dominum inquirent quæ beneplacita sunt ei, et qui diligunt eum replebuntur lege ipsius.
text_pt: E desposar-te-ei comigo para sempre; desposar-te-ei comigo em justiça, e em juízo, e em benignidade, e em misericórdias.
text_el: οἱ φοβούμενοι κύριον ζητήσουσιν εὐδοκίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀγαπῶντες αὐτὸν ἐμπλησθήσονται τοῦ νόμου

text_en: They that fear the Lord , will prepare their hearts, and in his sight will sanctify their souls ,
text_la: Qui timent Dominum præparabunt corda sua, et in conspectu illius sanctificabunt animas suas.
text_pt: E desposar-te-ei comigo em fidelidade, e conhecerás ao Senhor.
text_el: οἱ φοβούμενοι κύριον ἑτοιμάσουσιν καρδίας αὐτῶν καὶ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ταπεινώσουσιν τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: they that fear the Lord , keep his commandments, and will have patience even until his visitation,
text_la: Qui timent Dominum custodiunt mandata illius, et patientiam habebunt usque ad inspectionem illius,
text_pt: E acontecerá naquele dia que eu atenderei, diz o Senhor; eu atenderei aos céus, e estes atenderão à terra.

text_en: saying: If we do not penance , we shall fall into the hands of the Lord , and not into the hands of men .
text_la: dicentes : Si pœnitentiam non egerimus, incidemus in manus Domini, et non in manus hominum.
text_pt: E a terra atenderá ao trigo, e ao mosto, e ao azeite, e estes atenderão a Jizreel.
text_el: ἐμπεσούμεθα εἰς χεῖρας κυρίου καὶ οὐκ εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων

text_en: For according to his greatness, so also is his mercy with him.
text_la: Secundum enim magnitudinem ipsius, sic et misericordia illius cum ipso est.
text_pt: E semeá-la-ei para mim na terra, e compadecer-me-ei dela que não obteve misericórdia; e eu direi àquele que não era meu povo: Tu és meu povo; e ele dirá: Tu és meu Deus!
text_el: ὡς γὰρ ἡ μεγαλωσύνη αὐτοῦ οὕτως καὶ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: The sons of wisdom are the church of the just : and their generation , obedience and love .
text_la: Filii sapientiæ ecclesia justorum, et natio illorum obedientia et dilectio.
text_pt: E o SENHOR me disse: Vai outra vez, ama uma mulher, amada de seu amigo, contudo adúltera, como o SENHOR ama os filhos de Israel, embora eles olhem para outros deuses, e amem os bolos de uvas.

text_en: Children, hear the judgment of your father, and so do that you may be saved.
text_la: Judicium patris audite, filii, et sic facite, ut salvi sitis.
text_pt: E comprei-a para mim por quinze peças de prata, e um ômer, e meio ômer de cevada;
text_el: ἐμοῦ τοῦ πατρὸς ἀκούσατε τέκνα καὶ οὕτως ποιήσατε ἵνα σωθῆτε

text_en: For God has made the father honourable to the children: and seeking the judgment of the mothers, has confirmed it upon the children.
text_la: Deus enim honoravit patrem in filiis : et judicium matris exquirens, firmavit in filios.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Tu ficarás comigo muitos dias; não te prostituirás, nem serás de outro homem; assim também eu esperarei por ti.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ κύριος ἐδόξασεν πατέρα ἐπὶ τέκνοις καὶ κρίσιν μητρὸς ἐστερέωσεν ἐφ' υἱοῖς

text_en: He that loves God , shall obtain pardon for his sins by prayer , and shall refrain himself from them, and shall be heard in the prayer of days.
text_la: Qui diligit Deum exorabit pro peccatis, et continebit se ab illis, et in oratione dierum exaudietur.
text_pt: Porque os filhos de Israel ficarão por muitos dias sem rei, e sem príncipe, e sem sacrifício, e sem estátua, e sem éfode ou terafim.
text_el: ὁ τιμῶν πατέρα ἐξιλάσκεται ἁμαρτίας

text_en: And he that honours his mother is as one that lays up a treasure.
text_la: Et sicut qui thesaurizat, ita et qui honorificat matrem suam.
text_pt: Depois tornarão os filhos de Israel, e buscarão ao Senhor seu Deus, e a Davi, seu rei; e temerão ao Senhor, e à sua bondade, no fim dos dias.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ὁ ἀποθησαυρίζων ὁ δοξάζων μητέρα αὐτοῦ

text_en: He that honours his father shall have joy in his own children, and in the day of his prayer he shall be heard.
text_la: Qui honorat patrem suum jucundabitur in filiis, et in die orationis suæ exaudietur.
text_el: ὁ τιμῶν πατέρα εὐφρανθήσεται ὑπὸ τέκνων καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ προσευχῆς αὐτοῦ εἰσακουσθήσεται

text_en: He that honours his father shall enjoy a long life: and he that obeys the father, shall be a comfort to his mother.
text_la: Qui honorat patrem suum vita vivet longiore, et qui obedit patri refrigerabit matrem.
text_el: ὁ δοξάζων πατέρα μακροημερεύσει καὶ ὁ εἰσακούων κυρίου ἀναπαύσει μητέρα αὐτοῦ

text_en: He that fears the Lord , honours his parents , and will serve them as his masters that brought him into the world.
text_la: Qui timet Dominum honorat parentes, et quasi dominis serviet his qui se genuerunt.
text_el: καὶ ὡς δεσπόταις δουλεύσει ἐν τοῖς γεννήσασιν αὐτόν

text_en: Honour your father, in work and word, and all patience,
text_la: In opere, et sermone, et omni patientia, honora patrem tuum,
text_el: ἐν ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου

text_en: that a blessing may come upon you from him, and his blessing may remain in the latter end.
text_la: ut superveniat tibi benedictio ab eo, et benedictio illius in novissimo maneat.
text_el: ἵνα ἐπέλθῃ σοι εὐλογία παρ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: The father's blessing establishes the houses of the children: but the mother's curse roots up the foundation.
text_la: Benedictio patris firmat domos filiorum : maledictio autem matris eradicat fundamenta.
text_el: εὐλογία γὰρ πατρὸς στηρίζει οἴκους τέκνων κατάρα δὲ μητρὸς ἐκριζοῖ θεμέλια

text_en: Glory not in the dishonour of your father: for his shame is no glory to you.
text_la: Ne glorieris in contumelia patris tui : non enim est tibi gloria ejus confusio.
text_el: μὴ δοξάζου ἐν ἀτιμίᾳ πατρός σου οὐ γάρ ἐστίν σοι δόξα πατρὸς ἀτιμία

text_en: For the glory of a man is from the honour of his father, and a father without honour is the disgrace of the son.
text_la: Gloria enim hominis ex honore patris sui, et dedecus filii pater sine honore.
text_el: ἡ γὰρ δόξα ἀνθρώπου ἐκ τιμῆς πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ὄνειδος τέκνοις μήτηρ ἐν ἀδοξίᾳ

text_en: Son, support the old age of your father, and grieve him not in his life;
text_la: Fili, suscipe senectam patris tui, et non contristes eum in vita illius :
text_el: τέκνον ἀντιλαβοῦ ἐν γήρᾳ πατρός σου καὶ μὴ λυπήσῃς αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ζωῇ αὐτοῦ

text_en: and if his understanding fail, have patience with him, and despise him not when you are in your strength: for the relieving of the father shall not be forgotten.
text_la: et si defecerit sensu, veniam da, et ne spernas eum in virtute tua : eleemosyna enim patris non erit in oblivione.
text_el: κἂν ἀπολείπῃ σύνεσιν συγγνώμην ἔχε καὶ μὴ ἀτιμάσῃς αὐτὸν ἐν πάσῃ ἰσχύι σου

text_en: For good shall be repaid to you for the sin of your mother.
text_la: Nam pro peccato matris restituetur tibi bonum :
text_el: ἐλεημοσύνη γὰρ πατρὸς οὐκ ἐπιλησθήσεται καὶ ἀντὶ ἁμαρτιῶν προσανοικοδομηθήσεταί σοι

text_en: And in justice you shall be built up, and in the day of affliction you shall be remembered: and your sins shall melt away as the ice in the fair warm weather.
text_la: et in justitia ædificabitur tibi, et in die tribulationis commemorabitur tui, et sicut in sereno glacies, solventur peccata tua.
text_el: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς σου ἀναμνησθήσεταί σου ὡς εὐδία ἐπὶ παγετῷ οὕτως ἀναλυθήσονταί σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι

text_en: Of what an evil fame is he that forsakes his father: and he is cursed of God that angers his mother.
text_la: Quam malæ famæ est qui derelinquit patrem, et est maledictus a Deo qui exasperat matrem!
text_el: ὡς βλάσφημος ὁ ἐγκαταλιπὼν πατέρα καὶ κεκατηραμένος ὑπὸ κυρίου ὁ παροργίζων μητέρα αὐτοῦ

text_en: My son, do your works in meekness, and you shall be beloved above the glory of men .
text_la: Fili, in mansuetudine opera tua perfice, et super hominum gloriam diligeris.
text_el: τέκνον ἐν πραΰτητι τὰ ἔργα σου διέξαγε καὶ ὑπὸ ἀνθρώπου δεκτοῦ ἀγαπηθήσῃ

text_en: The greater you are, the more humble yourself in all things, and you shall find grace before God :
text_la: Quanto magnus es, humilia te in omnibus, et coram Deo invenies gratiam :
text_el: ὅσῳ μέγας εἶ τοσούτῳ ταπείνου σεαυτόν καὶ ἔναντι κυρίου εὑρήσεις χάριν

text_en: For great is the power of God alone, and he is honoured by the humble .
text_la: quoniam magna potentia Dei solius, et ab humilibus honoratur.
text_el: ὅτι μεγάλη ἡ δυναστεία τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν ταπεινῶν δοξάζεται

text_en: Seek not the things that are too high for you, and search not into things above your ability: but the things that God has commanded you, think on them always, and in many of his works be not curious.
text_la: Altiora te ne quæsieris, et fortiora te ne scrutatus fueris : sed quæ præcepit tibi Deus, illa cogita semper, et in pluribus operibus ejus ne fueris curiosus.
text_el: χαλεπώτερά σου μὴ ζήτει καὶ ἰσχυρότερά σου μὴ ἐξέταζε

text_en: For it is not necessary for you to see with your eyes those things that are hid.
text_la: Non est enim tibi necessarium ea, quæ abscondita sunt, videre oculis tuis.
text_el: ἃ προσετάγη σοι ταῦτα διανοοῦ οὐ γάρ ἐστίν σοι χρεία τῶν κρυπτῶν

text_en: In unnecessary matters be not over curious, and in many of his works you shall not be inquisitive.
text_la: In supervacuis rebus noli scrutari multipliciter, et in pluribus operibus ejus non eris curiosus.
text_el: ἐν τοῖς περισσοῖς τῶν ἔργων σου μὴ περιεργάζου

text_en: For many things are shown to you above the understanding of men .
text_la: Plurima enim super sensum hominum ostensa sunt tibi :
text_el: πλείονα γὰρ συνέσεως ἀνθρώπων ὑπεδείχθη σοι

text_en: And the suspicion of them has deceived many, and has detained their minds in vanity.
text_la: multos quoque supplantavit suspicio illorum, et in vanitate detinuit sensus illorum.
text_el: πολλοὺς γὰρ ἐπλάνησεν ἡ ὑπόλημψις αὐτῶν καὶ ὑπόνοια πονηρὰ ὠλίσθησεν διανοίας αὐτῶν

text_en: A hard heart shall fear evil at the last: and he that loves danger shall perish in it.
text_la: Cor durum habebit male in novissimo, et qui amat periculum in illo peribit.
text_el: καρδία σκληρὰ κακωθήσεται ἐπ' ἐσχάτων καὶ ὁ ἀγαπῶν κίνδυνον ἐν αὐτῷ ἀπολεῖται

text_en: A heart that goes two ways shall not have success, and the perverse of heart shall be scandalized therein.
text_la: Cor ingrediens duas vias non habebit successus, et pravus corde in illis scandalizabitur.

text_en: A wicked heart shall be laden with sorrows, and the sinner will add sin to sin .
text_la: Cor nequam gravabitur in doloribus, et peccator adjiciet ad peccandum.
text_el: καρδία σκληρὰ βαρυνθήσεται πόνοις καὶ ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς προσθήσει ἁμαρτίαν ἐφ' ἁμαρτίαις

text_en: The congregation of the proud shall not be healed: for the plant of wickedness shall take root in them, and it shall not be perceived.
text_la: Synagogæ superborum non erit sanitas, frutex enim peccati radicabitur in illis, et non intelligetur.
text_el: ἐπαγωγῇ ὑπερηφάνου οὐκ ἔστιν ἴασις φυτὸν γὰρ πονηρίας ἐρρίζωκεν ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: The heart of the wise is understood in wisdom, and a good ear will hear wisdom with all desire.
text_la: Cor sapientis intelligitur in sapientia, et auris bona audiet cum omni concupiscentia sapientiam.
text_el: καρδία συνετοῦ διανοηθήσεται παραβολήν καὶ οὖς ἀκροατοῦ ἐπιθυμία σοφοῦ

text_en: A wise heart, and which has understanding, will abstain from sins , and in the works of justice shall have success.
text_la: Sapiens cor et intelligibile abstinebit se a peccatis, et in operibus justitiæ successus habebit.

text_en: Water quenches a flaming fire, and alms resists sins :
text_la: Ignem ardentem exstinguit aqua, et eleemosyna resistit peccatis :
text_el: πῦρ φλογιζόμενον ἀποσβέσει ὕδωρ καὶ ἐλεημοσύνη ἐξιλάσεται ἁμαρτίας

text_en: And God provides for him that shows favour: he remembers him afterwards, and in the time of his fall he shall find a sure stay.
text_la: et Deus prospector est ejus qui reddit gratiam : meminit ejus in posterum, et in tempore casus sui inveniet firmamentum.
text_el: ὁ ἀνταποδιδοὺς χάριτας μέμνηται εἰς τὰ μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἐν καιρῷ πτώσεως αὐτοῦ εὑρήσει στήριγμα

text_en: Son, defraud not the poor of alms , and turn not away your eyes from the poor.
text_la: Fili, eleemosynam pauperis ne defraudes, et oculos tuos ne transvertas a paupere.
text_pt: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, vós filhos de Israel, porque o SENHOR tem uma contenda com os habitantes da terra; porque na terra não há verdade, nem benignidade, nem conhecimento de Deus.
text_el: τέκνον τὴν ζωὴν τοῦ πτωχοῦ μὴ ἀποστερήσῃς καὶ μὴ παρελκύσῃς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἐπιδεεῖς

text_en: Despise not the hungry soul : and provoke not the poor in his want.
text_la: Animam esurientem ne despexeris, et non exasperes pauperem in inopia sua.
text_pt: Só permanecem o perjurar, o mentir, o matar, o furtar e o adulterar; fazem violência, um ato sanguinário segue imediatamente a outro.
text_el: ψυχὴν πεινῶσαν μὴ λυπήσῃς καὶ μὴ παροργίσῃς ἄνδρα ἐν ἀπορίᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Afflict not the heart of the needy, and defer not to gibe to him that is in distress.
text_la: Cor inopis ne afflixeris, et non protrahas datum angustianti.
text_pt: Por isso a terra se lamentará, e qualquer que morar nela desfalecerá, com os animais do campo e com as aves do céu; e até os peixes do mar serão tirados.
text_el: καρδίαν παρωργισμένην μὴ προσταράξῃς καὶ μὴ παρελκύσῃς δόσιν προσδεομένου

text_en: Reject not the petition of the afflicted: and turn not away your face from the needy.
text_la: Rogationem contribulati ne abjicias, et non avertas faciem tuam ab egeno.
text_pt: Todavia ninguém contenda, ninguém repreenda, porque o teu povo é como os que contendem com o sacerdote.
text_el: ἱκέτην θλιβόμενον μὴ ἀπαναίνου καὶ μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπὸ πτωχοῦ

text_en: Turn not away your eyes from the poor for fear of anger : and leave not to them that ask of you to curse you behind your back.
text_la: Ab inope ne avertas oculos tuos propter iram : et non relinquas quærentibus tibi retro maledicere.
text_pt: Por isso tropeçarás de dia, e o profeta contigo tropeçará de noite; e destruirei a tua mãe.
text_el: ἀπὸ δεομένου μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς ὀφθαλμὸν καὶ μὴ δῷς τόπον ἀνθρώπῳ καταράσασθαί σε

text_en: For the prayer of him that curses you in the bitterness of his soul , shall be heard, for he that made him will hear him.
text_la: Maledicentis enim tibi in amaritudine animæ, exaudietur deprecatio illius : exaudiet autem eum qui fecit illum.
text_pt: O meu povo foi destruído, porque lhe faltou o conhecimento; porque tu rejeitaste o conhecimento, também eu te rejeitarei, para que não sejas sacerdote diante de mim; e, visto que te esqueceste da lei do teu Deus, também eu me esquecerei de teus filhos.
text_el: καταρωμένου γάρ σε ἐν πικρίᾳ ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ τῆς δεήσεως αὐτοῦ ἐπακούσεται ὁ ποιήσας αὐτόν

text_en: Make yourself affable to the congregation of the poor, and humble your soul to the ancient, and bow your head to a great man .
text_la: Congregationi pauperum affabilem te facito : et presbytero humilia animam tuam, et magnato humilia caput tuum.
text_pt: Como eles se multiplicaram, assim pecaram contra mim; eu mudarei a sua honra em vergonha.
text_el: προσφιλῆ συναγωγῇ σεαυτὸν ποίει καὶ μεγιστᾶνι ταπείνου τὴν κεφαλήν σου

text_en: Bow down your ear cheerfully to the poor, and pay what you owe, and answer him peaceable words with mildness.
text_la: Declina pauperi sine tristitia aurem tuam, et redde debitum tuum, et responde illi pacifica in mansuetudine.
text_pt: Comem da oferta pelo pecado do meu povo, e pela transgressão dele têm desejo ardente.
text_el: κλῖνον πτωχῷ τὸ οὖς σου καὶ ἀποκρίθητι αὐτῷ εἰρηνικὰ ἐν πραΰτητι

text_en: Deliver him that suffers wrong out of the hand of the proud : and be not fainthearted in your soul .
text_la: Libera eum qui injuriam patitur de manu superbi, et non acide feras in anima tua.
text_pt: Por isso, como é o povo, assim será o sacerdote; e castigá-lo-ei segundo os seus caminhos, e dar-lhe-ei a recompensa das suas obras.
text_el: ἐξελοῦ ἀδικούμενον ἐκ χειρὸς ἀδικοῦντος καὶ μὴ ὀλιγοψυχήσῃς ἐν τῷ κρίνειν σε

text_en: In judging be merciful to the fatherless as a father, and as a husband to their mother.
text_la: In judicando esto pupillis misericors ut pater, et pro viro matri illorum :
text_pt: Comerão, mas não se fartarão; entregar-se-ão à luxúria, mas não se multiplicarão; porque deixaram de atentar ao Senhor.
text_el: γίνου ὀρφανοῖς ὡς πατὴρ καὶ ἀντὶ ἀνδρὸς τῇ μητρὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: And you shall be as the obedient son of the most High, and he will have mercy on you more than a mother.
text_la: et eris tu velut filius Altissimi obediens, et miserebitur tui magis quam mater.
text_pt: A luxúria, e o vinho, e o mosto tiram o coração.
text_el: καὶ ἔσῃ ὡς υἱὸς ὑψίστου καὶ ἀγαπήσει σε μᾶλλον ἢ μήτηρ σου

text_en: Wisdom inspires life into her children, and protects them that seek after her, and will go before them in the way of justice .
text_la: Sapientia filiis suis vitam inspirat : et suscipit inquirentes se, et præibit in via justitiæ.
text_pt: O meu povo consulta a sua madeira, e a sua vara lhe responde, porque o espírito da luxúria os engana, e prostituem-se, apartando-se da sujeição do seu Deus.
text_el: ἡ σοφία υἱοὺς αὐτῆς ἀνύψωσεν καὶ ἐπιλαμβάνεται τῶν ζητοῦντων αὐτήν

text_en: And he that loves her, loves life: and they that watch for her, shall embrace her sweetness.
text_la: Et qui illam diligit, diligit vitam, et qui vigilaverint ad illam complectentur placorem ejus.
text_pt: Sacrificam sobre os cumes dos montes, e queimam incenso sobre os outeiros, debaixo do carvalho, e do álamo, e do olmeiro, porque é boa a sua sombra; por isso vossas filhas se prostituem, e as vossas noras adulteram.
text_el: ὁ ἀγαπῶν αὐτὴν ἀγαπᾷ ζωήν καὶ οἱ ὀρθρίζοντες πρὸς αὐτὴν ἐμπλησθήσονται εὐφροσύνης

text_en: They that hold her fast, shall inherit life: and wherever she enters, God will give a blessing .
text_la: Qui tenuerint illam, vitam hæreditabunt : et quo introibit benedicet Deus.
text_pt: Eu não castigarei vossas filhas, quando se prostituem, nem vossas noras, quando adulteram; porque eles mesmos com as prostitutas se desviam, e com as meretrizes sacrificam; pois o povo que não tem entendimento será transtornado.
text_el: ὁ κρατῶν αὐτῆς κληρονομήσει δόξαν καὶ οὗ εἰσπορεύεται εὐλογεῖ κύριος

text_en: They that serve her, shall be servants to the holy one: and God loves them that love her.
text_la: Qui serviunt ei obsequentes erunt sancto : et eos qui diligunt illam, diligit Deus.
text_pt: Ainda que tu, ó Israel, queiras prostituir-te, contudo não se faça culpado Judá; não venhais a Gilgal, e não subais a Bete-Áven, e não jureis, dizendo: Vive o Senhor.
text_el: οἱ λατρεύοντες αὐτῇ λειτουργήσουσιν ἁγίῳ καὶ τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας αὐτὴν ἀγαπᾷ ὁ κύριος

text_en: He that hearkens to her, shall judge nations: and he that looks upon her, shall remain secure.
text_la: Qui audit illam judicabit gentes : et qui intuetur illam permanebit confidens.
text_pt: Porque como uma novilha obstinada se rebelou Israel; agora o Senhor os apascentará como a um cordeiro num lugar espaçoso.
text_el: ὁ ὑπακούων αὐτῆς κρινεῖ ἔθνη καὶ ὁ προσέχων αὐτῇ κατασκηνώσει πεποιθώς

text_en: If he trust to her, he shall inherit her, and his generation shall be in assurance.
text_la: Si crediderit ei, hæreditabit illam, et erunt in confirmatione creaturæ illius :
text_pt: Efraim está entregue aos ídolos; deixa-o.
text_el: ἐὰν ἐμπιστεύσῃ κατακληρονομήσει αὐτήν καὶ ἐν κατασχέσει ἔσονται αἱ γενεαὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: For she walks with him in temptation , and at the first she chooses him.
text_la: quoniam in tentatione ambulat cum eo, et in primis eligit eum.
text_pt: A sua bebida se foi; lançaram-se à luxúria continuamente; certamente os seus governadores amam a vergonha.
text_el: ὅτι διεστραμμένως πορεύσεται μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν πρώτοις

text_en: She will bring upon him fear and dread and trial: and she will scourge him with the affliction of her discipline, till she try him by her laws, and trust his soul .
text_la: Timorem, et metum, et probationem inducet super illum : et cruciabit illum in tribulatione doctrinæ suæ, donec tentet eum in cogitationibus suis, et credat animæ illius.
text_pt: Um vento os envolveu nas suas asas, e envergonhar-se-ão por causa dos seus sacrifícios.
text_el: φόβον καὶ δειλίαν ἐπάξει ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ βασανίσει αὐτὸν ἐν παιδείᾳ αὐτῆς ἕως οὗ ἐμπιστεύσῃ τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ καὶ πειράσει αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς δικαιώμασιν αὐτῆς

text_en: Then she will strengthen him, and make a straight way to him, and give him joy ,
text_la: Et firmabit illum, et iter adducet directum ad illum, et lætificabit illum :
text_el: καὶ πάλιν ἐπανήξει κατ' εὐθεῖαν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εὐφρανεῖ αὐτὸν

text_en: and will disclose her secrets to him, and will heap upon him treasures of knowledge and understanding of justice .
text_la: et denudabit absconsa sua illi, et thesaurizabit super illum scientiam et intellectum justitiæ.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκαλύψει αὐτῷ τὰ κρυπτὰ αὐτῆς

text_en: But if he go astray, she will forsake him, and deliver him into the hands of his enemy.
text_la: Si autem oberraverit, derelinquet eum, et tradet eum in manus inimici sui.
text_el: ἐὰν ἀποπλανηθῇ ἐγκαταλείψει αὐτὸν καὶ παραδώσει αὐτὸν εἰς χεῖρας πτώσεως αὐτοῦ

text_en: Son, observe the time, and fly from evil .
text_la: Fili, conserva tempus, et devita a malo.
text_el: συντήρησον καιρὸν καὶ φύλαξαι ἀπὸ πονηροῦ

text_en: For your soul be not ashamed to say the truth .
text_la: Pro anima tua ne confundaris dicere verum :
text_el: καὶ περὶ τῆς ψυχῆς σου μὴ αἰσχυνθῇς

text_en: For there is a shame that brings sin , and there is a shame that brings glory and grace .
text_la: est enim confusio adducens peccatum, et est confusio adducens gloriam et gratiam.
text_el: ἔστιν γὰρ αἰσχύνη ἐπάγουσα ἁμαρτίαν καὶ ἔστιν αἰσχύνη δόξα καὶ χάρις

text_en: Accept no person against your own person, nor against your soul a lie.
text_la: Ne accipias faciem adversus faciem tuam, nec adversus animam tuam mendacium.
text_el: μὴ λάβῃς πρόσωπον κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς σου

text_en: Reverence not your neighbour in his fall:
text_la: Ne reverearis proximum tuum in casu suo,
text_el: καὶ μὴ ἐντραπῇς εἰς πτῶσίν σου

text_en: And refrain not to speak in the time of salvation . Hide not your wisdom in her beauty.
text_la: nec retineas verbum in tempore salutis. Non abscondas sapientiam tuam in decore suo :
text_el: μὴ κωλύσῃς λόγον ἐν καιρῷ χρείας

text_en: For by the tongue wisdom is discerned: and understanding, and knowledge , and learning by the word of the wise, and steadfastness in the works of justice .
text_la: in lingua enim sapientia dignoscitur : et sensus, et scientia, et doctrina in verbo sensati, et firmamentum in operibus justitiæ.
text_el: ἐν γὰρ λόγῳ γνωσθήσεται σοφία καὶ παιδεία ἐν ῥήματι γλώσσης

text_en: In nowise speak against the truth , but be ashamed of the lie of your ignorance .
text_la: Non contradicas verbo veritatis ullo modo, et de mendacio ineruditionis tuæ confundere.
text_el: μὴ ἀντίλεγε τῇ ἀληθείᾳ καὶ περὶ τῆς ἀπαιδευσίας σου ἐντράπηθι

text_en: Be not ashamed to confess your sins , but submit not yourself to every man for sin .
text_la: Non confundaris confiteri peccata tua, et ne subjicias te omni homini pro peccato.
text_el: μὴ αἰσχυνθῇς ὁμολογῆσαι ἐφ' ἁμαρτίαις σου καὶ μὴ βιάζου ῥοῦν ποταμοῦ

text_en: Resist not against the face of the mighty, and do not strive against the stream of the river.
text_la: Noli resistere contra faciem potentis, nec coneris contra ictum fluvii.
text_el: καὶ μὴ ὑποστρώσῃς ἀνθρώπῳ μωρῷ σεαυτὸν καὶ μὴ λάβῃς πρόσωπον δυνάστου

text_en: Strive for justice for your soul , and even unto death fight for justice , and God will overthrow your enemies for you.
text_la: Pro justitia agonizare pro anima tua, et usque ad mortem certa pro justitia : et Deus expugnabit pro te inimicos tuos.
text_el: ἕως θανάτου ἀγώνισαι περὶ τῆς ἀληθείας καὶ κύριος ὁ θεὸς πολεμήσει ὑπὲρ σοῦ

text_en: Be not hasty in your tongue: and slack and remiss in your works.
text_la: Noli citatus esse in lingua tua, et inutilis, et remissus in operibus tuis.
text_el: μὴ γίνου θρασὺς ἐν γλώσσῃ σου καὶ νωθρὸς καὶ παρειμένος ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις σου

text_en: Be not as a lion in your house, terrifying them of your household, and oppressing them that are under you.
text_la: Noli esse sicut leo in domo tua, evertens domesticos tuos, et opprimens subjectos tibi.
text_el: μὴ ἴσθι ὡς λέων ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου καὶ φαντασιοκοπῶν ἐν τοῖς οἰκέταις σου

text_en: Let not your hand be stretched out to receive, and shut when you should give.
text_la: Non sit porrecta manus tua ad accipiendum, et ad dandum collecta.
text_el: μὴ ἔστω ἡ χείρ σου ἐκτεταμένη εἰς τὸ λαβεῖν καὶ ἐν τῷ ἀποδιδόναι συνεσταλμένη

text_en: W innow not with every wind, and go not into every way; for so is every sinner proved by a double tongue.
text_la: Noli attendere ad possessiones iniquas, et ne dixeris : Est mihi sufficiens vita : nihil enim proderit in tempore vindictæ et obductionis.
text_pt: Ouvi isto, ó sacerdotes, e escutai, ó casa de Israel, e dai ouvidos, ó casa do rei, porque contra vós se dirige este juízo, visto que fostes um laço para Mizpá, e rede estendida sobre o Tabor.
text_el: μὴ ἔπεχε ἐπὶ τοῖς χρήμασίν σου καὶ μὴ εἴπῃς αὐτάρκη μοί ἐστιν

text_en: Follow not in your strength the desires of your heart,
text_la: Ne sequaris in fortitudine tua concupiscentiam cordis tui,
text_pt: Os revoltos se aprofundaram na matança; mas eu castigarei a todos eles.
text_el: μὴ ἐξακολούθει τῇ ψυχῇ σου καὶ τῇ ἰσχύι σου πορεύεσθαι ἐν ἐπιθυμίαις καρδίας σου

text_en: and say not, "How mighty am I? And who shall bring me under for my deeds?" For God will surely take revenge.
text_la: et ne dixeris : Quomodo potui? aut, Quis me subjiciet propter facta mea? Deus enim vindicans vindicabit.
text_pt: Eu conheço a Efraim, e Israel não se esconde de mim; porque agora te tens prostituído, ó Efraim, e Israel se contaminou.
text_el: καὶ μὴ εἴπῃς τίς με δυναστεύσει ὁ γὰρ κύριος ἐκδικῶν ἐκδικήσει

text_en: Say not, "I have sinned , and what harm has befallen me?" For the most High is a patient rewarder.
text_la: Ne dixeris : Peccavi : et quid mihi accidit triste? Altissimus enim est patiens redditor.
text_pt: Não querem ordenar as suas ações a fim de voltarem para o seu Deus, porque o espírito das prostituições está no meio deles, e não conhecem ao Senhor.
text_el: μὴ εἴπῃς ἥμαρτον καὶ τί μοι ἐγένετο ὁ γὰρ κύριός ἐστιν μακρόθυμος

text_en: Be not without fear about sin forgiven, and add not sin upon sin .
text_la: De propitiatio peccato noli esse sine metu, neque adjicias peccatum super peccatum.
text_pt: A soberba de Israel testificará no seu rosto; e Israel e Efraim cairão pela sua injustiça, e Judá cairá juntamente com eles.
text_el: περὶ ἐξιλασμοῦ μὴ ἄφοβος γίνου προσθεῖναι ἁμαρτίαν ἐφ' ἁμαρτίαις

text_en: And say not, "The mercy of the Lord is great, he will have mercy on the multitude of my sins ."
text_la: Et ne dicas : Miseratio Domini magna est, multitudinis peccatorum meorum miserebitur :
text_pt: Então irão com os seus rebanhos, e com o seu gado, para buscarem ao Senhor, mas não o acharão; ele se retirou deles.
text_el: καὶ μὴ εἴπῃς ὁ οἰκτιρμὸς αὐτοῦ πολύς τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν μου ἐξιλάσεται

text_en: For mercy and wrath quickly come from him, and his wrath looks upon sinners.
text_la: misericordia enim et ira ab illo cito proximant, et in peccatores respicit ira illius.
text_pt: Aleivosamente se houveram contra o Senhor, porque geraram filhos estranhos; agora em um só mês os consumirá com as suas porções.
text_el: ἔλεος γὰρ καὶ ὀργὴ παρ' αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπὶ ἁμαρτωλοὺς καταπαύσει ὁ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Delay not to be converted to the Lord , and defer it not from day to day.
text_la: Non tardes converti ad Dominum, et ne differas de die in diem :
text_pt: Tocai a buzina em Gibeá, a trombeta em Ramá; gritai altamente em Bete-Áven; depois de ti, ó Benjamim.
text_el: μὴ ἀνάμενε ἐπιστρέψαι πρὸς κύριον καὶ μὴ ὑπερβάλλου ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας

text_en: For his wrath shall come on a sudden, and in the time of vengeance he will destroy you.
text_la: subito enim veniet ira illius, et in tempore vindictæ disperdet te.
text_pt: Efraim será para assolação no dia do castigo; entre as tribos de Israel manifestei o que está certo.
text_el: ἐξάπινα γὰρ ἐξελεύσεται ὀργὴ κυρίου καὶ ἐν καιρῷ ἐκδικήσεως ἐξολῇ

text_en: Be not anxious for goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit you in the day of calamity and revenge.
text_la: Noli anxius esse in divitiis injustis : non enim proderunt tibi in die obductionis et vindictæ.
text_pt: Os príncipes de Judá são como os que mudam os limites; derramarei, pois, o meu furor sobre eles como água.
text_el: μὴ ἔπεχε ἐπὶ χρήμασιν ἀδίκοις οὐδὲν γὰρ ὠφελήσει σε ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπαγωγῆς

text_la: Non ventiles te in omnem ventum, et non eas in omnem viam : sic enim omnis peccator probatur in duplici lingua.
text_pt: Efraim está oprimido e quebrantado no juízo, porque quis andar após o mandamento dos homens.
text_el: μὴ λίκμα ἐν παντὶ ἀνέμῳ καὶ μὴ πορεύου ἐν πάσῃ ἀτραπῷ οὕτως ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς ὁ δίγλωσσος

text_en: Be steadfast in the way of the Lord , and in the truth of your judgment, and in knowledge , and let the word of peace and justice keep with you.
text_la: Esto firmus in via Domini, et in veritate sensus tui et scientia : et prosequatur te verbum pacis et justitiæ.
text_pt: Portanto a Efraim serei como a traça, e para a casa de Judá como a podridão.
text_el: ἴσθι ἐστηριγμένος ἐν συνέσει σου καὶ εἷς ἔστω σου ὁ λόγος

text_en: Be meek to hear the word, that you may understand; and return a true answer with wisdom.
text_la: Esto mansuetus ad audiendum verbum, ut intelligas, et cum sapientia proferas responsum verum.
text_pt: Quando Efraim viu a sua enfermidade, e Judá a sua chaga, subiu Efraim à Assíria e enviou ao rei Jarebe; mas ele não poderá sarar-vos, nem curar a vossa chaga.
text_el: γίνου ταχὺς ἐν ἀκροάσει σου καὶ ἐν μακροθυμίᾳ φθέγγου ἀπόκρισιν

text_en: If you have understanding, answer your neighbour. But if not, let your hand be upon your mouth, lest you be surprised in an unskilful word, and be confounded.
text_la: Si est tibi intellectus, responde proximo : sin autem, sit manus tua super os tuum, ne capiaris in verbo indisciplinato, et confundaris.
text_pt: Porque para Efraim serei como um leão, e como um leãozinho à casa de Judá: eu, eu o despedaçarei, e irme-ei embora; arrebatarei, e não haverá quem livre.
text_el: εἰ ἔστιν σοι σύνεσις ἀποκρίθητι τῷ πλησίον εἰ δὲ μή ἡ χείρ σου ἔστω ἐπὶ τῷ στόματί σου

text_en: Honour and glory is in the word of the wise, but the tongue of the fool is his ruin.
text_la: Honor et gloria in sermone sensati : lingua vero imprudentis subversio est ipsius.
text_pt: Irei e voltarei ao meu lugar, até que se reconheçam culpados e busquem a minha face; estando eles angustiados, de madrugada me buscarão.
text_el: δόξα καὶ ἀτιμία ἐν λαλιᾷ καὶ γλῶσσα ἀνθρώπου πτῶσις αὐτῷ

text_en: Be not called a whisperer, and be not taken in your tongue, and confounded.
text_la: Non appelleris susurro, et lingua tua ne capiaris et confundaris :
text_el: μὴ κληθῇς ψίθυρος καὶ τῇ γλώσσῃ σου μὴ ἐνέδρευε

text_en: For confusion and repentance is upon a thief , and an evil mark of disgrace upon the double tongued; but to the whisperer hatred , and enmity, and reproach.
text_la: super furem enim est confusio et pœnitentia, et denotatio pessima super bilinguem : susurratori autem odium, et inimicitia, et contumelia.
text_el: ἐπὶ γὰρ τῷ κλέπτῃ ἐστὶν αἰσχύνη καὶ κατάγνωσις πονηρὰ ἐπὶ διγλώσσου

text_en: Justify alike the small and the great.
text_la: Justifica pusillum et magnum similiter.
text_el: ἐν μεγάλῳ καὶ ἐν μικρῷ μὴ ἀγνόει

text_en: Instead of a friend become not an enemy to your neighbour: for an evil man shall inherit reproach and shame, so shall every sinner that is envious and double tongued.
text_la: Noli fieri pro amico inimicus proximo : improperium enim et contumeliam malus hæreditabit : et omnis peccator invidus et bilinguis.
text_pt: Vinde, e tornemos ao SENHOR, porque ele despedaçou, e nos sarará; feriu, e nos atará a ferida.
text_el: καὶ ἀντὶ φίλου μὴ γίνου ἐχθρός ὄνομα γὰρ πονηρὸν αἰσχύνην καὶ ὄνειδος κληρονομήσει οὕτως ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς ὁ δίγλωσσος

text_en: Extol not yourself in the thoughts of your soul like a bull: lest your strength be quashed by folly,
text_la: Non te extollas in cogitatione animæ tuæ velut taurus, ne forte elidatur virtus tua per stultitiam :
text_pt: Depois de dois dias nos dará a vida; ao terceiro dia nos ressuscitará, e viveremos diante dele.
text_el: μὴ ἐπάρῃς σεαυτὸν ἐν βουλῇ ψυχῆς σου ἵνα μὴ διαρπαγῇ ὡς ταῦρος ἡ ψυχή σου

text_en: and it eat up your leaves, and destroy your fruit, and you be left as a dry tree in the wilderness .
text_la: et folia tua comedat, et fructus tuos perdat, et relinquaris velut lignum aridum in eremo.
text_pt: Então conheçamos, e prossigamos em conhecer ao Senhor; a sua saída, como a alva, é certa; e ele a nós virá como a chuva, como chuva serôdia que rega a terra.
text_el: τὰ φύλλα σου καταφάγεσαι καὶ τοὺς καρπούς σου ἀπολέσεις καὶ ἀφήσεις σεαυτὸν ὡς ξύλον ξηρόν

text_en: For a wicked soul shall destroy him that has it, and makes him to be a joy to his enemies, and shall lead him into the lot of the wicked .
text_la: Anima enim nequam disperdet qui se habet, et in gaudium inimicis dat illum, et deducet in sortem impiorum.
text_pt: Que te farei, ó Efraim? Que te farei, ó Judá? Porque a vossa benignidade é como a nuvem da manhã e como o orvalho da madrugada, que cedo passa.
text_el: ψυχὴ πονηρὰ ἀπολεῖ τὸν κτησάμενον αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπίχαρμα ἐχθρῶν ποιήσει αὐτόν

text_en: A sweet word multiplies friends, and appeases enemies, and a gracious tongue in a good man abounds.
text_la: Verbum dulce multiplicat amicos et mitigat inimicos, et lingua eucharis in bono homine abundat.
text_pt: Por isso os abati pelos profetas; pelas palavras da minha boca os matei; e os teus juízos sairão como a luz,
text_el: λάρυγξ γλυκὺς πληθυνεῖ φίλους αὐτοῦ καὶ γλῶσσα εὔλαλος πληθυνεῖ εὐπροσήγορα

text_en: Be in peace with many, but let one of a thousand be your counsellor.
text_la: Multi pacifici sint tibi : et consiliarius sit tibi unus de mille.
text_pt: Porque eu quero a misericórdia, e não o sacrifício; e o conhecimento de Deus, mais do que os holocaustos.
text_el: οἱ εἰρηνεύοντές σοι ἔστωσαν πολλοί οἱ δὲ σύμβουλοί σου εἷς ἀπὸ χιλίων

text_en: If you would get a friend, try him before you take him, and do not credit him easily.
text_la: Si possides amicum, in tentatione posside eum, et ne facile credas ei.
text_pt: Mas eles transgrediram a aliança, como Adão; eles se portaram aleivosamente contra mim.
text_el: εἰ κτᾶσαι φίλον ἐν πειρασμῷ κτῆσαι αὐτὸν καὶ μὴ ταχὺ ἐμπιστεύσῃς αὐτῷ

text_en: For there is a friend for his own occasion, and he will not abide in the day of your trouble.
text_la: Est enim amicus secundum tempus suum, et non permanebit in die tribulationis.
text_pt: Gileade é a cidade dos que praticam iniqüidade, manchada de sangue.
text_el: ἔστιν γὰρ φίλος ἐν καιρῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ μὴ παραμείνῃ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς σου

text_en: And there is a friend that turns to enmity; and there is a friend that will disclose hatred and strife and reproaches.
text_la: Et est amicus qui convertitur ad inimicitiam, et est amicus qui odium et rixam et convitia denudabit.
text_pt: Como as hordas de salteadores que esperam alguns, assim é a companhia dos sacerdotes que matam no caminho num mesmo consenso; sim, eles cometem abominações.
text_el: καὶ ἔστιν φίλος μετατιθέμενος εἰς ἔχθραν καὶ μάχην ὀνειδισμοῦ σου ἀποκαλύψει

text_en: And there is a friend a companion at the table, and he will not abide in the day of distress.
text_la: Est autem amicus socius mensæ, et non permanebit in die necessitatis.
text_pt: Vejo uma coisa horrenda na casa de Israel, ali está a prostituição de Efraim; Israel está contaminado.
text_el: καὶ ἔστιν φίλος κοινωνὸς τραπεζῶν καὶ οὐ μὴ παραμείνῃ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς σου

text_en: A friend if he continue steadfast, shall be to you as yourself, and shall act with confidence among them of your household.
text_la: Amicus si permanserit fixus, erit tibi quasi coæqualis, et in domesticis tuis fiducialiter aget.
text_pt: Também para ti, ó Judá, está assinada uma sega, quando eu trouxer o cativeiro do meu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς σου ἔσται ὡς σὺ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς οἰκέτας σου παρρησιάσεται

text_en: If he humble himself before you, and hide himself from your face, you shall have unanimous friendship for good .
text_la: Si humiliaverit se contra te, et a facie tua absconderit se, unanimem habebis amicitiam bonam.
text_el: ἐὰν ταπεινωθῇς ἔσται κατὰ σοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου σου κρυβήσεται

text_en: Separate yourself from your enemies, and take heed of your friends.
text_la: Ab inimicis tuis separare, et ab amicis tuis attende.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου διαχωρίσθητι καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν φίλων σου πρόσεχε

text_en: A faithful friend is a strong defence: and he that has found him, has found a treasure.
text_la: Amicus fidelis protectio fortis : qui autem invenit illum, invenit thesaurum.
text_el: φίλος πιστὸς σκέπη κραταιά ὁ δὲ εὑρὼν αὐτὸν εὗρεν θησαυρόν

text_en: Nothing can be compared to a faithful friend, and no weight of gold and silver is able to countervail the goodness of his fidelity.
text_la: Amico fideli nulla est comparatio, et non est digna ponderatio auri et argenti contra bonitatem fidei illius.
text_el: φίλου πιστοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀντάλλαγμα καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν σταθμὸς τῆς καλλονῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: A faithful friend is the medicine of life and immortality : and they that fear the Lord , shall find him.
text_la: Amicus fidelis medicamentum vitæ et immortalitatis : et qui metuunt Dominum, invenient illum.
text_el: φίλος πιστὸς φάρμακον ζωῆς καὶ οἱ φοβούμενοι κύριον εὑρήσουσιν αὐτόν

text_en: He that fears God , shall likewise have good friendship: because according to him shall his friend be.
text_la: Qui timet Deum æque habebit amicitiam bonam, quoniam secundum illum erit amicus illius.
text_el: ὁ φοβούμενος κύριον εὐθυνεῖ φιλίαν αὐτοῦ ὅτι κατ' αὐτὸν οὕτως καὶ ὁ πλησίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: My son, from your youth up receive instruction, and even to your grey hairs you shall find wisdom.
text_la: Fili, a juventute tua excipe doctrinam, et usque ad canos invenies sapientiam.
text_el: τέκνον ἐκ νεότητός σου ἐπίλεξαι παιδείαν καὶ ἕως πολιῶν εὑρήσεις σοφίαν

text_en: Come to her as one that ploughs, and sows, and wait for her good fruits:
text_la: Quasi is qui arat et seminat accede ad eam, et sustine bonos fructus illius.
text_el: ὡς ὁ ἀροτριῶν καὶ ὁ σπείρων πρόσελθε αὐτῇ καὶ ἀνάμενε τοὺς ἀγαθοὺς καρποὺς αὐτῆς ἐν γὰρ τῇ ἐργασίᾳ αὐτῆς ὀλίγον κοπιάσεις καὶ ταχὺ φάγεσαι τῶν γενημάτων αὐτῆς

text_en: For in working about her you shall labour a little, and shall quickly eat of her fruits.
text_la: In opere enim ipsius exiguum laborabis, et cito edes de generationibus illius.
text_el: ὡς τραχεῖά ἐστιν σφόδρα τοῖς ἀπαιδεύτοις καὶ οὐκ ἐμμενεῖ ἐν αὐτῇ ἀκάρδιος

text_en: How very unpleasant is wisdom to the unlearned, and the unwise will not continue with her.
text_la: Quam aspera est nimium sapientia indoctis hominibus! et non permanebit in illa excors.
text_el: ὡς λίθος δοκιμασίας ἰσχυρὸς ἔσται ἐπ' αὐτῷ καὶ οὐ χρονιεῖ ἀπορρῖψαι αὐτήν

text_en: She shall be to them as a mighty stone of trial, and they will cast her from them before it be long.
text_la: Quasi lapidis virtus probatio erit in illis : et non demorabuntur projicere illam.
text_el: σοφία γὰρ κατὰ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς ἐστιν καὶ οὐ πολλοῖς ἐστιν φανερά

text_en: For the wisdom of doctrine is according to her name , and she is not manifest unto many, but with them to whom she is known , she continues even to the sight of God .
text_la: Sapientia enim doctrinæ secundum nomen est ejus, et non est multis manifestata : quibus autem cognita est, permanet usque ad conspectum Dei.
text_el: ἄκουσον τέκνον καὶ ἔκδεξαι γνώμην μου καὶ μὴ ἀπαναίνου τὴν συμβουλίαν μου

text_en: Give ear, my son, and take wise counsel, and cast not away my advice.
text_la: Audi, fili, et accipe consilium intellectus, et ne abjicias consilium meum.
text_el: καὶ εἰσένεγκον τοὺς πόδας σου εἰς τὰς πέδας αὐτῆς καὶ εἰς τὸν κλοιὸν αὐτῆς τὸν τράχηλόν σου

text_en: Put your feet into her fetters, and your neck into her chains:
text_la: Injice pedem tuum in compedes illius, et in torques illius collum tuum.
text_el: ὑπόθες τὸν ὦμόν σου καὶ βάσταξον αὐτὴν καὶ μὴ προσοχθίσῃς τοῖς δεσμοῖς αὐτῆς

text_en: Bow down your shoulder, and bear her, and be not grieved with her bands.
text_la: Subjice humerum tuum, et porta illam, et ne acedieris vinculis ejus.
text_el: ἐν πάσῃ ψυχῇ σου πρόσελθε αὐτῇ καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ δυνάμει σου συντήρησον τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῆς

text_en: Come to her with all your mind, and keep her ways with all your power.
text_la: In omni animo tuo accede ad illam, et in omni virtute tua conserva vias ejus.
text_el: ἐξίχνευσον καὶ ζήτησον καὶ γνωσθήσεταί σοι καὶ ἐγκρατὴς γενόμενος μὴ ἀφῇς αὐτήν

text_en: Search for her, and she shall be made known to you, and when you have gotten her, let her not go:
text_la: Investiga illam, et manifestabitur tibi : et continens factus, ne derelinquas eam :
text_el: ἐπ' ἐσχάτων γὰρ εὑρήσεις τὴν ἀνάπαυσιν αὐτῆς καὶ στραφήσεταί σοι εἰς εὐφροσύνην

text_en: For in the latter end you shall find rest in her, and she shall be turned to your joy .
text_la: in novissimis enim invenies requiem in ea, et convertetur tibi in oblectationem.
text_el: καὶ ἔσονταί σοι αἱ πέδαι εἰς σκέπην ἰσχύος καὶ οἱ κλοιοὶ αὐτῆς εἰς στολὴν δόξης

text_en: Then shall her fetters be a strong defence for you, and a firm foundation, and her chain a robe of glory :
text_la: Et erunt tibi compedes ejus in protectionem fortitudinis et bases virtutis, et torques illius in stolam gloriæ :
text_el: κόσμος γὰρ χρύσεός ἐστιν ἐπ' αὐτῆς καὶ οἱ δεσμοὶ αὐτῆς κλῶσμα ὑακίνθινον

text_en: For in her is the beauty of life, and her bands are a healthful binding.
text_la: decor enim vitæ est in illa, et vincula illius alligatura salutaris.
text_el: στολὴν δόξης ἐνδύσῃ αὐτὴν καὶ στέφανον ἀγαλλιάματος περιθήσεις σεαυτῷ

text_en: You shall put her on as a robe of glory , and you shall set her upon you as a crown of joy .
text_la: Stolam gloriæ indues eam, et coronam gratulationis superpones tibi.
text_el: ἐὰν θέλῃς τέκνον παιδευθήσῃ καὶ ἐὰν ἐπιδῷς τὴν ψυχήν σου πανοῦργος ἔσῃ

text_en: My son, if you will attend to me, you shall learn: and if you will apply your mind, you shall be wise.
text_la: Fili, si attenderis mihi, disces : et si accommodaveris animum tuum, sapiens eris.
text_el: ἐὰν ἀγαπήσῃς ἀκούειν ἐκδέξῃ καὶ ἐὰν κλίνῃς τὸ οὖς σου σοφὸς ἔσῃ

text_en: If you will incline your ear, you shall receive instruction: and if you love to hear, you shall be wise.
text_la: Si inclinaveris aurem tuam, excipies doctrinam : et si dilexeris audire, sapiens eris.
text_el: ἐν πλήθει πρεσβυτέρων στῆθι καὶ τίς σοφός αὐτῷ προσκολλήθητι

text_en: Stand in the multitude of ancients that are wise, and join yourself from your heart to their wisdom, that you may hear every discourse of God , and the sayings of praise may not escape you.
text_la: In multitudine presbyterorum prudentium sta, et sapientiæ illorum ex corde conjungere, ut omnem narrationem Dei possis audire, et proverbia laudis non effugiant a te.
text_el: πᾶσαν διήγησιν θείαν θέλε ἀκροᾶσθαι καὶ παροιμίαι συνέσεως μὴ ἐκφευγέτωσάν σε

text_en: And if you see a man of understanding, go to him early in the morning, and let your foot wear the steps of his doors.
text_la: Et si videris sensatum, evigila ad eum, et gradus ostiorum illius exterat pes tuus.
text_el: ἐὰν ἴδῃς συνετόν ὄρθριζε πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ βαθμοὺς θυρῶν αὐτοῦ ἐκτριβέτω ὁ πούς σου

text_en: Let your thoughts be upon the precepts of God , and meditate continually on his commandments: and he will give you a heart, and the desire of wisdom shall be given to you.
text_la: Cogitatum tuum habe in præceptis Dei, et in mandatis illius maxime assiduus esto : et ipse dabit tibi cor, et concupiscentia sapientiæ dabitur tibi.
text_el: διανοοῦ ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασιν κυρίου καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς αὐτοῦ μελέτα διὰ παντός αὐτὸς στηριεῖ τὴν καρδίαν σου καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῆς σοφίας δοθήσεταί σοι

text_en: Do no evils , and no evils shall lay hold of you.
text_la: Noli facere mala, et non te apprehendent :
text_pt: Sarando eu a Israel, se descobriu a iniqüidade de Efraim, como também as maldades de Samaria, porque praticaram a falsidade; e o ladrão entra, e a horda dos salteadores despoja por fora.
text_el: μὴ ποίει κακά καὶ οὐ μή σε καταλάβῃ κακόν

text_en: Depart from the unjust , and evils shall depart from you.
text_la: discede ab iniquo, et deficient mala abs te.
text_pt: E não dizem no seu coração que eu me lembro de toda a sua maldade; agora, pois, os cercam as suas obras; diante da minha face estão.
text_el: ἀπόστηθι ἀπὸ ἀδίκου καὶ ἐκκλινεῖ ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: My son, sow not evils in the furrows of injustice , and you shall not reap them sevenfold.
text_la: Fili, non semines mala in sulcis injustitiæ, et non metes ea in septuplum.
text_pt: Com a sua malícia alegram ao rei, e com as suas mentiras aos príncipes.
text_el: υἱέ μὴ σπεῖρε ἐπ' αὔλακας ἀδικίας καὶ οὐ μὴ θερίσῃς αὐτὰ ἑπταπλασίως

text_en: Seek not of the Lord a preeminence, nor of the king the seat of honour .
text_la: Noli quærere a Domino ducatum, neque a rege cathedram honoris.
text_pt: Todos eles são adúlteros; são semelhantes ao forno aceso pelo padeiro, que cessa de mexer nas brasas, depois que amassou a massa, até que seja levedada.
text_el: μὴ ζήτει παρὰ κυρίου ἡγεμονίαν μηδὲ παρὰ βασιλέως καθέδραν δόξης

text_en: Justify not yourself before God , for he knows the heart: and desire not to appear wise before the king.
text_la: Non te justifices ante Deum, quoniam agnitor cordis ipse est : et penes regem noli velle videri sapiens.
text_pt: E no dia do nosso rei os príncipes se tornaram doentes com frascos de vinho; ele estendeu a sua mão com os escarnecedores.
text_el: μὴ δικαιοῦ ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ παρὰ βασιλεῖ μὴ σοφίζου

text_en: Seek not to be made a judge, unless you have strength enough to extirpate iniquities : lest you fear the person of the powerful, and lay a stumbling block for your integrity.
text_la: Noli quærere fieri judex, nisi valeas virtute irrumpere iniquitates : ne forte extimescas faciem potentis, et ponas scandalum in æquitate tua.
text_pt: Porque, prepararam o coração como um forno, na sua emboscada; toda a noite dorme o seu padeiro, pela manhã arde como fogo de chama.
text_el: μὴ ζήτει γενέσθαι κριτής μὴ οὐκ ἰσχύσεις ἐξᾶραι ἀδικίας μήποτε εὐλαβηθῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου δυνάστου καὶ θήσεις σκάνδαλον ἐν εὐθύτητί σου

text_en: Offend not against the multitude of a city, neither cast yourself in upon the people,
text_la: Non pecces in multitudinem civitatis, nec te immittas in populum :
text_pt: Todos eles estão quentes como um forno, e consomem os seus juízes; todos os seus reis caem, ninguém entre eles há que me invoque.
text_el: μὴ ἁμάρτανε εἰς πλῆθος πόλεως καὶ μὴ καταβάλῃς σεαυτὸν ἐν ὄχλῳ

text_en: nor bind sin to sin : for even in one you shall not be unpunished.
text_la: neque alliges duplicia peccata, nec enim in uno eris immunis.
text_pt: Efraim se mistura com os povos; Efraim é um bolo que não foi virado.
text_el: μὴ καταδεσμεύσῃς δὶς ἁμαρτίαν ἐν γὰρ τῇ μιᾷ οὐκ ἀθῷος ἔσῃ

text_en: Be not fainthearted in your mind:
text_la: Noli esse pusillanimis in animo tuo :
text_pt: Estrangeiros lhe comeram a força, e ele não o sabe; também as cãs se espalharam sobre ele, e não o sabe.
text_el: μὴ ὀλιγοψυχήσῃς ἐν τῇ προσευχῇ σου

text_en: Neglect not to pray , and to give alms .
text_la: exorare et facere eleemosynam ne despicias.
text_pt: E a soberba de Israel testificará diante dele; todavia não voltarão para o Senhor seu Deus, nem o buscarão em tudo isto.
text_el: καὶ ἐλεημοσύνην ποιῆσαι μὴ παρίδῃς

text_en: Say not: God will have respect to the multitude of my gifts, and when I offer to the most high God , he will accept my offerings .
text_la: Ne dicas : In multitudine munerum meorum respiciet Deus, et offerente me Deo altissimo, munera mea suscipiet.
text_pt: Porque Efraim é como uma pomba ingênua, sem entendimento; invocam o Egito, vão para a Assíria.
text_el: μὴ εἴπῃς τῷ πλήθει τῶν δώρων μου ἐπόψεται καὶ ἐν τῷ προσενέγκαι με θεῷ ὑψίστῳ προσδέξεται

text_en: Laugh no man to scorn in the bitterness of his soul : for there is one that humbles and exalts, God who sees all.
text_la: Non irrideas hominem in amaritudine animæ : est enim qui humiliat et exaltat circumspector Deus.
text_pt: Quando forem, sobre eles estenderei a minha rede, e como aves do céu os farei descer; castigá-los-ei, conforme o que eles têm ouvido na sua congregação.
text_el: μὴ καταγέλα ἄνθρωπον ὄντα ἐν πικρίᾳ ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ἔστιν γὰρ ὁ ταπεινῶν καὶ ἀνυψῶν

text_en: Devise not a lie against your brother: neither do the like against your friend.
text_la: Noli amare mendacium adversus fratrem tuum, neque in amicum similiter facias.
text_pt: Ai deles, porque fugiram de mim; destruição sobre eles, porque se rebelaram contra mim; eu os remi, mas disseram mentiras contra mim.
text_el: μὴ ἀροτρία ψεῦδος ἐπ' ἀδελφῷ σου μηδὲ φίλῳ τὸ ὅμοιον ποίει

text_en: Be not willing to make any manner of lie: for the custom thereof is not good .
text_la: Noli velle mentiri omne mendacium : assiduitas enim illius non est bona.
text_pt: E não clamaram a mim com seu coração, mas davam uivos nas suas camas; para o trigo e para o vinho se ajuntam, mas contra mim se rebelam.
text_el: μὴ θέλε ψεύδεσθαι πᾶν ψεῦδος ὁ γὰρ ἐνδελεχισμὸς αὐτοῦ οὐκ εἰς ἀγαθόν

text_en: Be not full of words in a multitude of ancients, and repeat not the word in your prayer .
text_la: Noli verbosus esse in multitudine presbyterorum, et non iteres verbum in oratione tua.
text_pt: Eu os corrigi, e lhes esforcei os braços, mas pensam mal contra mim.
text_el: μὴ ἀδολέσχει ἐν πλήθει πρεσβυτέρων καὶ μὴ δευτερώσῃς λόγον ἐν προσευχῇ σου

text_en: Hate not laborious works, nor husbandry ordained by the most High .
text_la: Non oderis laboriosa opera, et rusticationem creatam ab Altissimo.
text_pt: Eles voltaram, mas não para o Altíssimo. Fizeram-se como um arco enganador; caem à espada os seus príncipes, por causa do furor da sua língua; este será o seu escárnio na terra do Egito.
text_el: μὴ μισήσῃς ἐπίπονον ἐργασίαν καὶ γεωργίαν ὑπὸ ὑψίστου ἐκτισμένην

text_en: Number not yourself among the multitude of the disorderly.
text_la: Non te reputes in multitudine indisciplinatorum.
text_el: μὴ προσλογίζου σεαυτὸν ἐν πλήθει

text_en: Remember wrath , for it will not tarry long.
text_la: Memento iræ, quoniam non tardabit.
text_el: ταπείνωσον σφόδρα τὴν ψυχήν σου

text_en: Humble your spirit very much: for the vengeance on the flesh of the ungodly is fire and worms.
text_la: Humilia valde spiritum tuum, quoniam vindicta carnis impii ignis et vermis.
text_el: ἁμαρτωλῶν μνήσθητι ὅτι ὀργὴ οὐ χρονιεῖ

text_en: Do not transgress against your friend deferring money, nor despise your dear brother for the sake of gold.
text_la: Noli prævaricari in amicum pecuniam differentem, neque fratrem carissimum auro spreveris.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκδίκησις ἀσεβοῦς πῦρ καὶ σκώληξ μὴ ἀλλάξῃς φίλον ἕνεκεν διαφόρου μηδὲ ἀδελφὸν γνήσιον ἐν χρυσίῳ Σουφιρ

text_en: Depart not from a wise and good wife, whom you have gotten in the fear of the Lord : for the grace of her modesty is above gold.
text_la: Noli discedere a muliere sensata et bona, quam sortitus es in timore Domini : gratia enim verecundiæ illius super aurum.
text_el: μὴ ἀστόχει γυναικὸς σοφῆς καὶ ἀγαθῆς ἡ γὰρ χάρις αὐτῆς ὑπὲρ τὸ χρυσίον

text_en: Hurt not the servant that works faithfully, nor the hired man that gives you his life.
text_la: Non lædas servum in veritate operantem, neque mercenarium dantem animam suam.
text_el: μὴ κακώσῃς οἰκέτην ἐργαζόμενον ἐν ἀληθείᾳ μηδὲ μίσθιον διδόντα τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let a wise servant be dear to you as your own soul , defraud him not of liberty, nor leave him needy.
text_la: Servus sensatus sit tibi dilectus quasi anima tua : non defraudes illum libertate, neque inopem derelinquas illum.
text_el: οἰκέτην συνετὸν ἀγαπάτω σου ἡ ψυχή μὴ στερήσῃς αὐτὸν ἐλευθερίας

text_en: Have you cattle? Have an eye to them: and if they be for your profit, keep them with you.
text_la: Pecora tibi sunt, attende illis : et si sunt utilia, perseverent apud te.
text_el: κτήνη σοί ἐστιν ἐπισκέπτου αὐτά καὶ εἰ ἔστιν σοι χρήσιμα ἐμμενέτω σοι

text_en: Have you children? Instruct them, and bow down their neck from their childhood.
text_la: Filii tibi sunt? erudi illos, et curva illos a pueritia illorum.
text_el: τέκνα σοί ἐστιν παίδευσον αὐτὰ καὶ κάμψον ἐκ νεότητος τὸν τράχηλον αὐτῶν

text_en: Have you daughters? Have a care of their body, and show not your countenance gay towards them.
text_la: Filiæ tibi sunt? serva corpus illarum, et non ostendas hilarem faciem tuam ad illas.
text_el: θυγατέρες σοί εἰσιν πρόσεχε τῷ σώματι αὐτῶν καὶ μὴ ἱλαρώσῃς πρὸς αὐτὰς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου

text_en: Marry your daughter well, and you shall do a great work, and give her to a wise man .
text_la: Trade filiam, et grande opus feceris : et homini sensato da illam.
text_el: ἔκδου θυγατέρα καὶ ἔσῃ τετελεκὼς ἔργον μέγα καὶ ἀνδρὶ συνετῷ δώρησαι αὐτήν

text_en: If you have a wife according to your soul , cast her not off: and to her that is hateful , trust not yourself. With your whole heart,
text_la: Mulier si est tibi secundum animam tuam, non projicias illam : et odibili non credas te. In toto corde tuo
text_el: γυνή σοί ἐστιν κατὰ ψυχήν μὴ ἐκβάλῃς αὐτήν καὶ μισουμένῃ μὴ ἐμπιστεύσῃς σεαυτόν

text_en: honour your father, and forget not the groanings of your mother:
text_la: honora patrem tuum, et gemitus matris tuæ ne obliviscaris :
text_el: ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ σου δόξασον τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ μητρὸς ὠδῖνας μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ

text_en: Remember that you had not been born but through them: and make a return to them as they have done for you.
text_la: memento quoniam nisi per illos natus non fuisses : et retribue illis, quomodo et illi tibi.
text_el: μνήσθητι ὅτι δι' αὐτῶν ἐγεννήθης καὶ τί ἀνταποδώσεις αὐτοῖς καθὼς αὐτοὶ σοί

text_en: With all your soul fear the Lord , and reverence his priests .
text_la: In tota anima tua time Dominum, et sacerdotes illius sanctifica.
text_el: ἐν ὅλῃ ψυχῇ σου εὐλαβοῦ τὸν κύριον καὶ τοὺς ἱερεῖς αὐτοῦ θαύμαζε

text_en: With all your strength love him that made you: and forsake not his ministers .
text_la: In omni virtute tua dilige eum qui te fecit, et ministros ejus ne derelinquas.
text_el: ἐν ὅλῃ δυνάμει ἀγάπησον τὸν ποιήσαντά σε καὶ τοὺς λειτουργοὺς αὐτοῦ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς

text_en: Honour God with all your soul and give honour to the priests , and purify yourself with your arms.
text_la: Honora Deum ex tota anima tua, et honorifica sacerdotes, et propurga te cum brachiis.
text_el: φοβοῦ τὸν κύριον

text_en: Give them their portion, as it is commanded you, of the firstfruits and of purifications: and for your negligences purify yourself with a few.
text_la: Da illis partem, sicut mandatum est tibi, primitiarum et purgationis, et de negligentia tua purga te cum paucis.
text_el: καὶ δόξασον ἱερέα καὶ δὸς τὴν μερίδα αὐτῷ καθὼς ἐντέταλταί σοι ἀπαρχὴν καὶ περὶ πλημμελείας

text_en: Offer to the Lord the gift of your shoulders, and the sacrifice of sanctification , and the firstfruits of the holy things:
text_la: Datum brachiorum tuorum, et sacrificium sanctificationis offeres Domino, et initia sanctorum.
text_el: καὶ δόσιν βραχιόνων καὶ θυσίαν ἁγιασμοῦ καὶ ἀπαρχὴν ἁγίων

text_en: And stretch out your hand to the poor, that your expiation and your blessing may be perfected.
text_la: Et pauperi porrige manum tuam, ut perficiatur propitiatio et benedictio tua.
text_el: καὶ πτωχῷ ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρά σου ἵνα τελειωθῇ ἡ εὐλογία σου

text_en: A gift has grace in the sight of all the living, and restrain not grace from the dead.
text_la: Gratia dati in conspectu omnis viventis, et mortuo non prohibeas gratiam.
text_el: χάρις δόματος ἔναντι παντὸς ζῶντος καὶ ἐπὶ νεκρῷ μὴ ἀποκωλύσῃς χάριν

text_en: Be not wanting in comforting them that weep, and walk with them that mourn.
text_la: Non desis plorantibus in consolatione, et cum lugentibus ambula.
text_el: μὴ ὑστέρει ἀπὸ κλαιόντων καὶ μετὰ πενθούντων πένθησον

text_en: Be not slow to visit the sick: for by these things you shall be confirmed in love .
text_la: Non te pigeat visitare infirmum : ex his enim in dilectione firmaberis.
text_el: μὴ ὄκνει ἐπισκέπτεσθαι ἄρρωστον ἄνθρωπον ἐκ γὰρ τῶν τοιούτων ἀγαπηθήσῃ

text_en: In all your works remember your last end, and you shall never sin .
text_la: In omnibus operibus tuis memorare novissima tua, et in æternum non peccabis.
text_el: ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς λόγοις σου μιμνῄσκου τὰ ἔσχατά σου καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα οὐχ ἁμαρτήσεις

text_en: Strive not with a powerful man , lest you fall into his hands.
text_la: Non litiges cum homine potente, ne forte incidas in manus illius.
text_pt: Põe a trombeta à tua boca. Ele virá como a águia contra a casa do SENHOR, porque transgrediram a minha aliança, e se rebelaram contra a minha lei.
text_el: μὴ διαμάχου μετὰ ἀνθρώπου δυνάστου μήποτε ἐμπέσῃς εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ

text_en: Contend not with a rich man , lest he bring an action against you.
text_la: Non contendas cum viro locuplete, ne forte contra te constituat litem tibi :
text_pt: E a mim clamarão: Deus meu! Nós, Israel, te conhecemos.
text_el: μὴ ἔριζε μετὰ ἀνθρώπου πλουσίου μήποτε ἀντιστήσῃ σου τὴν ὁλκήν

text_en: For gold and silver has destroyed many, and has reached even to the heart of kings, and perverted them.
text_la: multos enim perdidit aurum et argentum, et usque ad cor regum extendit et convertit.
text_pt: Israel rejeitou o bem; o inimigo persegui-lo-á.
text_el: πολλοὺς γὰρ ἀπώλεσεν τὸ χρυσίον καὶ καρδίας βασιλέων ἐξέκλινεν

text_en: Strive not with a man that is full of tongue, and heap not wood upon his fire.
text_la: Non litiges cum homine linguato, et non strues in ignem illius ligna.
text_pt: Eles fizeram reis, mas não por mim; constituíram príncipes, mas eu não o soube; da sua prata e do seu ouro fizeram ídolos para si, para serem destruídos.
text_el: μὴ διαμάχου μετὰ ἀνθρώπου γλωσσώδους καὶ μὴ ἐπιστοιβάσῃς ἐπὶ τὸ πῦρ αὐτοῦ ξύλα

text_en: Communicate not with an ignorant man , lest he speak ill of your family .
text_la: Non communices homini indocto, ne male de progenie tua loquatur.
text_pt: O teu bezerro, ó Samaria, te rejeitou; a minha ira se acendeu contra eles; até quando serão eles incapazes da inocência?
text_el: μὴ πρόσπαιζε ἀπαιδεύτῳ ἵνα μὴ ἀτιμάζωνται οἱ πρόγονοί σου

text_en: Despise not a man that turns away from sin , nor reproach him therewith: remember that we are all worthy of reproof.
text_la: Ne despicias hominem avertentem se a peccato, neque improperes ei : memento quoniam omnes in correptione sumus.
text_pt: Porque isso vem de Israel, um artífice o fez, e não é Deus; mas em pedaços será desfeito o bezerro de Samaria.
text_el: μὴ ὀνείδιζε ἄνθρωπον ἀποστρέφοντα ἀπὸ ἁμαρτίας μνήσθητι ὅτι πάντες ἐσμὲν ἐν ἐπιτίμοις

text_en: Despise not a man in his old age; for we also shall become old.
text_la: Ne spernas hominem in sua senectute, etenim ex nobis senescunt.
text_pt: Porque semearam vento, e segarão tormenta, não haverá seara, a erva não dará farinha; se a der, tragá-la-ão os estrangeiros.
text_el: μὴ ἀτιμάσῃς ἄνθρωπον ἐν γήρᾳ αὐτοῦ καὶ γὰρ ἐξ ἡμῶν γηράσκουσιν

text_en: Rejoice not at the death of your enemy; knowing that we all die, and are not willing that others should rejoice at our death.
text_la: Noli de mortuo inimico tuo gaudere : sciens quoniam omnes morimur, et in gaudium nolumus venire.
text_pt: Israel foi devorado; agora está entre os gentios como um vaso em que ninguém tem prazer.
text_el: μὴ ἐπίχαιρε ἐπὶ νεκρῷ μνήσθητι ὅτι πάντες τελευτῶμεν

text_en: Despise not the discourse of them that are ancient and wise, but acquaint yourself with their proverbs.
text_la: Ne despicias narrationem presbyterorum sapientium, et in proverbiis eorum conversare :
text_pt: Porque subiram à Assíria, como um jumento montês, por si só; Efraim mercou amores.
text_el: μὴ παρίδῃς διήγημα σοφῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς παροιμίαις αὐτῶν ἀναστρέφου

text_en: For of them you shall learn wisdom, and instruction of understanding, and to serve great men without blame.
text_la: ab ipsis enim disces sapientiam et doctrinam intellectus, et servire magnatis sine querela.
text_pt: Todavia, ainda que eles merquem entre as nações, eu os congregarei; e serão um pouco afligidos por causa da carga do rei dos príncipes.
