text_el: ὅτι παρ' αὐτῶν μαθήσῃ παιδείαν καὶ λειτουργῆσαι μεγιστᾶσιν

text_en: Let not the discourse of the ancients escape you, for they have learned of their fathers:
text_la: Non te prætereat narratio seniorum, ipsi enim didicerunt a patribus suis :
text_pt: Porquanto Efraim multiplicou os altares para pecar; teve altares para pecar.
text_el: μὴ ἀστόχει διηγήματος γερόντων καὶ γὰρ αὐτοὶ ἔμαθον παρὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν

text_en: For of them you shall learn understanding, and to give an answer in time of need.
text_la: quoniam ab ipsis disces intellectum, et in tempore necessitatis dare responsum.
text_pt: Escrevi-lhe as grandezas da minha lei, porém essas são estimadas como coisa estranha.
text_el: ὅτι παρ' αὐτῶν μαθήσῃ σύνεσιν καὶ ἐν καιρῷ χρείας δοῦναι ἀπόκρισιν

text_en: Kindle not the coals of sinners by rebuking them, lest you be burnt with the flame of the fire of their sins .
text_la: Non incendas carbones peccatorum arguens eos, et ne incendaris flamma ignis peccatorum illorum.
text_pt: Quanto aos sacrifícios das minhas ofertas, sacrificam carne, e a comem, mas o Senhor não as aceita; agora se lembrará da sua iniqüidade, e punirá os seus pecados; eles voltarão para o Egito.
text_el: μὴ ἔκκαιε ἄνθρακας ἁμαρτωλοῦ μὴ ἐμπυρισθῇς ἐν πυρὶ φλογὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Stand not against the face of an injurious person, lest he sit as a spy to entrap you in your words.
text_la: Ne contra faciem stes contumeliosi, ne sedeat quasi insidiator ori tuo.
text_pt: Porque Israel se esqueceu do seu Criador, e edificou templos, e Judá multiplicou cidades fortificadas. Mas eu enviarei um fogo contra as suas cidades, que consumirá os seus palácios.
text_el: μὴ ἐξαναστῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑβριστοῦ ἵνα μὴ ἐγκαθίσῃ ὡς ἔνεδρον τῷ στόματί σου

text_en: Lend not to a man that is mightier than yourself: and if you lend, count it as lost.
text_la: Noli fœnerari homini fortiori te : quod si fœneraveris, quasi perditum habe.
text_el: μὴ δανείσῃς ἀνθρώπῳ ἰσχυροτέρῳ σου καὶ ἐὰν δανείσῃς ὡς ἀπολωλεκὼς γίνου

text_en: Be not surety above your power: and if you be surety, think as if you were to pay it.
text_la: Non spondeas super virtutem tuam : quod si spoponderis, quasi restituens cogita.
text_el: μὴ ἐγγυήσῃ ὑπὲρ δύναμίν σου καὶ ἐὰν ἐγγυήσῃ ὡς ἀποτείσων φρόντιζε

text_en: Judge not against a judge: for he judges according to that which is just .
text_la: Non judices contra judicem, quoniam secundum quod justum est judicat.
text_el: μὴ δικάζου μετὰ κριτοῦ κατὰ γὰρ τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ κρινοῦσιν αὐτῷ

text_en: Go not on the way with a bold man , lest he burden you with his evils : for he goes according to his own will, and you shall perish together with his folly.
text_la: Cum audace non eas in via, ne forte gravet mala sua in te : ipse enim secundum voluntatem suam vadit, et simul cum stultitia illius peries.
text_el: μετὰ τολμηροῦ μὴ πορεύου ἐν ὁδῷ ἵνα μὴ βαρύνηται κατὰ σοῦ αὐτὸς γὰρ κατὰ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιήσει καὶ τῇ ἀφροσύνῃ αὐτοῦ συναπολῇ

text_en: Quarrel not with a passionate man , and go not into the desert with a bold man : for blood is as nothing in his sight, and where there is no help he will overthrow you.
text_la: Cum iracundo non facias rixam, et cum audace non eas in desertum : quoniam quasi nihil est ante illum sanguis, et ubi non est adjutorium, elidet te.
text_el: μετὰ θυμώδους μὴ ποιήσῃς μάχην καὶ μὴ διαπορεύου μετ' αὐτοῦ τὴν ἔρημον ὅτι ὡς οὐδὲν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ αἷμα καὶ ὅπου οὐκ ἔστιν βοήθεια καταβαλεῖ σε

text_en: Advise not with fools, for they cannot love but such things as please them.
text_la: Cum fatuis consilium non habeas : non enim poterunt diligere nisi quæ eis placent.
text_el: μετὰ μωροῦ μὴ συμβουλεύου οὐ γὰρ δυνήσεται λόγον στέξαι

text_en: Before a stranger do no matter of counsel: for you know not what he will bring forth.
text_la: Coram extraneo ne facias consilium : nescis enim quid pariet.
text_el: ἐνώπιον ἀλλοτρίου μὴ ποιήσῃς κρυπτόν οὐ γὰρ γινώσκεις τί τέξεται

text_en: Open not your heart to every man : lest he repay you with an evil turn, and speak reproachfully to you.
text_la: Non omni homini cor tuum manifestes, ne forte inferat tibi gratiam falsam, et convicietur tibi.
text_el: παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ μὴ ἔκφαινε σὴν καρδίαν καὶ μὴ ἀναφερέτω σοι χάριν

text_en: Be not jealous over the wife of your bosom, lest she show in your regard the malice of a wicked lesson.
text_la: Non zeles mulierem sinus tui, ne ostendat super te malitiam doctrinæ nequam.
text_pt: Não te alegres, ó Israel, não exultes, como os povos; porque ao prostituir-te abandonaste o teu Deus; amaste a paga de meretriz sobre todas as eiras de trigo.
text_el: μὴ ζήλου γυναῖκα τοῦ κόλπου σου μηδὲ διδάξῃς ἐπὶ σεαυτὸν παιδείαν πονηράν

text_en: Give not the power of your soul to a woman , lest she enter upon your strength, and you be confounded.
text_la: Non des mulieri potestatem animæ tuæ, ne ingrediatur in virtutem tuam, et confundaris.
text_pt: A eira e o lagar não os manterão; e o mosto lhes faltará.
text_el: μὴ δῷς γυναικὶ τὴν ψυχήν σου ἐπιβῆναι αὐτὴν ἐπὶ τὴν ἰσχύν σου

text_en: Look not upon a woman that has a mind for many: lest you fall into her snares.
text_la: Ne respicias mulierem multivolam, ne forte incidas in laqueos illius.
text_pt: Na terra do Senhor não permanecerão; mas Efraim tornará ao Egito, e na Assíria comerão comida imunda.
text_el: μὴ ὑπάντα γυναικὶ ἑταιριζομένῃ μήποτε ἐμπέσῃς εἰς τὰς παγίδας αὐτῆς

text_en: Use not much the company of her that is a dancer , and hearken not to her, lest you perish by the force of her charms.
text_la: Cum saltatrice ne assiduus sis, nec audias illam, ne forte pereas in efficacia illius.
text_pt: Não derramarão libações de vinho ao Senhor, nem lhe agradarão as suas ofertas. Os seus sacrifícios lhes serão como pão de pranteadores; todos os que dele comerem serão imundos, porque o seu pão será somente para si mesmos; não entrará na casa do Senhor.
text_el: μετὰ ψαλλούσης μὴ ἐνδελέχιζε μήποτε ἁλῷς ἐν τοῖς ἐπιχειρήμασιν αὐτῆς

text_en: Gaze not upon a maiden, lest her beauty be a stumbling block to you.
text_la: Virginem ne conspicias, ne forte scandalizeris in decore illius.
text_pt: Que fareis vós no dia da solenidade, e no dia da festa do Senhor?
text_el: παρθένον μὴ καταμάνθανε μήποτε σκανδαλισθῇς ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτιμίοις αὐτῆς

text_en: Give not your soul to harlots in any point: lest you destroy yourself and your inheritance.
text_la: Ne des fornicariis animam tuam in ullo, ne perdas te et hæreditatem tuam.
text_pt: Porque, eis que eles se foram por causa da destruição, mas o Egito os recolherá, Mênfis os sepultará; o desejável da sua prata as urtigas o possuirão por herança, espinhos crescerão nas suas tendas.
text_el: μὴ δῷς πόρναις τὴν ψυχήν σου ἵνα μὴ ἀπολέσῃς τὴν κληρονομίαν σου

text_en: Look not round about you in the ways of the city, nor wander up and down in the streets thereof.
text_la: Noli circumspicere in vicis civitatis, nec oberraveris in plateis illius.
text_pt: Chegarão os dias da punição, chegarão os dias da retribuição; Israel o saberá; o profeta é um insensato, o homem de espírito é um louco; por causa da abundância da tua iniqüidade também haverá grande ódio.
text_el: μὴ περιβλέπου ἐν ῥύμαις πόλεως καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἐρήμοις αὐτῆς μὴ πλανῶ

text_en: Turn away your face from a woman dressed up, and gaze not about upon another's beauty.
text_la: Averte faciem tuam a muliere compta, et ne circumspicias speciem alienam.
text_pt: Efraim era o vigia com o meu Deus, mas o profeta é como um laço de caçador de aves em todos os seus caminhos, e ódio na casa do seu Deus.
text_el: ἀπόστρεψον ὀφθαλμὸν ἀπὸ γυναικὸς εὐμόρφου καὶ μὴ καταμάνθανε κάλλος ἀλλότριον

text_en: For many have perished by the beauty of a woman , and hereby lust is enkindled as a fire.
text_la: Propter speciem mulieris multi perierunt : et ex hoc concupiscentia quasi ignis exardescit.
text_pt: Muito profundamente se corromperam, como nos dias de Gibeá; ele lembrar-se-á das suas injustiças, visitará os pecados deles.
text_el: ἐν κάλλει γυναικὸς πολλοὶ ἐπλανήθησαν καὶ ἐκ τούτου φιλία ὡς πῦρ ἀνακαίεται

text_en: Every woman that is a harlot, shall be trodden upon as dung in the way.
text_la: Omnis mulier quæ est fornicaria, quasi stercus in via conculcabitur.
text_pt: Achei a Israel como uvas no deserto, vi a vossos pais como a fruta temporã da figueira no seu princípio; mas eles foram para Baal-Peor, e se consagraram a essa vergonha, e se tornaram abomináveis como aquilo que amaram.

text_en: Many by admiring the beauty of another man's wife, have become reprobate, for her conversation burns as fire.
text_la: Speciem mulieris alienæ multi admirati, reprobi facti sunt : colloquium enim illius quasi ignis exardescit.
text_pt: Quanto a Efraim, a sua glória como ave voará, não haverá nascimento, não haverá gestação nem concepção.

text_en: Sit not at all with another man's wife, nor repose upon the bed with her:
text_la: Cum aliena muliere ne sedeas omnino, nec accumbas cum ea super cubitum :
text_pt: Ainda que venham a criar seus filhos, contudo os privarei deles para que não fique nenhum homem. Ai deles, quando deles eu me apartar!
text_el: μετὰ ὑπάνδρου γυναικὸς μὴ κάθου τὸ σύνολον

text_en: And strive not with her over wine, lest your heart decline towards her and by your blood you fall into destruction.
text_la: et non alterceris cum illa in vino, ne forte declinet cor tuum in illam, et sanguine tuo labaris in perditionem.
text_pt: Efraim, assim como vi a Tiro, está plantado num lugar aprazível; mas Efraim levará os seus filhos ao matador.
text_el: καὶ μὴ συμβολοκοπήσῃς μετ' αὐτῆς ἐν οἴνῳ μήποτε ἐκκλίνῃ ἡ ψυχή σου ἐπ' αὐτὴν καὶ τῷ πνεύματί σου ὀλίσθῃς εἰς ἀπώλειαν

text_en: Forsake not an old friend, for the new will not be like to him.
text_la: Ne derelinquas amicum antiquum : novus enim non erit similis illi.
text_pt: Dá-lhes, ó Senhor; mas que lhes darás? Dá-lhes uma madre que aborte e seios secos.
text_el: μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς φίλον ἀρχαῖον ὁ γὰρ πρόσφατος οὐκ ἔστιν ἔφισος αὐτῷ

text_en: A new friend is as new wine: it shall grow old, and you shall drink it with pleasure.
text_la: Vinum novum amicus novus : veterascet, et cum suavitate bibes illud.
text_pt: Toda a sua malícia se acha em Gilgal, porque ali os odiei; por causa da maldade das suas obras lançá-los-ei para fora de minha casa. Não os amarei mais; todos os seus príncipes são rebeldes.
text_el: οἶνος νέος φίλος νέος ἐὰν παλαιωθῇ μετ' εὐφροσύνης πίεσαι αὐτόν

text_en: Envy not the glory and riches of a sinner: for you know not what his ruin shall be.
text_la: Non zeles gloriam et opes peccatoris : non enim scis quæ futura sit illius subversio.
text_pt: Efraim foi ferido, secou-se a sua raiz; não darão fruto; sim, ainda que gerem, matarei os frutos desejáveis do seu ventre.
text_el: μὴ ζηλώσῃς δόξαν ἁμαρτωλοῦ οὐ γὰρ οἶδας τί ἔσται ἡ καταστροφὴ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Be not pleased with the wrong done by the unjust , knowing that even to hell the wicked shall not please.
text_la: Non placeat tibi injuria injustorum, sciens quoniam usque ad inferos non placebit impius.
text_pt: O meu Deus os rejeitará, porque não o ouviram, e errantes andarão entre as nações.
text_el: μὴ εὐδοκήσῃς ἐν εὐδοκίᾳ ἀσεβῶν μνήσθητι ὅτι ἕως ᾅδου οὐ μὴ δικαιωθῶσιν

text_en: Keep you far from the man that has power to kill, so you shall not suspect the fear of death.
text_la: Longe abesto ab homine potestatem habente occidendi, et non suspicaberis timorem mortis.
text_el: μακρὰν ἄπεχε ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ὃς ἔχει ἐξουσίαν τοῦ φονεύειν καὶ οὐ μὴ ὑποπτεύσῃς φόβον θανάτου

text_en: And if you come to him, commit no fault, lest he take away your life.
text_la: Et si accesseris ad illum, noli aliquid committere, ne forte auferat vitam tuam.
text_el: κἂν προσέλθῃς μὴ πλημμελήσῃς ἵνα μὴ ἀφέληται τὴν ζωήν σου

text_en: Know it to be a communication with death: for you are going in the midst of snares, and walking upon the arms of them that are grieved.
text_la: Communionem mortis scito, quoniam in medio laqueorum ingredieris, et super dolentium arma ambulabis.
text_el: ἐπίγνωθι ὅτι ἐν μέσῳ παγίδων διαβαίνεις καὶ ἐπὶ ἐπάλξεων πόλεως περιπατεῖς

text_en: According to your power beware of your neighbour, and treat with the wise and prudent .
text_la: Secundum virtutem tuam cave te a proximo tuo, et cum sapientibus et prudentibus tracta.
text_el: κατὰ τὴν ἰσχύν σου στόχασαι τοὺς πλησίον καὶ μετὰ σοφῶν συμβουλεύου

text_en: Let just men be your guests, and let your glory be in the fear of God .
text_la: Viri justi sint tibi convivæ, et in timore Dei sit tibi gloriatio :
text_el: μετὰ συνετῶν ἔστω ὁ διαλογισμός σου καὶ πᾶσα διήγησίς σου ἐν νόμῳ ὑψίστου

text_en: And let the thought of God be in your mind, and all your discourse on the commandments of the Highest.
text_la: et in sensu sit tibi cogitatus Dei, et omnis enarratio tua in præceptis Altissimi.
text_el: ἄνδρες δίκαιοι ἔστωσαν σύνδειπνοί σου καὶ ἐν φόβῳ κυρίου ἔστω τὸ καύχημά σου

text_en: Works shall be praised for the hand of the artificers, and the prince of the people for the wisdom of his speech, but the word of the ancients for the sense.
text_la: In manu artificum opera laudabuntur, et princeps populi in sapientia sermonis sui, in sensu vero seniorum verbum.
text_el: ἐν χειρὶ τεχνιτῶν ἔργον ἐπαινεσθήσεται καὶ ὁ ἡγούμενος λαοῦ σοφὸς ἐν λόγῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: A man full of tongue is terrible in his city, and he that is rash in his word shall be hateful .
text_la: Terribilis est in civitate sua homo linguosus : et temerarius in verbo suo odibilis erit.
text_el: φοβερὸς ἐν πόλει αὐτοῦ ἀνὴρ γλωσσώδης καὶ ὁ προπετὴς ἐν λόγῳ αὐτοῦ μισηθήσεται

text_en: A wise judge shall judge his people, and the government of a prudent man shall be steady.
text_la: Judex sapiens judicabit populum suum, et principatus sensati stabilis erit.
text_pt: Israel é uma vide estéril que dá fruto para si mesmo; conforme a abundância do seu fruto, multiplicou também os altares; conforme a bondade da sua terra, assim, fizeram boas as estátuas.
text_el: κριτὴς σοφὸς παιδεύσει τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡγεμονία συνετοῦ τεταγμένη ἔσται

text_en: As the judge of the people is himself, so also are his ministers : and what manner of man the ruler of a city is, such also are they that dwell therein.
text_la: Secundum judicem populi, sic et ministri ejus : et qualis rector est civitatis, tales et inhabitantes in ea.
text_pt: O seu coração está dividido, por isso serão culpados; o Senhor demolirá os seus altares, e destruirá as suas estátuas.
text_el: κατὰ τὸν κριτὴν τοῦ λαοῦ οὕτως καὶ οἱ λειτουργοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ κατὰ τὸν ἡγούμενον τῆς πόλεως πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες αὐτήν

text_en: An unwise king shall be the ruin of his people: and cities shall be inhabited through the prudence of the rulers.
text_la: Rex insipiens perdet populum suum : et civitates inhabitabuntur per sensum potentium.
text_pt: Certamente agora dirão: Não temos rei, porque não tememos ao Senhor; e o rei, que faria por nós?
text_el: βασιλεὺς ἀπαίδευτος ἀπολεῖ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ πόλις οἰκισθήσεται ἐν συνέσει δυναστῶν

text_en: The power of the earth is in the hand of God , and in his time he will raise up a profitable ruler over it.
text_la: In manu Dei potestas terræ : et utilem rectorem suscitabit in tempus super illam.
text_pt: Falaram palavras, jurando falsamente, fazendo uma aliança; por isso florescerá o juízo como erva peçonhenta nos sulcos dos campos.
text_el: ἐν χειρὶ κυρίου ἡ ἐξουσία τῆς γῆς καὶ τὸν χρήσιμον ἐγερεῖ εἰς καιρὸν ἐπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: The prosperity of man is in the hand of God , and upon the person of the scribe he shall lay his honour .
text_la: In manu Dei prosperitas hominis, et super faciem scribæ imponet honorem suum.
text_pt: Os moradores de Samaria serão atemorizados pelo bezerro de Bete-«ven; porque o seu povo se lamentará por causa dele, como também os seus sacerdotes idólatras que nele se regozijavam, por causa da sua glória, que se apartou dela.
text_el: ἐν χειρὶ κυρίου εὐοδία ἀνδρός καὶ προσώπῳ γραμματέως ἐπιθήσει δόξαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Remember not any injury done you by your neighbour, and do nothing by deeds of injury.
text_la: Omnis injuriæ proximi ne memineris, et nihil agas in operibus injuriæ.
text_pt: Também será levada para a Assíria como um presente ao rei Jarebe; Efraim ficará confuso, e Israel se envergonhará por causa do seu próprio conselho.
text_el: ἐπὶ παντὶ ἀδικήματι μὴ μηνιάσῃς τῷ πλησίον καὶ μὴ πρᾶσσε μηδὲν ἐν ἔργοις ὕβρεως

text_en: Pride is hateful before God and men : and all iniquity of nations is execrable.
text_la: Odibilis coram Deo est et hominibus superbia, et execrabilis omnis iniquitas gentium.
text_pt: O rei de Samaria será desfeito como a espuma sobre a face da água.
text_el: μισητὴ ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ ἀνθρώπων ὑπερηφανία καὶ ἐξ ἀμφοτέρων πλημμελὴς ἡ ἀδικία

text_en: A kingdom is translated from one people to another, because of injustices , and wrongs, and injuries, and divers deceits.
text_la: Regnum a gente in gentem transfertur propter injustitias, et injurias, et contumelias, et diversos dolos.
text_pt: E os altos de Áven, pecado de Israel, serão destruídos; espinhos e cardos crescerão sobre os seus altares; e dirão aos montes: Cobri-nos! E aos outeiros: Caí sobre nós!
text_el: βασιλεία ἀπὸ ἔθνους εἰς ἔθνος μετάγεται διὰ ἀδικίας καὶ ὕβρεις καὶ χρήματα

text_en: But nothing is more wicked than the covetous man . Why is earth, and ashes proud ?
text_la: Avaro autem nihil est scelestius. Quid superbit terra et cinis?
text_pt: Desde os dias de Gibeá pecaste, ó Israel; ali permaneceram; a peleja em Gibeá, contra os filhos da perversidade, não os alcançará.
text_el: τί ὑπερηφανεύεται γῆ καὶ σποδός

text_en: There is not a more wicked thing than to love money: for such a one sets even his own soul to sale: because while he lives he has cast away his bowels.
text_la: Nihil est iniquius quam amare pecuniam : hic enim et animam suam venalem habet, quoniam in vita sua projecit intima sua.
text_pt: Eu os castigarei na medida do meu desejo; e congregar-se-ão contra eles os povos, quando eu os atar pela sua dupla transgressão.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν ζωῇ ἔρριψα τὰ ἐνδόσθια αὐτοῦ

text_en: All power is of short life. A long sickness is troublesome to the physician.
text_la: Omnis potentatus brevis vita; languor prolixior gravat medicum.
text_pt: Porque Efraim é uma bezerra domada, que gosta de trilhar; e eu poupava a formosura do seu pescoço; mas farei cavalgar Efraim. Judá lavrará, Jacó lhe desfará os torrões.
text_el: μακρὸν ἀρρώστημα σκώπτει ἰατρός

text_en: The physician cuts off a short sickness: so also a king is to day, and tomorrow he shall die.
text_la: Brevem languorem præcidit medicus : sic et rex hodie est, et cras morietur.
text_pt: Semeai para vós em justiça, ceifai segundo a misericórdia; lavrai o campo de lavoura; porque é tempo de buscar ao Senhor, até que venha e chova a justiça sobre vós.
text_el: καὶ βασιλεὺς σήμερον καὶ αὔριον τελευτήσει

text_en: For when a man shall die, he shall inherit serpents, and beasts, and worms.
text_la: Cum enim morietur homo, hæreditabit serpentes, et bestias, et vermes.
text_pt: Lavrastes a impiedade, segastes a iniqüidade, e comestes o fruto da mentira; porque confiaste no teu caminho, na multidão dos teus poderosos.
text_el: ἐν γὰρ τῷ ἀποθανεῖν ἄνθρωπον κληρονομήσει ἑρπετὰ καὶ θηρία καὶ σκώληκας

text_en: The beginning of the pride of man , is to fall off from God :
text_la: Initium superbiæ hominis apostatare a Deo:
text_pt: Portanto, entre o teu povo se levantará um grande tumulto, e todas as tuas fortalezas serão destruídas, como Salmã destruiu a Bete-Arbel no dia da guerra; a mãe ali foi despedaçada com os filhos.
text_el: ἀρχὴ ὑπερηφανίας ἀνθρώπου ἀφίστασθαι ἀπὸ κυρίου

text_en: Because his heart is departed from him that made him: for pride is the beginning of all sin : he that holds it, shall be filled with maledictions, and it shall ruin him in the end.
text_la: quoniam ab eo qui fecit illum recessit cor ejus, quoniam initium omnis peccati est superbia. Qui tenuerit illam adimplebitur maledictis, et subvertet eum in finem.
text_pt: Assim vos fará Betel por causa da vossa grande malícia; de madrugada o rei de Israel será totalmente destruído.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ποιήσαντος αὐτὸν ἀπέστη ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἀρχὴ ὑπερηφανίας ἁμαρτία καὶ ὁ κρατῶν αὐτῆς ἐξομβρήσει βδέλυγμα

text_en: Therefore has the Lord disgraced the assemblies of the wicked , and has utterly destroyed them.
text_la: Propterea exhonoravit Dominus conventus malorum, et destruxit eos usque in finem.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο παρεδόξασεν κύριος τὰς ἐπαγωγὰς καὶ κατέστρεψεν εἰς τέλος αὐτούς

text_en: God has overturned the thrones of proud princes, and has set up the meek in their stead.
text_la: Sedes ducum superborum destruxit Deus, et sedere fecit mites pro eis.
text_el: θρόνους ἀρχόντων καθεῖλεν ὁ κύριος καὶ ἐκάθισεν πραεῖς ἀντ' αὐτῶν

text_en: God has made the roots of proud nations to wither, and has planted the humble of these nations.
text_la: Radices gentium superbarum arefecit Deus, et plantavit humiles ex ipsis gentibus.
text_el: ῥίζας ἐθνῶν ἐξέτιλεν ὁ κύριος καὶ ἐφύτευσεν ταπεινοὺς ἀντ' αὐτῶν

text_en: The Lord has overthrown the lands of the Gentiles , and has destroyed them even to the foundation.
text_la: Terras gentium evertit Dominus, et perdidit eas usque ad fundamentum.
text_el: χώρας ἐθνῶν κατέστρεψεν ὁ κύριος καὶ ἀπώλεσεν αὐτὰς ἕως θεμελίων γῆς

text_en: He has made some of them to wither away, and has destroyed them, and has made the memory of them to cease from the earth.
text_la: Arefecit ex ipsis, et disperdidit eos, et cessare fecit memoriam eorum a terra.
text_el: ἐξῆρεν ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπώλεσεν αὐτοὺς καὶ κατέπαυσεν ἀπὸ γῆς τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῶν

text_en: God has abolished the memory of the proud , and has preserved the memory of them that are humble in mind.
text_la: Memoria superborum perdidit Deus, et reliquit memoriam humilium sensu.

text_en: Pride was not made for men : nor wrath for the race of women .
text_la: Non est creata hominibus superbia, neque iracundia nationi mulierum.
text_el: οὐκ ἔκτισται ἀνθρώποις ὑπερηφανία οὐδὲ ὀργὴ θυμοῦ γεννήμασιν γυναικῶν

text_en: That seed of men shall be honoured , which fears God : but that seed shall be dishonoured, which transgresses the commandments of the Lord .
text_la: Semen hominum honorabitur hoc, quod timet Deum : semen autem hoc exhonorabitur, quod præterit mandata Domini.
text_el: σπέρμα ἔντιμον ποῖον σπέρμα ἀνθρώπου σπέρμα ἔντιμον ποῖον οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον σπέρμα ἄτιμον ποῖον σπέρμα ἀνθρώπου σπέρμα ἄτιμον ποῖον οἱ παραβαίνοντες ἐντολάς

text_en: In the midst of brethren their chief is honourable : so shall they that fear the Lord , be in his eyes.
text_la: In medio fratrum rector illorum in honore : et qui timent Dominum erunt in oculis illius.
text_el: ἐν μέσῳ ἀδελφῶν ὁ ἡγούμενος αὐτῶν ἔντιμος καὶ οἱ φοβούμενοι κύριον ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The fear of God is the glory of the rich , and of the honourable , and of the poor.
text_la: Gloria divitum, honoratorum, et pauperum, timor Dei est.
text_el: πλούσιος καὶ ἔνδοξος καὶ πτωχός τὸ καύχημα αὐτῶν φόβος κυρίου

text_en: Despise not a just man that is poor, and do not magnify a sinful man that is rich.
text_la: Noli despicere hominem justum pauperem, et noli magnificare virum peccatorem divitem.
text_el: οὐ δίκαιον ἀτιμάσαι πτωχὸν συνετόν καὶ οὐ καθήκει δοξάσαι ἄνδρα ἁμαρτωλόν

text_en: The great man , and the judge, and the mighty is in honour : and there is none greater than he that fears God .
text_la: Magnus, et judex, et potens est in honore : et non est major illo qui timet Deum.
text_el: μεγιστὰν καὶ κριτὴς καὶ δυνάστης δοξασθήσεται καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτῶν τις μείζων τοῦ φοβουμένου τὸν κύριον

text_en: They that are free shall serve a servant that is wise: and a man that is prudent and well instructed will not murmur when he is reproved; and he that is ignorant , shall not be honoured .
text_la: Servo sensato liberi servient : et vir prudens et disciplinatus non murmurabit correptus, et inscius non honorabitur.
text_el: οἰκέτῃ σοφῷ ἐλεύθεροι λειτουργήσουσιν καὶ ἀνὴρ ἐπιστήμων οὐ γογγύσει

text_en: Extol not yourself in doing your work, and linger not in the time of distress;
text_la: Noli extollere te in faciendo opere tuo, et noli cunctari in tempore angustiæ.
text_el: μὴ σοφίζου ποιῆσαι τὸ ἔργον σου καὶ μὴ δοξάζου ἐν καιρῷ στενοχωρίας σου

text_en: better is he that labours, and abounds in all things, than he that boasts himself and wants bread.
text_la: Melior est qui operatur et abundat in omnibus, quam qui gloriatur et eget pane.
text_el: κρείσσων ἐργαζόμενος καὶ περισσεύων ἐν πᾶσιν ἢ περιπατῶν δοξαζόμενος καὶ ἀπορῶν ἄρτων

text_en: My son, keep your soul in meekness, and give it honour according to its desert .
text_la: Fili, in mansuetudine serva animam tuam, et da illi honorem secundum meritum suum.
text_el: τέκνον ἐν πραΰτητι δόξασον τὴν ψυχήν σου καὶ δὸς αὐτῇ τιμὴν κατὰ τὴν ἀξίαν αὐτῆς

text_en: Who will justify him that sins against his own soul ? And who will honour him that dishonours his own soul ?
text_la: Peccantem in animam suam quis justificabit? et quis honorificabit exhonorantem animam suam?
text_el: τὸν ἁμαρτάνοντα εἰς τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ τίς δικαιώσει καὶ τίς δοξάσει τὸν ἀτιμάζοντα τὴν ζωὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: The poor man is glorified by his discipline and fear, and there is a man that is honoured for his wealth.
text_la: Pauper gloriatur per disciplinam et timorem suum : et est homo qui honorificatur propter substantiam suam.
text_el: πτωχὸς δοξάζεται δι' ἐπιστήμην αὐτοῦ καὶ πλούσιος δοξάζεται διὰ τὸν πλοῦτον αὐτοῦ

text_en: But he that is glorified in poverty, how much more in wealth? And he that is glorified in wealth, let him fear poverty.
text_la: Qui autem gloriatur in paupertate, quanto magis in substantia! et qui gloriatur in substantia, paupertatem vereatur.
text_el: ὁ δεδοξασμένος ἐν πτωχείᾳ καὶ ἐν πλούτῳ ποσαχῶς καὶ ὁ ἄδοξος ἐν πλούτῳ καὶ ἐν πτωχείᾳ ποσαχῶς

text_en: The wisdom of the humble shall exalt his head, and shall make him sit in the midst of great men .
text_la: Sapientia humiliati exaltabit caput illius, et in medio magnatorum consedere illum faciet.
text_pt: Quando Israel era menino, eu o amei; e do Egito chamei a meu filho.
text_el: σοφία ταπεινοῦ ἀνυψώσει κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν μέσῳ μεγιστάνων καθίσει αὐτόν

text_en: Praise not a man for his beauty, neither despise a man for his look.
text_la: Non laudes virum in specie sua, neque spernas hominem in visu suo.
text_pt: Mas, como os chamavam, assim se iam da sua face; sacrificavam a baalins, e queimavam incenso às imagens de escultura.
text_el: μὴ αἰνέσῃς ἄνδρα ἐν κάλλει αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ βδελύξῃ ἄνθρωπον ἐν ὁράσει αὐτοῦ

text_en: The bee is small among flying things but her fruit has the chiefest sweetness.
text_la: Brevis in volatilibus est apis, et initium dulcoris habet fructus illius.
text_pt: Todavia, eu ensinei a andar a Efraim; tomando-os pelos seus braços, mas não entenderam que eu os curava.
text_el: μικρὰ ἐν πετεινοῖς μέλισσα καὶ ἀρχὴ γλυκασμάτων ὁ καρπὸς αὐτῆς

text_en: Glory not in apparel at any time, and be not exalted in the day of your honour : for the works of the Highest only are wonderful, and his works are glorious , and secret, and hidden.
text_la: In vestitu ne glorieris umquam, nec in die honoris tui extollaris : quoniam mirabilia opera Altissimi solius, et gloriosa, et absconsa, et invisa opera illius.
text_pt: Atraí-os com cordas humanas, com laços de amor, e fui para eles como os que tiram o jugo de sobre as suas queixadas, e lhes dei mantimento.
text_el: ἐν περιβολῇ ἱματίων μὴ καυχήσῃ καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ δόξης μὴ ἐπαίρου ὅτι θαυμαστὰ τὰ ἔργα κυρίου καὶ κρυπτὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἀνθρώποις

text_en: Many tyrants have sat on the throne, and he whom no man would think on, has worn the crown.
text_la: Multi tyranni sederunt in throno : et insuspicabilis portavit diadema.
text_pt: Não voltará para a terra do Egito, mas a Assíria será seu rei; porque recusam converter-se.
text_el: πολλοὶ τύραννοι ἐκάθισαν ἐπὶ ἐδάφους ὁ δὲ ἀνυπονόητος ἐφόρεσεν διάδημα

text_en: Many mighty men have been greatly brought down, and the glorious have been delivered into the hand of others.
text_la: Multi potentes oppressi sunt valide, et gloriosi traditi sunt in manus alterorum.
text_pt: E cairá a espada sobre as suas cidades, e consumirá os seus ramos, e os devorará, por causa dos seus próprios conselhos.
text_el: πολλοὶ δυνάσται ἠτιμάσθησαν σφόδρα καὶ ἔνδοξοι παρεδόθησαν εἰς χεῖρας ἑτέρων

text_en: Before you inquire, blame no man : and when you have inquired, reprove justly .
text_la: Priusquam interroges, ne vituperes quemquam : et cum interrogaveris, corripe juste.
text_pt: Porque o meu povo é inclinado a desviar-se de mim; ainda que chamam ao Altíssimo, nenhum deles o exalta.
text_el: πρὶν ἐξετάσῃς μὴ μέμψῃ νόησον πρῶτον καὶ τότε ἐπιτίμα πρὶν ἢ ἀκοῦσαι μὴ ἀποκρίνου καὶ ἐν μέσῳ λόγων μὴ παρεμβάλλου

text_en: Before you hear, answer not a word: and interrupt not others in the midst of their discourse.
text_la: Priusquam audias, ne respondeas verbum : et in medio sermonum ne adjicias loqui.
text_pt: Como te deixaria, ó Efraim? Como te entregaria, ó Israel? Como te faria como Admá? Te poria como Zeboim? Está comovido em mim o meu coração, as minhas compaixões à uma se acendem.
text_el: περὶ πράγματος οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν σοι χρεία μὴ ἔριζε καὶ ἐν κρίσει ἁμαρτωλῶν μὴ συνέδρευε

text_en: Strive not in a matter which does not concern you, and sit not in judgment with sinners.
text_la: De ea re quæ te non molestat, ne certeris : et in judicio peccantium ne consistas.
text_pt: Não executarei o furor da minha ira; não voltarei para destruir a Efraim, porque eu sou Deus e não homem, o Santo no meio de ti; eu não entrarei na cidade.
text_el: τέκνον μὴ περὶ πολλὰ ἔστωσαν αἱ πράξεις σου

text_en: My son, meddle not with many matters: and if you be rich, you shall not be free from sin : for if you pursue after you shall not overtake; and if you run before you shall not escape.
text_la: Fili, ne in multis sint actus tui : et si dives fueris, non eris immunis a delicto. Si enim secutus fueris, non apprehendes : et non effugies, si præcucurreris.
text_pt: Andarão após o Senhor; ele rugirá como leão; rugindo, pois, ele, os filhos do ocidente tremerão.
text_el: ἐὰν πληθύνῃς οὐκ ἀθῳωθήσῃ καὶ ἐὰν διώκῃς οὐ μὴ καταλάβῃς καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκφύγῃς διαδράς

text_en: There is an ungodly man that labours, and makes haste, and is in sorrow, and is so much the more in want.
text_la: Est homo laborans et festinans, et dolens : impius, et tanto magis non abundabit.
text_pt: Tremendo virão como um passarinho, os do Egito, e como uma pomba os da terra da Assíria, e os farei habitar em suas casas, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἔστιν κοπιῶν καὶ πονῶν καὶ σπεύδων καὶ τόσῳ μᾶλλον ὑστερεῖται

text_en: Again, there is an inactive man that wants help, is very weak in ability, and full of poverty:
text_la: Est homo marcidus egens recuperatione, plus deficiens virtute, et abundans paupertate :
text_pt: Efraim me cercou com mentira, e a casa de Israel com engano; mas Judá ainda domina com Deus, e com os santos está fiel.
text_el: ἔστιν νωθρὸς προσδεόμενος ἀντιλήμψεως ὑστερῶν ἰσχύι καὶ πτωχείᾳ περισσεύει

text_en: Yet the eye of God has looked upon him for good, and has lifted him up from his low estate, and has exalted his head: and many have wondered at him, and have glorified God .
text_la: et oculus Dei respexit illum in bono, et erexit eum ab humilitate ipsius, et exaltavit caput ejus : et mirati sunt in illo multi, et honoraverunt Deum.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ κυρίου ἐπέβλεψαν αὐτῷ εἰς ἀγαθά καὶ ἀνώρθωσεν αὐτὸν ἐκ ταπεινώσεως αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνύψωσεν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπεθαύμασαν ἐπ' αὐτῷ πολλοί

text_en: Good things and evil , life and death, poverty and riches, are from God .
text_la: Bona et mala, vita et mors, paupertas et honestas, a Deo sunt :
text_el: ἀγαθὰ καὶ κακά ζωὴ καὶ θάνατος πτωχεία καὶ πλοῦτος παρὰ κυρίου ἐστίν

text_en: Wisdom and discipline, and the knowledge of the law are with God . Love and the ways of good things are with him.
text_la: sapientia, et disciplina, et scientia legis, apud Deum : dilectio, et viæ bonorum, apud ipsum.

text_en: Error and darkness are created with sinners: and they that glory in evil things, grow old in evil .
text_la: Error et tenebræ peccatoribus concreata sunt : qui autem exsultant in malis consenescunt in malo.

text_en: The gift of God abides with the just , and his advancement shall have success for ever.
text_la: Datio Dei permanet justis, et profectus illius successus habebit in æternum.
text_el: δόσις κυρίου παραμένει εὐσεβέσιν καὶ ἡ εὐδοκία αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα εὐοδωθήσεται

text_en: There is one that is enriched by living sparingly, and this is the portion of his reward.
text_la: Est qui locupletatur parce agendo, et hæc est pars mercedis illius.
text_el: ἔστιν πλουτῶν ἀπὸ προσοχῆς καὶ σφιγγίας αὐτοῦ καὶ αὕτη ἡ μερὶς τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: In that he says: I have found me rest, and now I will eat of my goods alone:
text_la: In eo quod dicit : Inveni requiem mihi, et nunc manducabo de bonis meis solus :
text_el: ἐν τῷ εἰπεῖν αὐτόν εὗρον ἀνάπαυσιν καὶ νῦν φάγομαι ἐκ τῶν ἀγαθῶν μου

text_en: And he knows not what time shall pass, and that death approaches, and that he must leave all to others, and shall die.
text_la: et nescit quod tempus præteriet, et mors appropinquet, et relinquat omnia aliis, et morietur.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ οἶδεν τίς καιρὸς παρελεύσεται καὶ καταλείψει αὐτὰ ἑτέροις καὶ ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: Be steadfast in your covenant, and be conversant therein, and grow old in the work of your commandments.
text_la: Sta in testamento tuo, et in illo colloquere, et in opere mandatorum tuorum veterasce.
text_el: στῆθι ἐν διαθήκῃ σου καὶ ὁμίλει ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἐν τῷ ἔργῳ σου παλαιώθητι

text_en: Abide not in the works of sinners. But trust in God , and stay in your place,
text_la: Ne manseris in operibus peccatorum : confide autem in Deo, et mane in loco tuo.
text_el: μὴ θαύμαζε ἐν ἔργοις ἁμαρτωλοῦ πίστευε δὲ κυρίῳ καὶ ἔμμενε τῷ πόνῳ σου

text_en: for it is easy in the eyes of God on a sudden to make the poor man rich.
text_la: Facile est enim in oculis Dei subito honestare pauperem.
text_el: ὅτι κοῦφον ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου διὰ τάχους ἐξάπινα πλουτίσαι πένητα

text_en: The blessing of God makes haste to reward the just , and in a swift hour his blessing bears fruit.
text_la: Benedictio Dei in mercedem justi festinat, et in hora veloci processus illius fructificat.
text_el: εὐλογία κυρίου ἐν μισθῷ εὐσεβοῦς καὶ ἐν ὥρᾳ ταχινῇ ἀναθάλλει εὐλογίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Say not: What need I, and what good shall I have by this?
text_la: Ne dicas : Quid est mihi opus? et quæ erunt mihi ex hoc bona?
text_el: μὴ εἴπῃς τίς ἐστίν μου χρεία καὶ τίνα ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἔσται μου τὰ ἀγαθά

text_en: Say not: I am sufficient for myself: and what shall I be made worse by this?
text_la: Ne dicas : Sufficiens mihi sum : et quid ex hoc pessimabor?
text_el: μὴ εἴπῃς αὐτάρκη μοί ἐστιν καὶ τί ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν κακωθήσομαι

text_en: In the day of good things be not unmindful of evils : and in the day of evils be not unmindful of good things:
text_la: In die bonorum ne immemor sis malorum, et in die malorum ne immemor sis bonorum :
text_el: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἀγαθῶν ἀμνησία κακῶν καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κακῶν οὐ μνησθήσεται ἀγαθῶν

text_en: For it is easy before God in the day of death to reward every one according to his ways.
text_la: quoniam facile est coram Deo in die obitus retribuere unicuique secundum vias suas.
text_el: ὅτι κοῦφον ἔναντι κυρίου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τελευτῆς ἀποδοῦναι ἀνθρώπῳ κατὰ τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The affliction of an hour makes one forget great delights, and in the end of a man is the disclosing of his works.
text_la: Malitia horæ oblivionem facit luxuriæ magnæ, et in fine hominis denudatio operum illius.
text_el: κάκωσις ὥρας ἐπιλησμονὴν ποιεῖ τρυφῆς καὶ ἐν συντελείᾳ ἀνθρώπου ἀποκάλυψις ἔργων αὐτοῦ

text_en: Praise not any man before death, for a man is known by his children.
text_la: Ante mortem ne laudes hominem quemquam : quoniam in filiis suis agnoscitur vir.
text_el: πρὸ τελευτῆς μὴ μακάριζε μηδένα καὶ ἐν τέκνοις αὐτοῦ γνωσθήσεται ἀνήρ

text_en: Bring not every man into your house: for many are the snares of the deceitful.
text_la: Non omnem hominem inducas in domum tuam : multæ enim sunt insidiæ dolosi.
text_el: μὴ πάντα ἄνθρωπον εἴσαγε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου πολλὰ γὰρ τὰ ἔνεδρα τοῦ δολίου

text_en: For as corrupted bowels send forth stinking breath, and as the partridge is brought into the cage, and as the roe into the snare: so also is the heart of the proud , and as a spy that looks on the fall of his neighbour.
text_la: Sicut enim eructant præcordia fœtentium, et sicut perdix inducitur in caveam, et ut caprea in laqueum : sic et cor superborum, et sicut prospector videns casum proximi sui.
text_el: πέρδιξ θηρευτὴς ἐν καρτάλλῳ οὕτως καρδία ὑπερηφάνου καὶ ὡς ὁ κατάσκοπος ἐπιβλέπει πτῶσιν

text_en: For he lies in wait and turns good into evil , and on the elect he will lay a blot.
text_la: Bona enim in mala convertens insidiatur, et in electis imponet maculam.
text_el: τὰ γὰρ ἀγαθὰ εἰς κακὰ μεταστρέφων ἐνεδρεύει καὶ ἐν τοῖς αἱρετοῖς ἐπιθήσει μῶμον

text_en: Of one spark comes a great fire, and of one deceitful man much blood: and a sinful man lies in wait for blood.
text_la: A scintilla una augetur ignis, et ab uno doloso augetur sanguis : homo vero peccator sanguini insidiatur.
text_el: ἀπὸ σπινθῆρος πυρὸς πληθύνεται ἀνθρακιά καὶ ἄνθρωπος ἁμαρτωλὸς εἰς αἷμα ἐνεδρεύει

text_en: Take heed to yourself of a mischievous man , for he works evils : lest he bring upon you reproach for ever.
text_la: Attende tibi a pestifero, fabricat enim mala, ne inducat super te subsannationem in perpetuum.
text_el: πρόσεχε ἀπὸ κακούργου πονηρὰ γὰρ τεκταίνει μήποτε μῶμον εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα δῷ σοι

text_en: Receive a stranger in, and he shall overthrow you with a whirlwind, and shall turn you out of your own.
text_la: Admitte ad te alienigenam : et subvertet te in turbine, et abalienabit te a tuis propriis.
text_el: ἐνοίκισον ἀλλότριον καὶ διαστρέψει σε ἐν ταραχαῖς καὶ ἀπαλλοτριώσει σε τῶν ἰδίων σου

text_en: If you do good , know to whom you do it, and there shall be much thanks for your good deeds.
text_la: Si benefeceris, scito cui feceris, et erit gratia in bonis tuis multa.
text_pt: Efraim se apascenta de vento, e segue o vento leste; todo o dia multiplica a mentira e a destruição; e fazem aliança com a Assíria, e o azeite se leva ao Egito.
text_el: ἐὰν εὖ ποιῇς γνῶθι τίνι ποιεῖς καὶ ἔσται χάρις τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς σου

text_en: Do good to the just , and you shall find great recompense: and if not of him, assuredly of the Lord .
text_la: Benefac justo, et invenies retributionem magnam : et si non ab ipso, certe a Domino.
text_pt: O Senhor também com Judá tem contenda, e castigará Jacó segundo os seus caminhos; segundo as suas obras o recompensará.
text_el: εὖ ποίησον εὐσεβεῖ καὶ εὑρήσεις ἀνταπόδομα καὶ εἰ μὴ παρ' αὐτοῦ ἀλλὰ παρὰ τοῦ ὑψίστου

text_en: For there is no good for him that is always occupied in evil , and that gives no alms : for the Highest hates sinners, and has mercy on the penitent.
text_la: Non est enim ei bene qui assiduus est in malis, et eleemosynas non danti : quoniam et Altissimus odio habet peccatores, et misertus est pœnitentibus.
text_pt: No ventre pegou do calcanhar de seu irmão, e na sua força lutou com Deus.
text_el: οὐκ ἔσται ἀγαθὰ τῷ ἐνδελεχίζοντι εἰς κακὰ καὶ τῷ ἐλεημοσύνην μὴ χαριζομένῳ

text_en: Give to the merciful and uphold not the sinner: God will repay vengeance to the ungodly and to sinners, and keep them against the day of vengeance.
text_la: Da misericordi, et ne suscipias peccatorem : et impiis et peccatoribus reddet vindictam, custodiens eos in diem vindictæ.
text_pt: Lutou com o anjo, e prevaleceu; chorou, e lhe suplicou; em Betel o achou, e ali falou conosco,
text_el: δὸς τῷ εὐσεβεῖ καὶ μὴ ἀντιλάβῃ τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ

text_en: Give to the good , and receive not a sinner.
text_la: Da bono, et non receperis peccatorem.
text_pt: Sim, o Senhor, o Deus dos Exércitos; o Senhor é o seu memorial.

text_en: Do good to the humble , and give not to the ungodly: hold back your bread, and give it not to him, lest thereby he overmaster you.
text_la: Benefac humili, et non dederis impio : prohibe panes illi dari, ne in ipsis potentior te sit :
text_pt: Tu, pois, converte-te a teu Deus; guarda a benevolência e o juízo, e em teu Deus espera sempre.
text_el: εὖ ποίησον ταπεινῷ καὶ μὴ δῷς ἀσεβεῖ ἐμπόδισον τοὺς ἄρτους αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ δῷς αὐτῷ ἵνα μὴ ἐν αὐτοῖς σε δυναστεύσῃ

text_en: For you shall receive twice as much evil for all the good you shall have done to him: for the Highest also hates sinners, and will repay vengeance to the ungodly.
text_la: nam duplicia mala invenies in omnibus bonis quæcumque feceris illi, quoniam et Altissimus odio habet peccatores, et impiis reddet vindictam.
text_pt: É um mercador; tem nas mãos uma balança enganosa; ama a opressão.
text_el: διπλάσια γὰρ κακὰ εὑρήσεις ἐν πᾶσιν ἀγαθοῖς οἷς ἂν ποιήσῃς αὐτῷ ὅτι καὶ ὁ ὕψιστος ἐμίσησεν ἁμαρτωλοὺς καὶ τοῖς ἀσεβέσιν ἀποδώσει ἐκδίκησιν δὸς τῷ ἀγαθῷ καὶ μὴ ἀντιλάβῃ τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ

text_en: A friend shall not be known in prosperity, and an enemy shall not be hidden in adversity.
text_la: Non agnoscetur in bonis amicus, et non abscondetur in malis inimicus.
text_pt: E diz Efraim: Contudo me tenho enriquecido, e tenho adquirido para mim grandes bens; em todo o meu trabalho não acharão em mim iniqüidade alguma que seja pecado.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκδικηθήσεται ἐν ἀγαθοῖς ὁ φίλος καὶ οὐ κρυβήσεται ἐν κακοῖς ὁ ἐχθρός

text_en: In the prosperity of a man , his enemies are grieved: and a friend is known in his adversity.
text_la: In bonis viri, inimici illius in tristitia : et in malitia illius, amicus agnitus est.
text_pt: Mas eu sou o Senhor teu Deus desde a terra do Egito; eu ainda te farei habitar em tendas, como nos dias da festa solene.
text_el: ἐν ἀγαθοῖς ἀνδρὸς οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτοῦ ἐν λύπῃ καὶ ἐν τοῖς κακοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ φίλος διαχωρισθήσεται

text_en: Never trust your enemy for as a brass pot his wickedness rusts:
text_la: Non credas inimico tuo in æternum : sicut enim æramentum æruginat nequitia illius :
text_pt: Falei aos profetas, e multipliquei a visão; e pelo ministério dos profetas propus símiles.
text_el: μὴ πιστεύσῃς τῷ ἐχθρῷ σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὡς γὰρ ὁ χαλκὸς ἰοῦται οὕτως ἡ πονηρία αὐτοῦ

text_en: Though he humble himself and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him.
text_la: et si humiliatus vadat curvus, adjice animum tuum, et custodi te ab illo.
text_pt: Não é Gileade iniqüidade? Pura vaidade são eles; em Gilgal sacrificam bois; os seus altares são como montões de pedras nos sulcos dos campos.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ταπεινωθῇ καὶ πορεύηται συγκεκυφώς ἐπίστησον τὴν ψυχήν σου καὶ φύλαξαι ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσῃ αὐτῷ ὡς ἐκμεμαχὼς ἔσοπτρον καὶ γνώσῃ ὅτι οὐκ εἰς τέλος κατίωσεν

text_en: Set him not by you, neither let him sit on your right hand, lest he turn into your place, and seek to take your seat and at the last you acknowledge my words, and be pricked with my sayings.
text_la: Non statuas illum penes te, nec sedeat ad dexteram tuam, ne forte conversus in locum tuum, inquirat cathedram tuam, et in novissimo agnosces verba mea, et in sermonibus meis stimuleris.
text_pt: Jacó fugiu para o campo da Síria, e Israel serviu por uma mulher, e por uma mulher guardou o gado.
text_el: μὴ στήσῃς αὐτὸν παρὰ σεαυτῷ μὴ ἀνατρέψας σε στῇ ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον σου μὴ καθίσῃς αὐτὸν ἐκ δεξιῶν σου μήποτε ζητήσῃ τὴν καθέδραν σου καὶ ἐπ' ἐσχάτων ἐπιγνώσῃ τοὺς λόγους μου καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ῥημάτων μου κατανυγήσῃ

text_en: Who will pity an enchanter struck by a serpent, or any that come near wild beasts? So is it with him that keeps company with a wicked man , and is involved in his sins .
text_la: Quis miserebitur incantatori a serpente percusso, et omnibus qui appropiant bestiis? et sic qui comitatur cum viro iniquo, et obvolutus est in peccatis ejus.
text_pt: Mas o Senhor por meio de um profeta fez subir a Israel do Egito, e por um profeta foi ele guardado.
text_el: τίς ἐλεήσει ἐπαοιδὸν ὀφιόδηκτον καὶ πάντας τοὺς προσάγοντας θηρίοις οὕτως τὸν προσπορευόμενον ἀνδρὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ καὶ συμφυρόμενον ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτοῦ

text_en: For an hour he will abide with you: but if you begin to decline, he will not endure it.
text_la: Una hora tecum permanebit : si autem declinaveris, non supportabit.
text_pt: Efraim mui amargosamente provocou a sua ira; portanto deixará ficar sobre ele o seu sangue, e o seu Senhor o recompensará pelo seu opróbrio.
text_el: ὥραν μετὰ σοῦ διαμενεῖ καὶ ἐὰν ἐκκλίνῃς οὐ μὴ καρτερήσῃ

text_en: An enemy speaks sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he lies in wait, to throw you into a pit.
text_la: In labiis suis indulcat inimicus, et in corde suo insidiatur ut subvertat te in foveam.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτοῦ γλυκανεῖ ὁ ἐχθρὸς καὶ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ βουλεύσεται ἀνατρέψαι σε εἰς βόθρον

text_en: An enemy weeps with his eyes: but if he find an opportunity he will not be satisfied with blood:
text_la: In oculis suis lacrimatur inimicus, et si invenerit tempus, non satiabitur sanguine.
text_el: ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ δακρύσει ὁ ἐχθρός καὶ ἐὰν εὕρῃ καιρόν οὐκ ἐμπλησθήσεται ἀφ' αἵματος

text_en: And if evils come upon you, you shall find him there first.
text_la: Et si incurrerint tibi mala, invenies eum illic priorem.
text_el: κακὰ ἐὰν ὑπαντήσῃ σοι εὑρήσεις αὐτὸν πρότερον ἐκεῖ σου

text_en: An enemy has tears in his eyes, and while he pretends to help you, will undermine your feet.
text_la: In oculis suis lacrimatur inimicus, et quasi adjuvans suffodiet plantas tuas.
text_el: καὶ ὡς βοηθῶν ὑποσχάσει πτέρναν σου

text_en: He will shake his head, and clap his hands, and whisper much, and change his countenance.
text_la: Caput suum movebit, et plaudet manu, et multa susurrans commutabit vultum suum.
text_el: τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ κινήσει καὶ ἐπικροτήσει ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ καὶ πολλὰ διαψιθυρίσει καὶ ἀλλοιώσει τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: He that touches pitch, shall be defiled with it: and he that has fellowship with the proud , shall put on pride .
text_la: Qui tetigerit picem inquinabitur ab ea : et qui communicaverit superbo induet superbiam.
text_pt: Quando Efraim falava, tremia-se; foi exaltado em Israel; mas ele se fez culpado em Baal, e morreu.
text_el: ὁ ἁπτόμενος πίσσης μολυνθήσεται καὶ ὁ κοινωνῶν ὑπερηφάνῳ ὁμοιωθήσεται αὐτῷ

text_en: He shall take a burden upon him that has fellowship with one more honourable than himself. And have no fellowship with one that is richer than yourself.
text_la: Pondus super se tollat qui honestiori se communicat, et ditiori te ne socius fueris.
text_pt: E agora multiplicaram pecados, e da sua prata fizeram uma imagem de fundição, ídolos segundo o seu entendimento, todos obra de artífices, dos quais dizem: Os homens que sacrificam beijem os bezerros.
text_el: βάρος ὑπὲρ σὲ μὴ ἄρῃς καὶ ἰσχυροτέρῳ σου καὶ πλουσιωτέρῳ μὴ κοινώνει

text_en: What agreement shall the earthen pot have with the kettle? For if they knock one against the other, it shall be broken.
text_la: Quid communicabit cacabus ad ollam? quando enim se colliserint, confringetur.
text_pt: Por isso serão como a nuvem da manhã, e como o orvalho da madrugada, que cedo passa; como folhelho que a tempestade lança da eira, e como a fumaça da chaminé.
text_el: τί κοινωνήσει χύτρα πρὸς λέβητα αὕτη προσκρούσει καὶ αὕτη συντριβήσεται

text_en: The rich man has done wrong, and yet he will fume: but the poor is wronged and must hold his peace.
text_la: Dives injuste egit, et fremet : pauper autem læsus tacebit.
text_pt: Todavia, eu sou o Senhor teu Deus desde a terra do Egito; portanto não reconhecerás outro deus além de mim, porque não há Salvador senão eu.
text_el: πλούσιος ἠδίκησεν καὶ αὐτὸς προσενεβριμήσατο πτωχὸς ἠδίκηται καὶ αὐτὸς προσδεηθήσεται

text_en: If you give, he will make use of you: and if you have nothing, he will forsake you.
text_la: Si largitus fueris, assumet te : et si non habueris, derelinquet te.
text_pt: Eu te conheci no deserto, na terra muito seca.
text_el: ἐὰν χρησιμεύσῃς ἐργᾶται ἐν σοί καὶ ἐὰν ὑστερήσῃς καταλείψει σε

text_en: If you have anything, he will live with you, and will make you bare, and he will not be sorry for you.
text_la: Si habes, convivet tecum, et evacuabit te : et ipse non dolebit super te.
text_pt: Depois eles se fartaram em proporção do seu pasto; estando fartos, ensoberbeceu-se o seu coração, por isso se esqueceram de mim.
text_el: ἐὰν ἔχῃς συμβιώσεταί σοι καὶ ἀποκενώσει σε καὶ αὐτὸς οὐ πονέσει

text_en: If he have need of you he will deceive you, and smiling upon you will put you in hope ; he will speak you fair, and will say: What do you want?
text_la: Si necessarius illi fueris, supplantabit te, et subridens spem dabit, narrans tibi bona, et dicet : Quid opus est tibi?
text_pt: Serei, pois, para eles como leão; como leopardo espiarei no caminho.
text_el: χρείαν ἔσχηκέν σου καὶ ἀποπλανήσει σε καὶ προσγελάσεταί σοι καὶ δώσει σοι ἐλπίδα λαλήσει σοι καλὰ καὶ ἐρεῖ τίς ἡ χρεία σου

text_en: And he will shame you by his meats, till he have drawn you dry twice or thrice, and at last he will laugh at you: and afterward when he sees you, he will forsake you, and shake his head at you.
text_la: Et confundet te in cibis suis, donec te exinaniat bis et ter : et in novissimo deridebit te, et postea videns derelinquet te, et caput suum movebit ad te.
text_pt: Como ursa roubada dos seus filhos, os encontrarei, e lhes romperei as teias do seu coração, e como leão ali os devorarei; as feras do campo os despedaçarão.
text_el: καὶ αἰσχυνεῖ σε ἐν τοῖς βρώμασιν αὐτοῦ ἕως οὗ ἀποκενώσῃ σε δὶς ἢ τρίς καὶ ἐπ' ἐσχάτων καταμωκήσεταί σου μετὰ ταῦτα ὄψεταί σε καὶ καταλείψει σε καὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ κινήσει ἐπὶ σοί

text_en: Humble yourself to God , and wait for his hands.
text_la: Humiliare Deo, et exspecta manus ejus.
text_pt: Para a tua perda, ó Israel, te rebelaste contra mim, a saber, contra o teu ajudador.

text_en: Beware that you be not deceived into folly, and be humbled .
text_la: Attende ne seductus in stultitiam humilieris.
text_pt: Onde está agora o teu rei, para que te guarde em todas as tuas cidades, e os teus juízes, dos quais disseste: Dá-me rei e príncipes?
text_el: πρόσεχε μὴ ἀποπλανηθῇς καὶ μὴ ταπεινωθῇς ἐν ἀφροσύνῃ σου

text_en: Be not lowly in your wisdom, lest being humbled you be deceived into folly.
text_la: Noli esse humilis in sapientia tua, ne humiliatus in stultitiam seducaris.
text_pt: Dei-te um rei na minha ira, e tirei-o no meu furor.

text_en: If you be invited by one that is mightier, withdraw yourself: for so he will invite you the more.
text_la: Advocatus a potentiore, discede : ex hoc enim magis te advocabit.
text_pt: A iniqüidade de Efraim está atada, o seu pecado está armazenado.
text_el: προσκαλεσαμένου σε δυνάστου ὑποχωρῶν γίνου καὶ τόσῳ μᾶλλόν σε προσκαλέσεται

text_en: Be not troublesome to him, lest you be put back: and keep not far from him, lest you be forgotten.
text_la: Ne improbus sis, ne impingaris : et ne longe sis ab eo, ne eas in oblivionem.
text_pt: Dores de mulher de parto lhe sobrevirão; ele é um filho insensato; porque é tempo e não está no lugar em que deve vir à luz.
text_el: μὴ ἔμπιπτε μὴ ἀπωσθῇς καὶ μὴ μακρὰν ἀφίστω ἵνα μὴ ἐπιλησθῇς

text_en: Affect not to speak with him as an equal, and believe not his many words: for by much talk he will sift you, and smiling will examine you concerning your secrets.
text_la: Ne retineas ex æquo loqui cum illo, nec credas multis verbis illius : ex multa enim loquela tentabit te, et subridens interrogabit te de absconditis tuis.
text_pt: Eu os remirei da mão do inferno, e os resgatarei da morte. Onde estão, ó morte, as tuas pragas? Onde está, ó inferno, a tua perdição? O arrependimento está escondido de meus olhos.
text_el: μὴ ἔπεχε ἰσηγορεῖσθαι μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ πίστευε τοῖς πλείοσιν λόγοις αὐτοῦ ἐκ πολλῆς γὰρ λαλιᾶς πειράσει σε καὶ ὡς προσγελῶν ἐξετάσει σε

text_en: His cruel mind will lay up your words: and he will not spare to do you hurt, and to cast you into prison .
text_la: Immitis animus illius conservabit verba tua : et non parcet de malitia, et de vinculis.
text_pt: Ainda que ele dê fruto entre os irmãos, virá o vento leste, vento do Senhor, subindo do deserto, e secar-se-á a sua nascente, e secar-se-á a sua fonte; ele saqueará o tesouro de todos os vasos desejáveis.
text_el: ἀνελεήμων ὁ μὴ συντηρῶν λόγους καὶ οὐ μὴ φείσηται περὶ κακώσεως καὶ δεσμῶν

text_en: Take heed to yourself, and attend diligently to what you hear: for you walk in danger of your ruin.
text_la: Cave tibi, et attende diligenter auditui tuo, quoniam cum subversione tua ambulas :
text_pt: Samaria virá a ser deserta, porque se rebelou contra o seu Deus; cairão à espada, seus filhos serão despedaçados, e as suas grávidas serão fendidas pelo meio.
text_el: συντήρησον καὶ πρόσεχε σφοδρῶς ὅτι μετὰ τῆς πτώσεώς σου περιπατεῖς

text_en: When you hear those things, see as it were in sleep, and you shall awake.
text_la: audiens vero illa, quasi in somnis vide, et vigilabis.

text_en: Love God all your life, and call upon him for your salvation .
text_la: Omni vita tua dilige Deum, et invoca illum in salute tua.

text_en: Every beast loves its like: so also every man him that is nearest to himself.
text_la: Omne animal diligit simile sibi, sic et omnis homo proximum sibi.
text_el: πᾶν ζῷον ἀγαπᾷ τὸ ὅμοιον αὐτῷ καὶ πᾶς ἄνθρωπος τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: All flesh shall consort with the like to itself, and every man shall associate himself to his like.
text_la: Omnis caro ad similem sibi conjungetur, et omnis homo simili sui sociabitur.
text_el: πᾶσα σὰρξ κατὰ γένος συνάγεται καὶ τῷ ὁμοίῳ αὐτοῦ προσκολληθήσεται ἀνήρ

text_en: If the wolf shall at any time have fellowship with the lamb, so the sinner with the just .
text_la: Si communicabit lupus agno aliquando, sic peccator justo.
text_el: τί κοινωνήσει λύκος ἀμνῷ οὕτως ἁμαρτωλὸς πρὸς εὐσεβῆ

text_en: What fellowship has a holy man with a dog, or what part has the rich with the poor?
text_la: Quæ communicatio sancto homini ad canem? aut quæ pars diviti ad pauperem?
text_el: τίς εἰρήνη ὑαίνῃ πρὸς κύνα καὶ τίς εἰρήνη πλουσίῳ πρὸς πένητα

text_en: The wild ass is the lion's prey in the desert : so also the poor are devoured by the rich.
text_la: Venatio leonis onager in eremo : sic et pascua divitum sunt pauperes.
text_el: κυνήγια λεόντων ὄναγροι ἐν ἐρήμῳ οὕτως νομαὶ πλουσίων πτωχοί

text_en: And as humility is an abomination to the proud : so also the rich man abhors the poor.
text_la: Et sicut abominatio est superbo humilitas, sic et execratio divitis pauper.
text_el: βδέλυγμα ὑπερηφάνῳ ταπεινότης οὕτως βδέλυγμα πλουσίῳ πτωχός

text_en: When a rich man is shaken, he is kept up by his friends: but when a poor man is fallen down, he is thrust away even by his acquaintance.
text_la: Dives commotus confirmatur ab amicis suis : humilis autem cum ceciderit, expelletur et a notis.
text_el: πλούσιος σαλευόμενος στηρίζεται ὑπὸ φίλων ταπεινὸς δὲ πεσὼν προσαπωθεῖται ὑπὸ φίλων

text_en: When a rich man has been deceived, he has many helpers: he has spoken proud things, and they have justified him.
text_la: Diviti decepto multi recuperatores : locutus est superbia, et justificaverunt illum.
text_el: πλουσίου σφαλέντος πολλοὶ ἀντιλήμπτορες ἐλάλησεν ἀπόρρητα καὶ ἐδικαίωσαν αὐτόν

text_en: The poor man was deceived, and he is rebuked also: he has spoken wisely, and could have no place.
text_la: Humilis deceptus est, insuper et arguitur : locutus est sensate, et non est datus ei locus.
text_el: ταπεινὸς ἔσφαλεν καὶ προσεπετίμησαν αὐτῷ ἐφθέγξατο σύνεσιν καὶ οὐκ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ τόπος

text_en: The rich man spoke, and all held their peace, and what he said they extol even to the clouds.
text_la: Dives locutus est, et omnes tacuerunt, et verbum illius usque ad nubes perducent.
text_el: πλούσιος ἐλάλησεν καὶ πάντες ἐσίγησαν καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ἀνύψωσαν ἕως τῶν νεφελῶν

text_en: The poor man spoke, and they say: Who is this? And if he stumble, they will overthrow him.
text_la: Pauper locutus est, et dicunt : Quis est hic? et si offenderit, subvertent illum.
text_el: πτωχὸς ἐλάλησεν καὶ εἶπαν τίς οὗτος κἂν προσκόψῃ προσανατρέψουσιν αὐτόν

text_en: Riches are good to him that has no sin in his conscience : and poverty is very wicked in the mouth of the ungodly.
text_la: Bona est substantia cui non est peccatum in conscientia : et nequissima paupertas in ore impii.
text_el: ἀγαθὸς ὁ πλοῦτος ᾧ μή ἐστιν ἁμαρτία καὶ πονηρὰ ἡ πτωχεία ἐν στόματι ἀσεβοῦς

text_en: The heart of a man changes his countenance, either for good , or for evil .
text_la: Cor hominis immutat faciem illius, sive in bona, sive in mala.
text_el: καρδία ἀνθρώπου ἀλλοιοῖ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐάν τε εἰς ἀγαθὰ ἐάν τε εἰς κακά

text_en: The token of a good heart, and a good countenance you shall hardly find, and with labour.
text_la: Vestigium cordis boni et faciem bonam difficile invenies, et cum labore.
text_el: ἴχνος καρδίας ἐν ἀγαθοῖς πρόσωπον ἱλαρόν καὶ εὕρεσις παραβολῶν διαλογισμοὶ μετὰ κόπων

text_en: Blessed is the man that has not slipped by a word out of his mouth, and is not pricked with the remorse of sin .
text_la: Beatus vir qui non est lapsus verbo ex ore suo, et non est stimulatus in tristitia delicti.
text_pt: Converte-te, ó Israel, ao SENHOR teu Deus; porque pelos teus pecados tens caído.
text_el: μακάριος ἀνήρ ὃς οὐκ ὠλίσθησεν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ κατενύγη ἐν λύπῃ ἁμαρτιῶν

text_en: Happy is he that has had no sadness of his mind, and who is not fallen from his hope .
text_la: Felix qui non habuit animi sui tristitiam, et non excidit a spe sua.
text_pt: Tomai convosco palavras, e convertei-vos ao Senhor; dizei-lhe: Tira toda a iniqüidade, e aceita o que é bom; e ofereceremos como novilhos os sacrifícios dos nossos lábios.
text_el: μακάριος οὗ οὐ κατέγνω ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὃς οὐκ ἔπεσεν ἀπὸ τῆς ἐλπίδος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Riches are not comely for a covetous man and a niggard, and what should an envious man do with gold?
text_la: Viro cupido et tenaci sine ratione est substantia : et homini livido ad quid aurum?
text_pt: Não nos salvará a Assíria, não iremos montados em cavalos, e à obra das nossas mãos já não diremos mais: Tu és o nosso deus; porque por ti o órfão alcança misericórdia.
text_el: ἀνδρὶ μικρολόγῳ οὐ καλὸς ὁ πλοῦτος καὶ ἀνθρώπῳ βασκάνῳ ἵνα τί χρήματα

text_en: He that gathers together by wronging his own soul , gathers for others, and another will squander away his goods in rioting.
text_la: Qui acervat ex animo suo injuste, aliis congregat, et in bonis illius alius luxuriabitur.
text_pt: Eu sararei a sua infidelidade, eu voluntariamente os amarei; porque a minha ira se apartou deles.
text_el: ὁ συνάγων ἀπὸ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ συνάγει ἄλλοις καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς αὐτοῦ τρυφήσουσιν ἕτεροι

text_en: He that is evil to himself, to whom will he be good ? And he shall not take pleasure in his goods .
text_la: Qui sibi nequam est, cui alii bonus erit? et non jucundabitur in bonis suis.
text_pt: Eu serei para Israel como o orvalho. Ele florescerá como o lírio e lançará as suas raízes como o Líbano.
text_el: ὁ πονηρὸς ἑαυτῷ τίνι ἀγαθὸς ἔσται καὶ οὐ μὴ εὐφρανθήσεται ἐν τοῖς χρήμασιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: There is none worse than he that envies himself, and this is the reward of his wickedness :
text_la: Qui sibi invidet, nihil est illo nequius : et hæc redditio est malitiæ illius.
text_pt: Estender-se-ão os seus galhos, e a sua glória será como a da oliveira, e sua fragrância como a do Líbano.
text_el: τοῦ βασκαίνοντος ἑαυτὸν οὐκ ἔστιν πονηρότερος καὶ τοῦτο ἀνταπόδομα τῆς κακίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And if he do good , he does it ignorantly , and unwillingly: and at the last he discovers his wickedness .
text_la: Et si bene fecerit, ignoranter et non volens facit : et in novissimo manifestat malitiam suam.
text_pt: Voltarão os que habitam debaixo da sua sombra; serão vivificados como o trigo, e florescerão como a vide; a sua memória será como o vinho do Líbano.
text_el: κἂν εὖ ποιῇ ἐν λήθῃ ποιεῖ καὶ ἐπ' ἐσχάτων ἐκφαίνει τὴν κακίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: The eye of the envious is wicked : and he turns away his face, and despises his own soul .
text_la: Nequam est oculus lividi : et avertens faciem suam, et despiciens animam suam.
text_pt: Efraim dirá: Que mais tenho eu com os ídolos? Eu o tenho ouvido, e cuidarei dele; eu sou como a faia verde; de mim é achado o teu fruto.
text_el: πονηρὸς ὁ βασκαίνων ὀφθαλμῷ ἀποστρέφων πρόσωπον καὶ ὑπερορῶν ψυχάς

text_en: The eye of the covetous man is insatiable in his portion of iniquity : he will not be satisfied till he consume his own soul , drying it up.
text_la: Insatiabilis oculus cupidi in parte iniquitatis : non satiabitur donec consumat arefaciens animam suam.
text_pt: Quem é sábio, para que entenda estas coisas? Quem é prudente, para que as saiba? Porque os caminhos do Senhor são retos, e os justos andarão neles, mas os transgressores neles cairão.
text_el: πλεονέκτου ὀφθαλμὸς οὐκ ἐμπίπλαται μερίδι καὶ ἀδικία πονηρὰ ἀναξηραίνει ψυχήν

text_en: An evil eye is towards evil things: and he shall not have his fill of bread, but shall be needy and pensive at his own table.
text_la: Oculus malus ad mala, et non saturabitur pane, sed indigens et in tristitia erit super mensam suam.
text_el: ὀφθαλμὸς πονηρὸς φθονερὸς ἐπ' ἄρτῳ καὶ ἐλλιπὴς ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης αὐτοῦ

text_en: My son, if you have anything, do good to yourself, and offer to God worthy offerings .
text_la: Fili, si habes, benefac tecum, et Deo dignas oblationes offer.
text_el: τέκνον καθὼς ἐὰν ἔχῃς εὖ ποίει σεαυτὸν καὶ προσφορὰς κυρίῳ ἀξίως πρόσαγε

text_en: Remember that death is not slow, and that the covenant of hell has been shown to you: for the covenant of this world shall surely die.
text_la: Memor esto quoniam mors non tardat, et testamentum inferorum, quia demonstratum est tibi : testamentum enim hujus mundi morte morietur.
text_el: μνήσθητι ὅτι θάνατος οὐ χρονιεῖ καὶ διαθήκη ᾅδου οὐχ ὑπεδείχθη σοι

text_en: Do good to your friend before you die, and according to your ability, stretching out your hand give to the poor.
text_la: Ante mortem benefac amico tuo, et secundum vires tuas exporrigens da pauperi.
text_el: πρίν σε τελευτῆσαι εὖ ποίει φίλῳ καὶ κατὰ τὴν ἰσχύν σου ἔκτεινον καὶ δὸς αὐτῷ

text_en: Defraud not yourself of the good day, and let not the part of a good gift overpass you.
text_la: Non defrauderis a die bono, et particula boni doni non te prætereat.
text_el: μὴ ἀφυστερήσῃς ἀπὸ ἀγαθῆς ἡμέρας καὶ μερὶς ἐπιθυμίας ἀγαθῆς μή σε παρελθάτω

text_en: Shall you not leave to others to divide by lot your sorrows and labours?
text_la: Nonne aliis relinques dolores et labores tuos in divisione sortis?
text_el: οὐχὶ ἑτέρῳ καταλείψεις τοὺς πόνους σου καὶ τοὺς κόπους σου εἰς διαίρεσιν κλήρου

text_en: Give and take, and justify your soul .
text_la: Da et accipe, et justifica animam tuam.
text_el: δὸς καὶ λαβὲ καὶ ἀπάτησον τὴν ψυχήν σου

text_en: Before your death work justice : for in hell there is no finding food.
text_la: Ante obitum tuum operare justitiam, quoniam non est apud inferos invenire cibum.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ᾅδου ζητῆσαι τρυφήν

text_en: All flesh shall fade as grass, and as the leaf that springs out on a green tree.
text_la: Omnis caro sicut fœnum veterascet, et sicut folium fructificans in arbore viridi.
text_el: πᾶσα σὰρξ ὡς ἱμάτιον παλαιοῦται ἡ γὰρ διαθήκη ἀπ' αἰῶνος θανάτῳ ἀποθανῇ ὡς φύλλον θάλλον ἐπὶ δένδρου δασέος

text_en: Some grow, and some fall off: so is the generation of flesh and blood, one comes to an end, and another is born.
text_la: Alia generantur, et alia dejiciuntur : sic generatio carnis et sanguinis, alia finitur, et alia nascitur.
text_el: τὰ μὲν καταβάλλει ἄλλα δὲ φύει οὕτως γενεὰ σαρκὸς καὶ αἵματος ἡ μὲν τελευτᾷ ἑτέρα δὲ γεννᾶται

text_en: Every work that is corruptible shall fail in the end: and the worker thereof shall go with it.
text_la: Omne opus corruptibile in fine deficiet, et qui illud operatur ibit cum illo.
text_el: πᾶν ἔργον σηπόμενον ἐκλείπει καὶ ὁ ἐργαζόμενος αὐτὸ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἀπελεύσεται

text_en: And every excellent work shall be justified: and the worker thereof shall be honoured therein.
text_la: Et omne opus electum justificabitur, et qui operatur illud honorabitur in illo.

text_en: Blessed is the man that shall continue in wisdom, and that shall meditate in his justice , and in his mind shall think of the all seeing eye of God .
text_la: Beatus vir qui in sapientia morabitur, et qui in justitia sua meditabitur, et in sensu cogitabit circumspectionem Dei :
text_el: μακάριος ἀνήρ ὃς ἐν σοφίᾳ μελετήσει καὶ ὃς ἐν συνέσει αὐτοῦ διαλεχθήσεται

text_en: He that considers her ways in his heart, and has understanding in her secrets, who goes after her as one that traces, and stays in her ways.
text_la: qui excogitat vias illius in corde suo, et in absconditis suis intelligens, vadens post illam quasi investigator, et in viis illius consistens :
text_el: ὁ διανοούμενος τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῆς ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀποκρύφοις αὐτῆς ἐννοηθήσεται ἔξελθε ὀπίσω αὐτῆς ὡς ἰχνευτὴς καὶ ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῆς ἐνέδρευε

text_en: He who looks in at her windows, and hearkens at her door.
text_la: qui respicit per fenestras illius, et in januis illius audiens :
text_el: ὁ παρακύπτων διὰ τῶν θυρίδων αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν θυρωμάτων αὐτῆς ἀκροάσεται

text_en: He that lodges near her house, and fastening a pin in her walls shall set up his tent high unto her, where good things shall rest in his lodging for ever.
text_la: qui requiescit juxta domum illius, et in parietibus illius figens palum, statuet casulam suam ad manus illius, et requiescent in casula illius bona per ævum.
text_el: ὁ καταλύων σύνεγγυς τοῦ οἴκου αὐτῆς καὶ πήξει πάσσαλον ἐν τοῖς τοίχοις αὐτῆς στήσει τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ κατὰ χεῖρας αὐτῆς καὶ καταλύσει ἐν καταλύματι ἀγαθῶν

text_en: He shall set his children under her shelter, and shall lodge under her branches:
text_la: Statuet filios suos sub tegmine illius, et sub ramis ejus morabitur.
text_el: θήσει τὰ τέκνα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκέπῃ αὐτῆς καὶ ὑπὸ τοὺς κλάδους αὐτῆς αὐλισθήσεται

text_en: He shall be protected under her covering from the heat, and shall rest in her glory .
text_la: Protegetur sub tegmine illius a fervore, et in gloria ejus requiescet.
text_el: σκεπασθήσεται ὑπ' αὐτῆς ἀπὸ καύματος καὶ ἐν τῇ δόξῃ αὐτῆς καταλύσει

text_en: He that fears God , will do good : and he that possesses justice , shall lay hold on her,
text_la: Qui timet Deum faciet bona, et qui continens est justitiæ apprehendet illam :
text_el: ὁ φοβούμενος κύριον ποιήσει αὐτό καὶ ὁ ἐγκρατὴς τοῦ νόμου καταλήμψεται αὐτήν

text_en: and she will meet him as an honourable mother, and will receive him as a wife married of a virgin .
text_la: et obviabit illi quasi mater honorificata, et quasi mulier a virginitate suscipiet illum.
text_el: καὶ ὑπαντήσεται αὐτῷ ὡς μήτηρ καὶ ὡς γυνὴ παρθενίας προσδέξεται αὐτόν

text_en: With the bread of life and understanding, she shall feed him, and give him the water of wholesome wisdom to drink: and she shall be made strong in him, and he shall not be moved.
text_la: Cibabit illum pane vitæ et intellectus, et aqua sapientiæ salutaris potabit illum : et firmabitur in illo, et non flectetur :
text_el: ψωμιεῖ αὐτὸν ἄρτον συνέσεως καὶ ὕδωρ σοφίας ποτίσει αὐτόν στηριχθήσεται ἐπ' αὐτὴν καὶ οὐ μὴ κλιθῇ

text_en: And she shall hold him fast, and he shall not be confounded: and she shall exalt him among his neighbours.
text_la: et continebit illum, et non confundetur : et exaltabit illum apud proximos suos,
text_el: καὶ ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἐφέξει καὶ οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ καὶ ὑψώσει αὐτὸν παρὰ τοὺς πλησίον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And in the midst of the church she shall open his mouth, and shall fill him with the spirit of wisdom and understanding, and shall clothe him with a robe of glory .
text_la: et in medio ecclesiæ aperiet os ejus, et adimplebit illum spiritu sapientiæ et intellectus, et stola gloriæ vestiet illum.
text_el: καὶ ἐν μέσῳ ἐκκλησίας ἀνοίξει τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ

text_en: She shall heap upon him a treasure of joy and gladness , and shall cause him to inherit an everlasting name .
text_la: Jucunditatem et exsultationem thesaurizabit super illum, et nomine æterno hæreditabit illum.
text_el: εὐφροσύνην καὶ στέφανον ἀγαλλιάματος εὑρήσει καὶ ὄνομα αἰῶνος κατακληρονομήσει

text_en: But foolish men shall not obtain her, and wise men shall meet her, foolish men shall not see her: for she is far from pride and deceit .
text_la: Homines stulti non apprehendent illam, et homines sensati obviabunt illi. Homines stulti non videbunt eam : longe enim abest a superbia et dolo.
text_el: οὐ μὴ καταλήμψονται αὐτὴν ἄνθρωποι ἀσύνετοι καὶ ἄνδρες ἁμαρτωλοὶ οὐ μὴ ἴδωσιν αὐτήν

text_en: Lying men shall be mindful of her: but men that speak truth shall be found with her, and shall advance, even till they come to the sight of God .
text_la: Viri mendaces non erunt illius memores : et viri veraces invenientur in illa, et successum habebunt usque ad inspectionem Dei.
text_el: μακράν ἐστιν ὑπερηφανίας καὶ ἄνδρες ψεῦσται οὐ μὴ μνησθήσονται αὐτῆς

text_en: Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner:
text_la: Non est speciosa laus in ore peccatoris,
text_el: οὐχ ὡραῖος αἶνος ἐν στόματι ἁμαρτωλοῦ

text_en: For wisdom came forth from God : for praise shall be with the wisdom of God , and shall abound in a faithful mouth, and the sovereign Lord will give praise unto it.
text_la: quoniam a Deo profecta est sapientia. Sapientiæ enim Dei astabit laus, et in ore fideli abundabit, et Dominator dabit eam illi.
text_el: ὅτι οὐ παρὰ κυρίου ἀπεστάλη ἐν γὰρ σοφίᾳ ῥηθήσεται αἶνος καὶ ὁ κύριος εὐοδώσει αὐτόν

text_en: Say not: It is through God , that she is not with me: for do not do the things that he hates .
text_la: Non dixeris : Per Deum abest : quæ enim odit ne feceris.
text_el: μὴ εἴπῃς ὅτι διὰ κύριον ἀπέστην ἃ γὰρ ἐμίσησεν οὐ ποιήσει

text_en: Say not: He has caused me to err : for he has no need of wicked men .
text_la: Non dicas : Ille me implanavit : non enim necessarii sunt ei homines impii.
text_el: μὴ εἴπῃς ὅτι αὐτός με ἐπλάνησεν οὐ γὰρ χρείαν ἔχει ἀνδρὸς ἁμαρτωλοῦ

text_en: The Lord hates all abomination of error , and they that fear him shall not love it.
text_la: Omne execramentum erroris odit Dominus, et non erit amabile timentibus eum.
text_el: πᾶν βδέλυγμα ἐμίσησεν ὁ κύριος καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀγαπητὸν τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτόν

text_en: God made man from the beginning, and left him in the hand of his own counsel.
text_la: Deus ab initio constituit hominem, et reliquit illum in manu consilii sui :
text_el: αὐτὸς ἐξ ἀρχῆς ἐποίησεν ἄνθρωπον καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὸν ἐν χειρὶ διαβουλίου αὐτοῦ

text_en: He added his commandments and precepts .
text_la: adjecit mandata et præcepta sua.

text_en: If you will keep the commandments and perform acceptable fidelity for ever, they shall preserve you.
text_la: Si volueris mandata servare, conservabunt te, et in perpetuum fidem placitam facere.
text_el: ἐὰν θέλῃς συντηρήσεις ἐντολὰς καὶ πίστιν ποιῆσαι εὐδοκίας

text_en: He has set water and fire before you: stretch forth your hand to which you will.
text_la: Apposuit tibi aquam et ignem, ad quod volueris porrige manum tuam.
text_el: παρέθηκέν σοι πῦρ καὶ ὕδωρ οὗ ἐὰν θέλῃς ἐκτενεῖς τὴν χεῖρά σου

text_en: Before man is life and death, good and evil , that which he shall choose shall be given him:
text_la: Ante hominem vita et mors, bonum et malum : quod placuerit ei dabitur illi :
text_el: ἔναντι ἀνθρώπων ἡ ζωὴ καὶ ὁ θάνατος καὶ ὃ ἐὰν εὐδοκήσῃ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ

text_en: For the wisdom of God is great, and he is strong in power, seeing all men without ceasing.
text_la: quoniam multa sapientia Dei, et fortis in potentia, videns omnes sine intermissione.
text_el: ὅτι πολλὴ ἡ σοφία τοῦ κυρίου ἰσχυρὸς ἐν δυναστείᾳ καὶ βλέπων τὰ πάντα

text_en: The eyes of the Lord are towards them that fear him, and he knows al the work of man .
text_la: Oculi Domini ad timentes eum, et ipse agnoscit omnem operam hominis.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς φοβουμένους αὐτόν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπιγνώσεται πᾶν ἔργον ἀνθρώπου

text_en: He has commanded no man to do wickedly , and he has given no man license to sin ;
text_la: Nemini mandavit impie agere, et nemini dedit spatium peccandi :
text_el: οὐκ ἐνετείλατο οὐδενὶ ἀσεβεῖν καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκεν ἄνεσιν οὐδενὶ ἁμαρτάνειν

text_en: for he desires not a multitude of faithless and unprofitable children.
text_la: non enim concupiscit multitudinem filiorum infidelium et inutilium.

text_en: Rejoice not in ungodly children, if they be multiplied: neither be delighted in them, if the fear of God be not with them.
text_la: Ne jucunderis in filiis impiis, si multiplicentur : nec oblecteris super ipsos, si non est timor Dei in illis.
text_el: μὴ ἐπιθύμει τέκνων πλῆθος ἀχρήστων μηδὲ εὐφραίνου ἐπὶ υἱοῖς ἀσεβέσιν ἐὰν πληθύνωσιν μὴ εὐφραίνου ἐπ' αὐτοῖς εἰ μή ἐστιν φόβος κυρίου μετ' αὐτῶν

text_en: Trust not to their life, and respect not their labours.
text_la: Non credas vitæ illorum, et ne respexeris in labores eorum.
text_el: μὴ ἐμπιστεύσῃς τῇ ζωῇ αὐτῶν καὶ μὴ ἔπεχε ἐπὶ τὸ πλῆθος αὐτῶν

text_en: For better is one that fears God , than a thousand ungodly children.
text_la: Melior est enim unus timens Deum, quam mille filii impii :
text_el: κρείσσων γὰρ εἷς ἢ χίλιοι

text_en: And it is better to die without children, than to leave ungodly children.
text_la: et utile est mori sine filiis, quam relinquere filios impios.
text_el: καὶ ἀποθανεῖν ἄτεκνον ἢ ἔχειν τέκνα ἀσεβῆ

text_en: By one that is wise a country shall be inhabited, the tribe of the ungodly shall become desolate.
text_la: Ab uno sensato inhabitabitur patria : tribus impiorum deseretur.
text_el: ἀπὸ γὰρ ἑνὸς συνετοῦ συνοικισθήσεται πόλις φυλὴ δὲ ἀνόμων ἐρημωθήσεται

text_en: Many such things has my eyes seen, and greater things than these my ear has heard.
text_la: Multa talia vidit oculis meus, et fortiora horum audivit auris mea.
text_el: πολλὰ τοιαῦτα ἑόρακεν ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου καὶ ἰσχυρότερα τούτων ἀκήκοεν τὸ οὖς μου

text_en: In the congregation of sinners a fire shall be kindled, and in an unbelieving nation wrath shall flame out.
text_la: In synagoga peccantium exardebit ignis, et in gente incredibili exardescet ira.
text_el: ἐν συναγωγῇ ἁμαρτωλῶν ἐκκαυθήσεται πῦρ καὶ ἐν ἔθνει ἀπειθεῖ ἐξεκαύθη ὀργή

text_en: The ancient giants did not obtain pardon for their sins , who were destroyed trusting to their own strength:
text_la: Non exoraverunt pro peccatis suis antiqui gigantes, qui destructi sunt confidentes suæ virtuti.
text_el: οὐκ ἐξιλάσατο περὶ τῶν ἀρχαίων γιγάντων οἳ ἀπέστησαν τῇ ἰσχύι αὐτῶν

text_en: And he spared not the place where Lot sojourned , but abhorred them for the pride of their word.
text_la: Et non pepercit peregrinationi Lot, et execratus est eos præ superbia verbi illorum.
text_el: οὐκ ἐφείσατο περὶ τῆς παροικίας Λωτ οὓς ἐβδελύξατο διὰ τὴν ὑπερηφανίαν αὐτῶν

text_en: He had not pity on them, destroying the whole nation that extolled themselves in their sins .
text_la: Non misertus est illis, gentem totam perdens, et extollentem se in peccatis suis.
text_el: οὐκ ἠλέησεν ἔθνος ἀπωλείας τοὺς ἐξηρμένους ἐν ἁμαρτίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: So did he with the six hundred thousand footmen, who were gathered together in the hardness of their heart: and if one had been stiffnecked, it is a wonder if he had escaped unpunished:
text_la: Et sicut sexcenta millia peditum, qui congregati sunt in duritia cordis sui : et si unus fuisset cervicatus, mirum si fuisset immunis.
text_el: καὶ οὕτως ἑξακοσίας χιλιάδας πεζῶν τοὺς ἐπισυναχθέντας ἐν σκληροκαρδίᾳ αὐτῶν κἂν ᾖ εἷς σκληροτράχηλος θαυμαστὸν τοῦτο εἰ ἀθῳωθήσεται

text_en: For mercy and wrath are with him. He is mighty to forgive, and to pour out indignation:
text_la: Misericordia enim et ira est cum illo : potens exoratio, et effundens iram.
text_el: ἔλεος γὰρ καὶ ὀργὴ παρ' αὐτῷ δυνάστης ἐξιλασμῶν καὶ ἐκχέων ὀργήν

text_en: According as his mercy is, so his correction judges a man according to his works.
text_la: Secundum misericordiam suam, sic correptio illius homines secundum opera sua judicat.
text_el: κατὰ τὸ πολὺ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ οὕτως καὶ πολὺς ὁ ἔλεγχος αὐτοῦ ἄνδρα κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ κρινεῖ

text_en: The sinner shall not escape in his rapines, and the patience of him that shows mercy shall not be put off.
text_la: Non effugiet in rapina peccator, et non retardabit sufferentia misericordiam facientis.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκφεύξεται ἐν ἁρπάγματι ἁμαρτωλός καὶ οὐ μὴ καθυστερήσει ὑπομονὴ εὐσεβοῦς

text_en: All mercy shall make a place for every man according to the merit of his works, and according to the wisdom of his sojournment.
text_la: Omnis misericordia faciet locum unicuique, secundum meritum operum suorum, et secundum intellectum peregrinationis ipsius.
text_el: πάσῃ ἐλεημοσύνῃ ποιήσει τόπον ἕκαστος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ εὑρήσει

text_en: Say not: I shall be hidden from God , and who shall remember me from on high?
text_la: Non dicas : A Deo abscondar : et ex summo, quis mei memorabitur?
text_el: μὴ εἴπῃς ὅτι ἀπὸ κυρίου κρυβήσομαι καὶ ἐξ ὕψους τίς μου μνησθήσεται

text_en: In such a multitude I shall not be known : for what is my soul in such an immense creation?
text_la: in populo magno non agnoscar : quæ est enim anima mea in tam immensa creatura?
text_el: ἐν λαῷ πλείονι οὐ μὴ γνωσθῶ τίς γὰρ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν ἀμετρήτῳ κτίσει

text_en: Behold the heaven , and the heavens of heavens , the deep , and all the earth, and the things that are in them, shall be moved in his sight,
text_la: Ecce cælum et cæli cælorum, abyssus, et universa terra, et quæ in eis sunt, in conspectu illius commovebuntur.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἄβυσσος καὶ γῆ ἐν τῇ ἐπισκοπῇ αὐτοῦ σαλευθήσονται

text_en: the mountains also, and the hills, and the foundations of the earth: when God shall look upon them, they shall be shaken with trembling.
text_la: Montes simul, et colles, et fundamenta terræ, cum conspexerit illa Deus, tremore concutientur.
text_el: ἅμα τὰ ὄρη καὶ τὰ θεμέλια τῆς γῆς ἐν τῷ ἐπιβλέψαι εἰς αὐτὰ τρόμῳ συσσείονται

text_en: And in all these things the heart is senseless: and every heart is understood by him.
text_la: Et in omnibus his insensatum est cor, et omne cor intelligitur ab illo.
text_el: καὶ ἐπ' αὐτοῖς οὐ διανοηθήσεται καρδία

text_en: And his ways who shall understand, and the storm, which no eye of man shall see?
text_la: Et vias illius quis intelligit, et procellam quam nec oculus videbit hominis?
text_el: καὶ τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ τίς ἐνθυμηθήσεται καὶ καταιγίς ἣν οὐκ ὄψεται ἄνθρωπος

text_en: For many of his works are hidden, but the works of his justice who shall declare? Or who shall endure? For the testament is far from some, and the examination of all is in the end.
text_la: Nam plurima illius opera sunt in absconsis : sed opera justitiæ ejus quis enuntiabit, aut quis sustinebit? longe enim est testamentum a quibusdam, et interrogatio omnium in consummatione est.
text_el: τὰ δὲ πλείονα τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀποκρύφοις ἔργα δικαιοσύνης τίς ἀναγγελεῖ ἢ τίς ὑπομενεῖ μακρὰν γὰρ ἡ διαθήκη

text_en: He that wants understanding thinks vain things, and the foolish, and erring man , thinks foolish things.
text_la: Qui minoratur corde cogitat inania, et vir imprudens et errans cogitat stulta.
text_el: ἐλαττούμενος καρδίᾳ διανοεῖται ταῦτα καὶ ἀνὴρ ἄφρων καὶ πλανώμενος διανοεῖται μωρά

text_en: Hearken to me, my son, and learn the discipline of understanding, and attend to my words in your heart.
text_la: Audi me, fili, et disce disciplinam sensus, et in verbis meis attende in corde tuo :
text_el: ἄκουσόν μου τέκνον καὶ μάθε ἐπιστήμην καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν λόγων μου πρόσεχε τῇ καρδίᾳ σου

text_en: And I will show forth good doctrine in equity, and will seek to declare wisdom: and attend to my words in your heart, whilst with equity of spirit I tell you the virtues that God has put upon his works from the beginning, and I show forth in truth his knowledge .
text_la: et dicam in æquitate disciplinam, et scrutabor enarrare sapientiam : et in verbis meis attende in corde tuo, et dico in æquitate spiritus virtutes quas posuit Deus in opera sua ab initio, et in veritate enuntio scientiam ejus.
text_el: ἐκφανῶ ἐν σταθμῷ παιδείαν καὶ ἐν ἀκριβείᾳ ἀπαγγελῶ ἐπιστήμην
