text_en: The sun giving light has looked upon all things, and full of the glory of the Lord is his work.
text_la: Sol illuminans per omnia respexit, et gloria Domini plenum est opus ejus.
text_el: ἥλιος φωτίζων κατὰ πᾶν ἐπέβλεψεν καὶ τῆς δόξης κυρίου πλῆρες τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Hath not the Lord made the saints to declare all his wonderful works, which the Lord Almighty has firmly settled to be established for his glory ?
text_la: Nonne Dominus fecit sanctos enarrare omnia mirabilia sua, quæ confirmavit Dominus omnipotens stabiliri in gloria sua?
text_el: οὐκ ἐξεποίησεν τοῖς ἁγίοις κυρίου ἐκδιηγήσασθαι πάντα τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ ἃ ἐστερέωσεν κύριος ὁ παντοκράτωρ στηριχθῆναι ἐν δόξῃ αὐτοῦ τὸ πᾶν

text_en: He has searched out the deep, and the heart of men : and considered their crafty devices.
text_la: Abyssum et cor hominum investigavit, et in astutia eorum excogitavit.
text_el: ἄβυσσον καὶ καρδίαν ἐξίχνευσεν καὶ ἐν πανουργεύμασιν αὐτῶν διενοήθη

text_en: For the Lord knows all knowledge , and has beheld the signs of the world, he declares the things that are past, and the things that are to come, and reveals the traces of hidden things.
text_la: Cognovit enim Dominus omnem scientiam, et inspexit in signum ævi, annuntians quæ præterierunt et quæ superventura sunt, revelans vestigia occultorum.
text_el: ἔγνω γὰρ ὁ ὕψιστος πᾶσαν εἴδησιν καὶ ἐνέβλεψεν εἰς σημεῖον αἰῶνος ἀπαγγέλλων τὰ παρεληλυθότα καὶ τὰ ἐσόμενα καὶ ἀποκαλύπτων ἴχνη ἀποκρύφων

text_en: No thought escapes him, and no word can hide itself from him.
text_la: Non præterit illum omnis cogitatus, et non abscondit se ab eo ullus sermo.
text_el: οὐ παρῆλθεν αὐτὸν πᾶν διανόημα οὐκ ἐκρύβη ἀπ' αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ εἷς λόγος

text_en: He has beautified the glorious works of his wisdom: and he is from eternity to eternity , and to him nothing may be added,
text_la: Magnalia sapientiæ suæ decoravit, qui est ante sæculum et usque in sæculum : neque adjectum est,
text_el: τὰ μεγαλεῖα τῆς σοφίας αὐτοῦ ἐκόσμησεν ὡς ἔστιν πρὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα οὔτε προσετέθη

text_en: nor can he be diminished, and he has no need of any counsellor.
text_la: neque minuitur, et non eget alicujus consilio.
text_el: οὔτε ἠλαττώθη καὶ οὐ προσεδεήθη οὐδενὸς συμβούλου

text_en: O how desirable are all his works, and what we can know is but as a spark!
text_la: Quam desiderabilia omnia opera ejus! et tamquam scintilla quæ est considerare!
text_el: ὡς πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐπιθυμητὰ καὶ ὡς σπινθῆρός ἐστιν θεωρῆσαι

text_en: All these things live, and remain for ever, and for every use all things obey him.
text_la: Omnia hæc vivunt, et manent in sæculum, et in omni necessitate omnia obaudiunt ei.
text_el: πάντα ταῦτα ζῇ καὶ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐν πάσαις χρείαις καὶ πάντα ὑπακούει

text_en: All things are double, one against another, and he has made nothing defective.
text_la: Omnia duplicia, unum contra unum, et non fecit quidquam deesse.
text_el: πάντα δισσά ἓν κατέναντι τοῦ ἑνός καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησεν οὐδὲν ἐλλεῖπον

text_en: He has established the good things of every one. And who shall be filled with beholding his glory ?
text_la: Uniuscujusque confirmavit bona : et quis satiabitur videns gloriam ejus?
text_el: ἓν τοῦ ἑνὸς ἐστερέωσεν τὰ ἀγαθά καὶ τίς πλησθήσεται ὁρῶν δόξαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: The firmament on high is his beauty, the beauty of heaven with its glorious show.
text_la: Altitudinis firmamentum pulchritudo ejus est, species cæli in visione gloriæ.
text_el: γαυρίαμα ὕψους στερέωμα καθαριότητος εἶδος οὐρανοῦ ἐν ὁράματι δόξης

text_en: The sun when he appears showing forth at his rising, an admirable instrument, the work of the most High .
text_la: Sol in aspectu annuntians in exitu, vas admirabile, opus Excelsi.
text_el: ἥλιος ἐν ὀπτασίᾳ διαγγέλλων ἐν ἐξόδῳ σκεῦος θαυμαστόν ἔργον ὑψίστου

text_en: At noon he burns the earth, and who can abide his burning heat? As one keeping a furnace in the works of heat:
text_la: In meridiano exurit terram, et in conspectu ardoris ejus quis poterit sustinere? fornacem custodiens in operibus ardoris :
text_el: ἐν μεσημβρίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἀναξηραίνει χώραν καὶ ἐναντίον καύματος αὐτοῦ τίς ὑποστήσεται κάμινον φυσῶν ἐν ἔργοις καύματος

text_en: The sun three times as much, burns the mountains, breathing out fiery vapours, and shining with his beams, he blinds the eyes.
text_la: tripliciter sol exurens montes, radios igneos exsufflans, et refulgens radiis suis obcæcat oculos.
text_el: τριπλασίως ἥλιος ἐκκαίων ὄρη ἀτμίδας πυρώδεις ἐκφυσῶν καὶ ἐκλάμπων ἀκτῖνας ἀμαυροῖ ὀφθαλμούς

text_en: Great is the Lord that made him, and at his words he has hastened his course.
text_la: Magnus Dominus qui fecit illum, et in sermonibus ejus festinavit iter.
text_el: μέγας κύριος ὁ ποιήσας αὐτόν καὶ ἐν λόγοις αὐτοῦ κατέσπευσεν πορείαν

text_en: And the moon in all in her season, is for a declaration of times and a sign of the world.
text_la: Et luna in omnibus in tempore suo, ostensio temporis, et signum ævi.
text_el: καὶ ἡ σελήνη ἐν πᾶσιν εἰς καιρὸν αὐτῆς ἀνάδειξιν χρόνων καὶ σημεῖον αἰῶνος

text_en: From the moon is the sign of the festival day, a light that decreases in her perfection.
text_la: A luna signum diei festi : luminare quod minuitur in consummatione.
text_el: ἀπὸ σελήνης σημεῖον ἑορτῆς φωστὴρ μειούμενος ἐπὶ συντελείας

text_en: The month is called after her name , increasing wonderfully in her perfection.
text_la: Mensis secundum nomen ejus est, crescens mirabiliter in consummatione.
text_el: μὴν κατὰ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς ἐστιν αὐξανόμενος θαυμαστῶς ἐν ἀλλοιώσει

text_en: Being an instrument of the armies on high, shining gloriously in the firmament of heaven .
text_la: Vas castrorum in excelsis, in firmamento cæli resplendens gloriose.
text_el: σκεῦος παρεμβολῶν ἐν ὕψει ἐν στερεώματι οὐρανοῦ ἐκλάμπων

text_en: The glory of the stars is the beauty of heaven ; the Lord enlightens the world on high.
text_la: Species cæli gloria stellarum : mundum illuminans in excelsis Dominus.
text_el: κάλλος οὐρανοῦ δόξα ἄστρων κόσμος φωτίζων ἐν ὑψίστοις κυρίου

text_en: By the words of the holy one they stand in judgment, and shall never fall in their watches.
text_la: In verbis Sancti stabunt ad judicium, et non deficient in vigiliis suis.
text_el: ἐν λόγοις ἁγίου στήσονται κατὰ κρίμα καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκλυθῶσιν ἐν φυλακαῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: Look upon the rainbow, and bless him that made it: it is very beautiful in its brightness.
text_la: Vide arcum, et benedic eum qui fecit illum : valde speciosus est in splendore suo.
text_el: ἰδὲ τόξον καὶ εὐλόγησον τὸν ποιήσαντα αὐτὸ σφόδρα ὡραῖον ἐν τῷ αὐγάσματι αὐτοῦ

text_en: It encompasses the heaven about with the circle of its glory , the hands of the most High have displayed it.
text_la: Gyravit cælum in circuitu gloriæ suæ : manus Excelsi aperuerunt illum.
text_el: ἐγύρωσεν οὐρανὸν ἐν κυκλώσει δόξης χεῖρες ὑψίστου ἐτάνυσαν αὐτό

text_en: By his commandment he makes the snow to fall apace, and sends forth swiftly the lightnings of his judgment.
text_la: Imperio suo acceleravit nivem, et accelerat coruscationes emittere judicii sui.
text_el: προστάγματι αὐτοῦ κατέσπευσεν χιόνα καὶ ταχύνει ἀστραπὰς κρίματος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Through this are the treasures opened, and the clouds fly out like birds.
text_la: Propterea aperti sunt thesauri, et evolaverunt nebulæ sicut aves.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἠνεῴχθησαν θησαυροί καὶ ἐξέπτησαν νεφέλαι ὡς πετεινά

text_en: By his greatness he has fixed the clouds, and the hailstones are broken.
text_la: In magnitudine sua posuit nubes, et confracti sunt lapides grandinis.
text_el: ἐν μεγαλείῳ αὐτοῦ ἴσχυσεν νεφέλας καὶ διεθρύβησαν λίθοι χαλάζης

text_en: At his sight shall the mountains be shaken, and at his will the south wind shall blow.
text_la: In conspectu ejus commovebuntur montes, et in voluntate ejus aspirabit notus.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ὀπτασίᾳ αὐτοῦ σαλευθήσεται ὄρη ἐν θελήματι αὐτοῦ πνεύσεται νότος

text_en: The noise of his thunder shall strike the earth, so does the northern storm, and the whirlwind:
text_la: Vox tonitrui ejus verberavit terram, tempestas aquilonis, et congregatio spiritus :
text_el: φωνὴ βροντῆς αὐτοῦ ὠνείδισεν γῆν καὶ καταιγὶς βορέου καὶ συστροφὴ πνεύματος

text_en: And as the birds lighting upon the earth, he scatters snow, and the falling thereof, is as the coming down of locusts.
text_la: et sicut avis deponens ad sedendum, aspergit nivem, et sicut locusta demergens descensus ejus.
text_el: ὡς πετεινὰ καθιπτάμενα πάσσει χιόνα καὶ ὡς ἀκρὶς καταλύουσα ἡ κατάβασις αὐτῆς

text_en: The eye admires at the beauty of the whiteness thereof, and the heart is astonished at the shower thereof.
text_la: Pulchritudinem candoris ejus admirabitur oculus, et super imbrem ejus expavescet cor.
text_el: κάλλος λευκότητος αὐτῆς ἐκθαυμάσει ὀφθαλμός καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ ὑετοῦ αὐτῆς ἐκστήσεται καρδία

text_en: He shall pour frost as salt upon the earth: and when it freezes, it shall become like the tops of thistles.
text_la: Gelu sicut salem effundet super terram : et dum gelaverit, fiet tamquam cacumina tribuli.
text_el: καὶ πάχνην ὡς ἅλα ἐπὶ γῆς χέει καὶ παγεῖσα γίνεται σκολόπων ἄκρα

text_en: The cold north wind blows, and the water is congealed into crystal; upon every gathering together of waters it shall rest, and shall clothe the waters as a breastplate.
text_la: Frigidus ventus aquilo flavit, et gelavit crystallus ab aqua : super omnem congregationem aquarum requiescet, et sicut lorica induet se aquis :
text_el: ψυχρὸς ἄνεμος βορέης πνεύσει καὶ παγήσεται κρύσταλλος ἐφ' ὕδατος ἐπὶ πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν ὕδατος καταλύσει καὶ ὡς θώρακα ἐνδύσεται τὸ ὕδωρ

text_en: And it shall devour the mountains, and burn the wilderness , and consume all that is green as with fire.
text_la: et devorabit montes, et exuret desertum, et extinguet viride, sicut igne.
text_el: καταφάγεται ὄρη καὶ ἔρημον ἐκκαύσει καὶ ἀποσβέσει χλόην ὡς πῦρ

text_en: A present remedy of all is the speedy coming of a cloud, and a dew that meets it, by the heat that comes, shall overpower it.
text_la: Medicina omnium in festinatione nebulæ : et ros obvians ab ardore venienti humilem efficiet eum.
text_el: ἴασις πάντων κατὰ σπουδὴν ὁμίχλη δρόσος ἀπαντῶσα ἀπὸ καύσωνος ἱλαρώσει

text_en: At his word the wind is still, and with his thought he appeases the deep, and the Lord has planted islands therein.
text_la: In sermone ejus siluit ventus, et cogitatione sua placavit abyssum : et plantavit in illa Dominus insulas.
text_el: λογισμῷ αὐτοῦ ἐκόπασεν ἄβυσσον καὶ ἐφύτευσεν ἐν αὐτῇ νήσους

text_en: Let them that sail on the sea, tell the dangers thereof: and when we hear with our ears, we shall admire.
text_la: Qui navigant mare enarrent pericula ejus, et audientes auribus nostris admirabimur.
text_el: οἱ πλέοντες τὴν θάλασσαν διηγοῦνται τὸν κίνδυνον αὐτῆς καὶ ἀκοαῖς ὠτίων ἡμῶν θαυμάζομεν

text_en: There are great and wonderful works: a variety of beasts, and of all living things, and the monstrous creatures of whales.
text_la: Illic præclara opera et mirabilia, varia bestiarum genera, et omnium pecorum, et creatura belluarum.
text_el: καὶ ἐκεῖ τὰ παράδοξα καὶ θαυμάσια ἔργα ποικιλία παντὸς ζῴου κτίσις κητῶν

text_en: Through him is established the end of their journey, and by his word all things are regulated.
text_la: Propter ipsum confirmatus est itineris finis, et in sermone ejus composita sunt omnia.
text_el: δι' αὐτὸν εὐοδοῖ ἄγγελος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν λόγῳ αὐτοῦ σύγκειται τὰ πάντα

text_en: We shall say much, and yet shall want words: but the sum of our words is, He is all.
text_la: Multa dicemus, et deficiemus in verbis : consummatio autem sermonum ipse est in omnibus.
text_el: πολλὰ ἐροῦμεν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀφικώμεθα καὶ συντέλεια λόγων τὸ πᾶν ἐστιν αὐτός

text_en: What shall we be able to do to glorify him? For the Almighty himself is above all his works.
text_la: Gloriantes ad quid valebimus? ipse enim omnipotens super omnia opera sua.
text_el: δοξάζοντες ποῦ ἰσχύσομεν αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ μέγας παρὰ πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord is terrible, and exceeding great, and his power is admirable.
text_la: Terribilis Dominus, et magnus vehementer, et mirabilis potentia ipsius.
text_el: φοβερὸς κύριος καὶ σφόδρα μέγας καὶ θαυμαστὴ ἡ δυναστεία αὐτοῦ

text_en: Glorify the Lord as much as ever you can, for he will yet far exceed, and his magnificence is wonderful.
text_la: Glorificantes Dominum quantumcumque potueritis, supervalebit enim adhuc : et admirabilis magnificentia ejus.
text_el: δοξάζοντες κύριον ὑψώσατε καθ' ὅσον ἂν δύνησθε ὑπερέξει γὰρ καὶ ἔτι

text_en: Blessing the Lord , exalt him as much as you can; for he is above all praise.
text_la: Benedicentes Dominum, exaltate illum quantum potestis : major enim est omni laude.

text_en: When you exalt him put forth all your strength, and be not weary: for you can never go far enough.
text_la: Exaltantes eum, replemini virtute, ne laboretis, non enim comprehendetis.
text_el: καὶ ὑψοῦντες αὐτὸν πληθύνατε ἐν ἰσχύι μὴ κοπιᾶτε οὐ γὰρ μὴ ἀφίκησθε

text_en: Who shall see him, and declare him? And who shall magnify him as he is from the beginning?
text_la: Quis videbit eum et enarrabit? et quis magnificabit eum sicut est ab initio?
text_el: τίς ἑόρακεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐκδιηγήσεται καὶ τίς μεγαλυνεῖ αὐτὸν καθώς ἐστιν

text_en: There are many things hidden from us that are greater than these: for we have seen but a few of his works.
text_la: Multa abscondita sunt majora his : pauca enim vidimus operum ejus.
text_el: πολλὰ ἀπόκρυφά ἐστιν μείζονα τούτων ὀλίγα γὰρ ἑωράκαμεν τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ

text_en: But the Lord has made all things, and to the godly he has given wisdom.
text_la: Omnia autem Dominus fecit, et pie agentibus dedit sapientiam.
text_el: πάντα γὰρ ἐποίησεν ὁ κύριος καὶ τοῖς εὐσεβέσιν ἔδωκεν σοφίαν

text_en: Let us now praise men of renown and our fathers in their generation .
text_la: Laudemus viros gloriosos, et parentes nostros in generatione sua.
text_el: αἰνέσωμεν δὴ ἄνδρας ἐνδόξους καὶ τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν τῇ γενέσει

text_en: The Lord has wrought great glory through his magnificence from the beginning.
text_la: Multam gloriam fecit Dominus : magnificentia sua a sæculo.
text_el: πολλὴν δόξαν ἔκτισεν ὁ κύριος τὴν μεγαλωσύνην αὐτοῦ ἀπ' αἰῶνος

text_en: Such as have borne rule in their dominions, men of great power, and endued with their wisdom, showing forth in the prophets the dignity of prophets ,
text_la: Dominantes in potestatibus suis, homines magni virtute et prudentia sua præditi, nuntiantes in prophetis dignitatem prophetarum :
text_el: κυριεύοντες ἐν ταῖς βασιλείαις αὐτῶν καὶ ἄνδρες ὀνομαστοὶ ἐν δυνάμει βουλεύοντες ἐν συνέσει αὐτῶν ἀπηγγελκότες ἐν προφητείαις

text_en: and ruling over the present people, and by the strength of wisdom instructing the people in most holy words.
text_la: et imperantes in præsenti populo, et virtute prudentiæ populis sanctissima verba :
text_el: ἡγούμενοι λαοῦ ἐν διαβουλίοις καὶ συνέσει γραμματείας λαοῦ

text_en: Such as by their skill sought out musical tunes, and published canticles of the scriptures .
text_la: in peritia sua requirentes modos musicos, et narrantes carmina Scripturarum :
text_el: σοφοὶ λόγοι ἐν παιδείᾳ αὐτῶν ἐκζητοῦντες μέλη μουσικῶν καὶ διηγούμενοι ἔπη ἐν γραφῇ

text_en: Rich men in virtue , studying beautifulness: living at peace in their houses.
text_la: homines divites in virtute, pulchritudinis studium habentes, pacificantes in domibus suis.
text_el: ἄνδρες πλούσιοι κεχορηγημένοι ἰσχύι εἰρηνεύοντες ἐν κατοικίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: All these have gained glory in their generations , and were praised in their days.
text_la: Omnes isti in generationibus gentis suæ gloriam adepti sunt, et in diebus suis habentur in laudibus.
text_el: πάντες οὗτοι ἐν γενεαῖς ἐδοξάσθησαν καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῶν καύχημα

text_en: They that were born of them have left a name behind them, that their praises might be related:
text_la: Qui de illis nati sunt reliquerunt nomen narrandi laudes eorum.
text_el: εἰσὶν αὐτῶν οἳ κατέλιπον ὄνομα τοῦ ἐκδιηγήσασθαι ἐπαίνους

text_en: And there are some, of whom there is no memorial: who are perished, as if they had never been: and have become as if they had never been born, and their children with them.
text_la: Et sunt quorum non est memoria : perierunt quasi qui non fuerint : et nati sunt quasi non nati, et filii ipsorum cum ipsis.
text_el: καὶ εἰσὶν ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν μνημόσυνον καὶ ἀπώλοντο ὡς οὐχ ὑπάρξαντες καὶ ἐγένοντο ὡς οὐ γεγονότες καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν μετ' αὐτούς

text_en: But these were men of mercy, whose godly deeds have not failed:
text_la: Sed illi viri misericordiæ sunt, quorum pietates non defuerunt.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ οὗτοι ἄνδρες ἐλέους ὧν αἱ δικαιοσύναι οὐκ ἐπελήσθησαν

text_en: Good things continue with their seed,
text_la: Cum semine eorum permanent bona :
text_el: μετὰ τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτῶν διαμενεῖ

text_en: their posterity are a holy inheritance, and their seed has stood in the covenants.
text_la: hæreditas sancta nepotes eorum, et in testamentis stetit semen eorum :
text_el: ἀγαθὴ κληρονομία ἔκγονα αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς διαθήκαις ἔστη τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν

text_en: And their children for their sakes remain for ever: their seed and their glory shall not be forsaken.
text_la: et filii eorum propter illos usque in æternum manent : semen eorum et gloria eorum non derelinquetur.
text_el: καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν δι' αὐτούς ἕως αἰῶνος μενεῖ σπέρμα αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ δόξα αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐξαλειφθήσεται

text_en: Their bodies are buried in peace, and their name lives unto generation and generation .
text_la: Corpora ipsorum in pace sepulta sunt, et nomen eorum vivit in generationem et generationem.
text_el: τὰ σώματα αὐτῶν ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἐτάφη καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ζῇ εἰς γενεάς

text_en: Let the people show forth their wisdom, and the church declare their praise.
text_la: Sapientiam ipsorum narrent populi, et laudem eorum nuntiet ecclesia.
text_el: σοφίαν αὐτῶν διηγήσονται λαοί καὶ τὸν ἔπαινον ἐξαγγέλλει ἐκκλησία

text_en: Henoch pleased God , and was translated into paradise, that he may give repentance to the nations.
text_la: Enoch placuit Deo, et translatus est in paradisum, ut det gentibus pœnitentiam.
text_el: Ενωχ εὐηρέστησεν κυρίῳ καὶ μετετέθη ὑπόδειγμα μετανοίας ταῖς γενεαῖς

text_en: Noe was found perfect, just , and in the time of wrath he was made a reconciliation.
text_la: Noë inventus est perfectus, justus, et in tempore iracundiæ factus est reconciliatio.
text_el: Νωε εὑρέθη τέλειος δίκαιος ἐν καιρῷ ὀργῆς ἐγένετο ἀντάλλαγμα

text_en: Therefore was there a remnant left to the earth, when the flood came.
text_la: Ideo dimissum est reliquum terræ, cum factum est diluvium.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτον ἐγενήθη κατάλειμμα τῇ γῇ ὅτε ἐγένετο κατακλυσμός

text_en: The covenants of the world were made with him, that all flesh should no more be destroyed with the flood .
text_la: Testamenta sæculi posita sunt apud illum, ne deleri possit diluvio omnis caro.
text_el: διαθῆκαι αἰῶνος ἐτέθησαν πρὸς αὐτόν ἵνα μὴ ἐξαλειφθῇ κατακλυσμῷ πᾶσα σάρξ

text_en: Abraham was the great father of a multitude of nations, and there was not found the like to him in glory , who kept the law of the most High , and was in covenant with him.
text_la: Abraham magnus pater multitudinis gentium, et non est inventus similis illi in gloria : qui conservavit legem Excelsi, et fuit in testamento cum illo.
text_el: Αβρααμ μέγας πατὴρ πλήθους ἐθνῶν καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθη ὅμοιος ἐν τῇ δόξῃ ὃς συνετήρησεν νόμον ὑψίστου καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν διαθήκῃ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: In his flesh he established the covenant, and in temptation he was found faithful.
text_la: In carne ejus stare fecit testamentum, et in tentatione inventus est fidelis.
text_el: ἐν σαρκὶ αὐτοῦ ἔστησεν διαθήκην καὶ ἐν πειρασμῷ εὑρέθη πιστός

text_en: Therefore by an oath he gave him glory in his posterity, that he should increase as the dust of the earth,
text_la: Ideo jurejurando dedit illi gloriam in gente sua, crescere illum quasi terræ cumulum,
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐν ὅρκῳ ἔστησεν αὐτῷ ἐνευλογηθῆναι ἔθνη ἐν σπέρματι αὐτοῦ πληθῦναι αὐτὸν ὡς χοῦν τῆς γῆς

text_en: and that he would exalt his seed as the stars, and they should inherit from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.
text_la: et ut stellas exaltare semen ejus, et hæreditare illos a mari usque ad mare, et a flumine usque ad terminos terræ.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἄστρα ἀνυψῶσαι τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ καὶ κατακληρονομῆσαι αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ θαλάσσης ἕως θαλάσσης καὶ ἀπὸ ποταμοῦ ἕως ἄκρου τῆς γῆς

text_en: And he did in like manner with Isaac for the sake of Abraham his father.
text_la: Et in Isaac eodem modo fecit, propter Abraham patrem ejus.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ Ισαακ ἔστησεν οὕτως δι' Αβρααμ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord gave him the blessing of all nations, and confirmed his covenant upon the head of Jacob .
text_la: Benedictionem omnium gentium dedit illi Dominus, et testamentum confirmavit super caput Jacob.
text_el: εὐλογίαν πάντων ἀνθρώπων καὶ διαθήκην κατέπαυσεν ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν Ιακωβ

text_en: He acknowledged him in his blessings , and gave him an inheritance, and divided him his portion in twelve tribes.
text_la: Agnovit eum in benedictionibus suis, et dedit illi hæreditatem, et divisit illi partem in tribubus duodecim.
text_el: ἐπέγνω αὐτὸν ἐν εὐλογίαις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ἐν κληρονομίᾳ καὶ διέστειλεν μερίδας αὐτοῦ ἐν φυλαῖς ἐμέρισεν δέκα δύο

text_en: And he preserved for him men of mercy, that found grace in the eyes of all flesh.
text_la: Et conservavit illi homines misericordiæ, invenientes gratiam in oculis omnis carnis.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγεν ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἄνδρα ἐλέους εὑρίσκοντα χάριν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς πάσης σαρκὸς

text_en: Moses was beloved of God , and men : whose memory is in benediction.
text_la: Dilectus Deo et hominibus Moyses, cujus memoria in benedictione est.
text_el: ἠγαπημένον ὑπὸ θεοῦ καὶ ἀνθρώπων Μωυσῆν οὗ τὸ μνημόσυνον ἐν εὐλογίαις

text_en: He made him like the saints in glory , and magnified him in the fear of his enemies, and with his words he made prodigies to cease.
text_la: Similem illum fecit in gloria sanctorum, et magnificavit eum in timore inimicorum, et in verbis suis monstra placavit.
text_el: ὡμοίωσεν αὐτὸν δόξῃ ἁγίων καὶ ἐμεγάλυνεν αὐτὸν ἐν φόβοις ἐχθρῶν ἐν λόγοις αὐτοῦ σημεῖα κατέπαυσεν

text_en: He glorified him in the sight of kings, and gave him commandments in the sight of his people, and showed him his glory .
text_la: Glorificavit illum in conspectu regum, et jussit illi coram populo suo, et ostendit illi gloriam suam.
text_el: ἐδόξασεν αὐτὸν κατὰ πρόσωπον βασιλέων ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ πρὸς λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ

text_en: He sanctified him in his faith , and meekness, and chose him out of all flesh.
text_la: In fide et lenitate ipsius sanctum fecit illum, et elegit eum ex omni carne.
text_el: ἐν πίστει καὶ πραΰτητι αὐτὸν ἡγίασεν ἐξελέξατο αὐτὸν ἐκ πάσης σαρκός

text_en: For he heard him, and his voice, and brought him into a cloud.
text_la: Audivit enim eum, et vocem ipsius, et induxit illum in nubem.
text_el: ἠκούτισεν αὐτὸν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν γνόφον

text_en: And he gave him commandments before his face, and a law of life and instruction, that he might teach Jacob his covenant, and Israel his judgments.
text_la: Et dedit illi coram præcepta, et legem vitæ et disciplinæ, docere Jacob testamentum suum, et judicia sua Israël.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ κατὰ πρόσωπον ἐντολάς νόμον ζωῆς καὶ ἐπιστήμης διδάξαι τὸν Ιακωβ διαθήκην καὶ κρίματα αὐτοῦ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: He exalted Aaron his brother, and like to himself of the tribe of Levi :
text_la: Excelsum fecit Aaron fratrem ejus, et similem sibi, de tribu Levi.
text_el: Ααρων ὕψωσεν ἅγιον ὅμοιον αὐτῷ ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐκ φυλῆς Λευι

text_en: He made an everlasting covenant with him, and gave him the priesthood of the nation, and made him blessed in glory ,
text_la: Statuit ei testamentum æternum, et dedit illi sacerdotium gentis, et beatificavit illum in gloria :
text_el: ἔστησεν αὐτὸν διαθήκην αἰῶνος καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ἱερατείαν λαοῦ ἐμακάρισεν αὐτὸν ἐν εὐκοσμίᾳ

text_en: and he girded him about with a glorious girdle, and clothed him with a robe of glory , and crowned him with majestic attire.
text_la: et circumcinxit eum zona gloriæ, et induit eum stolam gloriæ, et coronavit eum in vasis virtutis.
text_el: καὶ περιέζωσεν αὐτὸν περιστολὴν δόξης ἐνέδυσεν αὐτὸν συντέλειαν καυχήματος καὶ ἐστερέωσεν αὐτὸν σκεύεσιν ἰσχύος

text_en: He put upon him a garment to the feet, and breeches, and an ephod , and he compassed him with many little bells of gold all round about,
text_la: Circumpedes, et femoralia, et humerale posuit ei : et cinxit illum tintinnabulis aureis plurimis in gyro :
text_el: περισκελῆ καὶ ποδήρη καὶ ἐπωμίδα καὶ ἐκύκλωσεν αὐτὸν ῥοΐσκοις χρυσοῖς κώδωσιν πλείστοις κυκλόθεν

text_en: that as he went there might be a sound, and a noise made that might be heard in the temple , for a memorial to the children of his people.
text_la: dare sonitum in incessu suo, auditum facere sonitum in templo in memoriam filiis gentis suæ.
text_el: ἠχῆσαι φωνὴν ἐν βήμασιν αὐτοῦ ἀκουστὸν ποιῆσαι ἦχον ἐν ναῷ εἰς μνημόσυνον υἱοῖς λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: He gave him a holy robe of gold, and blue, and purple, a woven work of a wise man , endued with judgment and truth :
text_la: Stolam sanctam auro, et hyacintho, et purpura, opus textile viri sapientis, judicio et veritate præditi :
text_el: στολῇ ἁγίᾳ χρυσῷ καὶ ὑακίνθῳ καὶ πορφύρᾳ ἔργῳ ποικιλτοῦ λογείῳ κρίσεως δήλοις ἀληθείας

text_en: Of twisted scarlet the work of an artist, with precious stones cut and set in gold, and graven by the work of a lapidary for a memorial, according to the number of the tribes of Israel .
text_la: torto cocco opus artificis gemmis pretiosis figuratis in ligatura auri, et opere lapidarii sculptis, in memoriam secundum numerum tribuum Israël.
text_el: κεκλωσμένῃ κόκκῳ ἔργῳ τεχνίτου λίθοις πολυτελέσιν γλύμματος σφραγῖδος ἐν δέσει χρυσίου ἔργῳ λιθουργοῦ εἰς μνημόσυνον ἐν γραφῇ κεκολαμμένῃ κατ' ἀριθμὸν φυλῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And a crown of gold upon his mitre wherein was engraved Holiness, an ornament of honour : a work of power, and delightful to the eyes for its beauty.
text_la: Corona aurea super mitram ejus expressa signo sanctitatis, et gloria honoris : opus virtutis, et desideria oculorum ornata.
text_el: στέφανον χρυσοῦν ἐπάνω κιδάρεως ἐκτύπωμα σφραγῖδος ἁγιάσματος καύχημα τιμῆς ἔργον ἰσχύος ἐπιθυμήματα ὀφθαλμῶν κοσμούμενα

text_en: Before him there were none so beautiful, even from the beginning.
text_la: Sic pulchra ante ipsum non fuerunt talia usque ad originem.
text_el: ὡραῖα πρὸ αὐτοῦ οὐ γέγονεν τοιαῦτα ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: No stranger was ever clothed with them, but only his children alone, and his grandchildren for ever.
text_la: Non est indutus illa alienigena aliquis, sed tantum filii ipsius soli, et nepotes ejus per omne tempus.
text_el: οὐκ ἐνεδύσατο ἀλλογενὴς πλὴν τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ μόνον καὶ τὰ ἔκγονα αὐτοῦ διὰ παντός

text_en: His sacrifices were consumed with fire every day.
text_la: Sacrificia ipsius consumpta sunt igne quotidie.
text_el: θυσίαι αὐτοῦ ὁλοκαρπωθήσονται καθ' ἡμέραν ἐνδελεχῶς δίς

text_en: Moses filled his hands and anointed him with holy oil .
text_la: Complevit Moyses manus ejus, et unxit illum oleo sancto.
text_el: ἐπλήρωσεν Μωυσῆς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ ἔχρισεν αὐτὸν ἐν ἐλαίῳ ἁγίῳ

text_en: This was made to him for an everlasting testament, and to his seed as the days of heaven , to execute the office of the priesthood , and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name .
text_la: Factum est illi in testamentum æternum, et semini ejus, sicut dies cæli, fungi sacerdotio, et habere laudem, et glorificare populum suum in nomine ejus.
text_el: ἐγενήθη αὐτῷ εἰς διαθήκην αἰῶνος καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ ἐν ἡμέραις οὐρανοῦ λειτουργεῖν αὐτῷ ἅμα καὶ ἱερατεύειν καὶ εὐλογεῖν τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι

text_en: He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God , incense , and a good savour, for a memorial to make reconciliation for his people:
text_la: Ipsum elegit ab omni vivente, offerre sacrificium Deo, incensum, et bonum odorem, in memoriam placare pro populo suo :
text_el: ἐξελέξατο αὐτὸν ἀπὸ παντὸς ζῶντος προσαγαγεῖν κάρπωσιν κυρίῳ θυμίαμα καὶ εὐωδίαν εἰς μνημόσυνον ἐξιλάσκεσθαι περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ σου

text_en: And he gave him power in his commandments, in the covenants of his judgments, that he should teach Jacob his testimonies, and give light to Israel in his law.
text_la: et dedit illi in præceptis suis potestatem, in testamentis judiciorum : docere Jacob testimonia, et in lege sua lucem dare Israël.
text_el: ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ἐν ἐντολαῖς αὐτοῦ ἐξουσίαν ἐν διαθήκαις κριμάτων διδάξαι τὸν Ιακωβ τὰ μαρτύρια καὶ ἐν νόμῳ αὐτοῦ φωτίσαι Ισραηλ

text_en: And strangers stood up against him, and through envy the men that were with Dathan and Abiron , compassed him about in the wilderness , and the congregation of Core in their wrath .
text_la: Quia contra illum steterunt alieni, et propter invidiam circumdederunt illum homines in deserto, qui erant cum Dathan et Abiron, et congregatio Core in iracundia.
text_el: ἐπισυνέστησαν αὐτῷ ἀλλότριοι καὶ ἐζήλωσαν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἄνδρες οἱ περὶ Δαθαν καὶ Αβιρων καὶ ἡ συναγωγὴ Κορε ἐν θυμῷ καὶ ὀργῇ

text_en: The Lord God saw and it pleased him not, and they were consumed in his wrathful indignation.
text_la: Vidit Dominus Deus, et non placuit illi, et consumpti sunt in impetu iracundiæ.
text_el: εἶδεν κύριος καὶ οὐκ εὐδόκησεν καὶ συνετελέσθησαν ἐν θυμῷ ὀργῆς

text_en: He wrought wonders upon them, and consumed them with a flame of fire.
text_la: Fecit illis monstra, et consumpsit illos in flamma ignis.
text_el: ἐποίησεν αὐτοῖς τέρατα καταναλῶσαι ἐν πυρὶ φλογὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he added glory to Aaron , and gave him an inheritance, and divided unto him the firstfruits of the increase of the earth.
text_la: Et addidit Aaron gloriam, et dedit illi hæreditatem, et primitias frugum terræ divisit illi.
text_el: καὶ προσέθηκεν Ααρων δόξαν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ κληρονομίαν ἀπαρχὰς πρωτογενημάτων ἐμέρισεν αὐτῷ

text_en: He prepared them bread in the first place unto fullness: for the sacrifices also of the Lord they shall eat, which he gave to him, and to his seed.
text_la: Panem ipsis in primis paravit in satietatem : nam et sacrificia Domini edent, quæ dedit illi et semini ejus.
text_el: ἄρτον πρώτοις ἡτοίμασεν πλησμονήν καὶ γὰρ θυσίας κυρίου φάγονται ἃς ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τε καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ

text_en: But he shall not inherit among the people in the land, and he has no portion among the people: for he himself is his portion and inheritance.
text_la: Ceterum in terra gentes non hæreditabit, et pars non est illi in gente : ipse est enim pars ejus, et hæreditas.
text_el: πλὴν ἐν γῇ λαοῦ οὐ κληρονομήσει καὶ μερὶς οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτῷ ἐν λαῷ αὐτὸς γὰρ μερίς σου καὶ κληρονομία

text_en: Phinees the son of Eleazar is the third in glory , by imitating him in the fear of the Lord :
text_la: Phinees, filius Eleazari, tertius in gloria est, imitando eum in timore Domini,
text_el: καὶ Φινεες υἱὸς Ελεαζαρ τρίτος εἰς δόξαν ἐν τῷ ζηλῶσαι αὐτὸν ἐν φόβῳ κυρίου

text_en: And he stood up in the shameful fall of the people: in the goodness and readiness of his soul he appeased God for Israel .
text_la: et stare in reverentia gentis : in bonitate et alacritate animæ suæ placuit Deo pro Israël.
text_el: καὶ στῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τροπῇ λαοῦ ἐν ἀγαθότητι προθυμίας ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξιλάσατο περὶ τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Therefore he made to him a covenant of peace, to be the prince of the sanctuary, and of his people, that the dignity of priesthood should be to him and to his seed for ever.
text_la: Ideo statuit illi testamentum pacis, principem sanctorum et gentis suæ, ut sit illi et semini ejus sacerdotii dignitas in æternum.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐστάθη αὐτῷ διαθήκη εἰρήνης προστατεῖν ἁγίων καὶ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἵνα αὐτῷ ᾖ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ ἱερωσύνης μεγαλεῖον εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: And a covenant to David the king, the son of Jesse of the tribe of Juda , an inheritance to him and to his seed, that he might give wisdom into our heart to judge his people in justice , that their good things might not be abolished, and he made their glory in their nation everlasting.
text_la: Et testamentum David regi filio Jesse de tribu Juda, hæreditas ipsi et semini ejus : ut daret sapientiam in cor nostrum, judicare gentem suam in justitia, ne abolerentur bona ipsorum : et gloriam ipsorum in gentem eorum æternam fecit.
text_el: καὶ διαθήκη τῷ Δαυιδ υἱῷ Ιεσσαι ἐκ φυλῆς Ιουδα κληρονομία βασιλέως υἱοῦ ἐξ υἱοῦ μόνου κληρονομία Ααρων καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ δῴη ὑμῖν σοφίαν ἐν καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν κρίνειν τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ἵνα μὴ ἀφανισθῇ τὰ ἀγαθὰ αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν εἰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: Valiant in war was Jesus the son of Nave , who was successor of Moses among the prophets , who was great according to his name ,
text_la: Fortis in bello Jesus Nave, successor Moysi in prophetis, qui fuit magnus secundum nomen suum,
text_el: κραταιὸς ἐν πολέμῳ Ἰησοῦς Ναυη καὶ διάδοχος Μωυσῆ ἐν προφητείαις ὃς ἐγένετο κατὰ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ

text_en: very great for the saving the elect of God , to overthrow the enemies that rose up against them, that he might get the inheritance for Israel .
text_la: maximus in salutem electorum Dei, expugnare insurgentes hostes, ut consequeretur hæreditatem Israël.
text_el: μέγας ἐπὶ σωτηρίᾳ ἐκλεκτῶν αὐτοῦ ἐκδικῆσαι ἐπεγειρομένους ἐχθρούς ὅπως κατακληρονομήσῃ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: How great glory did he gain when he lifted up his hands, and stretched out swords against the cities?
text_la: Quam gloriam adeptus est in tollendo manus suas, et jactando contra civitates rhomphæas!
text_el: ὡς ἐδοξάσθη ἐν τῷ ἐπᾶραι χεῖρας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐκτεῖναι ῥομφαίαν ἐπὶ πόλεις

text_en: Who before him has so resisted? For the Lord himself brought the enemies.
text_la: Quis ante illum sic restitit? nam hostes ipse Dominus perduxit.
text_el: τίς πρότερος αὐτοῦ οὕτως ἔστη τοὺς γὰρ πολέμους κυρίου αὐτὸς ἐπήγαγεν

text_en: Was not the sun stopped in his anger , and one day made as two?
text_la: An non in iracundia ejus impeditus est sol, et una dies facta est quasi duo?
text_el: οὐχὶ ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ἐνεποδίσθη ὁ ἥλιος καὶ μία ἡμέρα ἐγενήθη πρὸς δύο

text_en: He called upon the most high Sovereign when the enemies assaulted him on every side, and the great and holy God heard him by hailstones of exceeding great force.
text_la: Invocavit Altissimum potentem, in oppugnando inimicos undique : et audivit illum magnus et sanctus Deus, in saxis grandinis virtutis valde fortis.
text_el: ἐπεκαλέσατο τὸν ὕψιστον δυνάστην ἐν τῷ θλῖψαι αὐτὸν ἐχθροὺς κυκλόθεν καὶ ἐπήκουσεν αὐτοῦ μέγας κύριος ἐν λίθοις χαλάζης δυνάμεως κραταιᾶς

text_en: He made a violent assault against the nation of his enemies, and in the descent he destroyed the adversaries.
text_la: Impetum fecit contra gentem hostilem, et in descensu perdidit contrarios :
text_el: κατέρραξεν ἐπ' ἔθνος πόλεμον καὶ ἐν καταβάσει ἀπώλεσεν ἀνθεστηκότας

text_en: That the nations might know his power, that it is not easy to fight against God . And he followed the mighty one:
text_la: ut cognoscant gentes potentiam ejus, quia contra Deum pugnare non est facile. Et secutus est a tergo potentis :
text_el: ἵνα γνῶσιν ἔθνη πανοπλίαν αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐναντίον κυρίου ὁ πόλεμος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And in the days of Moses he did a work of mercy, he and Caleb the son of Jephone , in standing against the enemy, and withholding the people from sins , and appeasing the wicked murmuring.
text_la: et in diebus Moysi misericordiam fecit, ipse, et Caleb filius Jephone, stare contra hostem, et prohibere gentem a peccatis, et perfringere murmur malitiæ.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ἐπηκολούθησεν ὀπίσω δυνάστου καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις Μωυσέως ἐποίησεν ἔλεος αὐτὸς καὶ Χαλεβ υἱὸς Ιεφοννη ἀντιστῆναι ἔναντι ἐκκλησίας κωλῦσαι λαὸν ἀπὸ ἁμαρτίας καὶ κοπάσαι γογγυσμὸν πονηρίας

text_en: And they two being appointed, were delivered out of the danger from among the number of six hundred thousand men on foot, to bring them into their inheritance, into the land that flows with milk and honey.
text_la: Et ipsi duo constituti a periculo liberati sunt a numero sexcentorum millium peditum, inducere illos in hæreditatem, in terram quæ manat lac et mel.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ δύο ὄντες διεσώθησαν ἀπὸ ἑξακοσίων χιλιάδων πεζῶν εἰσαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς κληρονομίαν εἰς γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι

text_en: And the Lord gave strength also to Caleb , and his strength continued even to his old age, so that he went up to the high places of the land, and his seed obtained it for an inheritance:
text_la: Et dedit Dominus ipsi Caleb fortitudinem, et usque in senectutem permansit illi virtus, ut ascenderet in excelsum terræ locum, et semen ipsius obtinuit hæreditatem,
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ὁ κύριος τῷ Χαλεβ ἰσχύν καὶ ἕως γήρους διέμεινεν αὐτῷ ἐπιβῆναι αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ ὕψος τῆς γῆς καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ κατέσχεν κληρονομίαν

text_en: That all the children of Israel might see, that it is good to obey the holy God .
text_la: ut viderent omnes filii Israël quia bonum est obsequi sancto Deo.
text_el: ὅπως ἴδωσιν πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ὅτι καλὸν τὸ πορεύεσθαι ὀπίσω κυρίου

text_en: Then all the judges, every one by name , whose heart was not corrupted: who turned not away from the Lord ,
text_la: Et judices singuli suo nomine, quorum non est corruptum cor, qui non aversi sunt a Domino,
text_el: καὶ οἱ κριταί ἕκαστος τῷ αὐτοῦ ὀνόματι ὅσων οὐκ ἐξεπόρνευσεν ἡ καρδία καὶ ὅσοι οὐκ ἀπεστράφησαν ἀπὸ κυρίου

text_en: that their memory might be blessed , and their bones spring up out of their place,
text_la: ut sit memoria illorum in benedictione, et ossa eorum pullulent de loco suo :
text_el: εἴη τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῶν ἐν εὐλογίαις τὰ ὀστᾶ αὐτῶν ἀναθάλοι ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῶν

text_en: and their name continue for ever, the glory of the holy men remaining unto their children.
text_la: et nomen eorum permaneat in æternum, permanens ad filios illorum, sanctorum virorum gloria.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ἀντικαταλλασσόμενον ἐφ' υἱοῖς δεδοξασμένων αὐτῶν

text_en: Samuel the prophet of the Lord , the beloved of the Lord his God , established a new government, and anointed princes over his people.
text_la: Dilectus a Domino Deo suo Samuel, propheta Domini, renovavit imperium, et unxit principes in gente sua.
text_el: ἠγαπημένος ὑπὸ κυρίου αὐτοῦ Σαμουηλ προφήτης κυρίου κατέστησεν βασιλείαν καὶ ἔχρισεν ἄρχοντας ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: By the law of the Lord he judged the congregation, and the God of Jacob beheld, and by his fidelity he was proved a prophet .
text_la: In lege Domini congregationem judicavit, et vidit Deus Jacob : et in fide sua probatus est propheta,
text_el: ἐν νόμῳ κυρίου ἔκρινεν συναγωγήν καὶ ἐπεσκέψατο κύριος τὸν Ιακωβ

text_en: And he was known to be faithful in his words, because he saw the God of light:
text_la: et cognitus est in verbis suis fidelis, quia vidit Deum lucis.
text_el: ἐν πίστει αὐτοῦ ἠκριβάσθη προφήτης καὶ ἐγνώσθη ἐν ῥήμασιν αὐτοῦ πιστὸς ὁράσεως

text_en: And called upon the name of the Lord Almighty , in fighting against the enemies who beset him on every side, when he offered a lamb without blemish.
text_la: Et invocavit Dominum omnipotentem, in oppugnando hostes circumstantes undique, in oblatione agni inviolati.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεκαλέσατο τὸν κύριον δυνάστην ἐν τῷ θλῖψαι ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ κυκλόθεν ἐν προσφορᾷ ἀρνὸς γαλαθηνοῦ

text_en: And the Lord thundered from heaven , and with a great noise made his voice to be heard.
text_la: Et intonuit de cælo Dominus, et in sonitu magno auditam fecit vocem suam :
text_el: καὶ ἐβρόντησεν ἀπ' οὐρανοῦ ὁ κύριος καὶ ἐν ἤχῳ μεγάλῳ ἀκουστὴν ἐποίησεν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he crushed the princes of the Tyrians, and all the lords of the Philistines :
text_la: et contrivit principes Tyriorum, et omnes duces Philisthiim :
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτριψεν ἡγουμένους Τυρίων καὶ πάντας ἄρχοντας Φυλιστιιμ

text_en: And before the time of the end of his life in the world, he protested before the Lord , and his anointed: money, or anything else, even to a shoe, he had not taken of any man , and no man did accuse him.
text_la: et ante tempus finis vitæ suæ et sæculi, testimonium præbuit in conspectu Domini et christi : pecunias et usque ad calceamenta ab omni carne non accepit, et non accusavit illum homo.
text_el: καὶ πρὸ καιροῦ κοιμήσεως αἰῶνος ἐπεμαρτύρατο ἔναντι κυρίου καὶ χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ χρήματα καὶ ἕως ὑποδημάτων ἀπὸ πάσης σαρκὸς οὐκ εἴληφα καὶ οὐκ ἐνεκάλεσεν αὐτῷ ἄνθρωπος

text_en: And after this he slept, and he made known to the king, and showed him the end of his life, and he lifted up his voice from the earth in prophecy to blot out the wickedness of the nation.
text_la: Et post hoc dormivit : et notum fecit regi, et ostendit illi finem vitæ suæ : et exaltavit vocem suam de terra in prophetia, delere impietatem gentis.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τὸ ὑπνῶσαι αὐτὸν προεφήτευσεν καὶ ὑπέδειξεν βασιλεῖ τὴν τελευτὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνύψωσεν ἐκ γῆς τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ ἐν προφητείᾳ ἐξαλεῖψαι ἀνομίαν λαοῦ

text_en: Then Nathan the prophet arose in the days of David .
text_la: Post hæc surrexit Nathan, propheta in diebus David.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τοῦτον ἀνέστη Ναθαν προφητεύειν ἐν ἡμέραις Δαυιδ

text_en: And as the fat taken away from the flesh, so was David chosen from among the children of Israel .
text_la: Et quasi adeps separatus a carne, sic David a filiis Israël.
text_el: ὥσπερ στέαρ ἀφωρισμένον ἀπὸ σωτηρίου οὕτως Δαυιδ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: He played with lions as with lambs: and with bears he did in like manner as with the lambs of the flock, in his youth.
text_la: Cum leonibus lusit quasi cum agnis, et in ursis similiter fecit sicut in agnis ovium, in juventute sua.
text_el: ἐν λέουσιν ἔπαιξεν ὡς ἐν ἐρίφοις καὶ ἐν ἄρκοις ὡς ἐν ἄρνασι προβάτων ἐν νεότητι αὐτοῦ

text_en: Did not he kill the giant, and take away reproach from his people?
text_la: Numquid non occidit gigantem, et abstulit opprobrium de gente?
text_el: οὐχὶ ἀπέκτεινεν γίγαντα καὶ ἐξῆρεν ὀνειδισμὸν ἐκ λαοῦ

text_en: In lifting up his hand, with the stone in the sling he beat down the boasting of Goliath:
text_la: In tollendo manum, saxo fundæ dejecit exsultationem Goliæ :
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἐπᾶραι χεῖρα ἐν λίθῳ σφενδόνης καὶ καταβαλεῖν γαυρίαμα τοῦ Γολιαθ

text_en: For he called upon the Lord the Almighty, and he gave strength in his right hand, to take away the mighty warrior, and to set up the horn of his nation.
text_la: nam invocavit Dominum omnipotentem, et dedit in dextera ejus tollere hominem fortem in bello, et exaltare cornu gentis suæ.
text_el: ἐπεκαλέσατο γὰρ κύριον τὸν ὕψιστον καὶ ἔδωκεν ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ κράτος ἐξᾶραι ἄνθρωπον δυνατὸν ἐν πολέμῳ ἀνυψῶσαι κέρας λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: So in ten thousand did he glorify him, and praised him in the blessings of the Lord , in offering to him a crown of glory :
text_la: Sic in decem millibus glorificavit eum : et laudavit eum in benedictionibus Domini, in offerendo illi coronam gloriæ :
text_el: οὕτως ἐν μυριάσιν ἐδόξασαν αὐτὸν καὶ ᾔνεσαν αὐτὸν ἐν εὐλογίαις κυρίου ἐν τῷ φέρεσθαι αὐτῷ διάδημα δόξης

text_en: For he destroyed the enemies on every side, and extirpated the Philistines the adversaries unto this day: he broke their horn for ever.
text_la: contrivit enim inimicos undique, et extirpavit Philisthiim contrarios usque in hodiernum diem : contrivit cornu ipsorum usque in æternum.
text_el: ἐξέτριψεν γὰρ ἐχθροὺς κυκλόθεν καὶ ἐξουδένωσεν Φυλιστιιμ τοὺς ὑπεναντίους ἕως σήμερον συνέτριψεν αὐτῶν κέρας

text_en: In all his works he gave thanks to the holy one, and to the most High , with words of glory .
text_la: In omni opere dedit confessionem Sancto, et Excelso in verbo gloriæ.
text_el: ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν ἐξομολόγησιν ἁγίῳ ὑψίστῳ ῥήματι δόξης

text_en: With his whole heart he praised the Lord , and loved God that made him: and he gave him power against his enemies:
text_la: De omni corde suo laudavit Dominum : et dilexit Deum, qui fecit illum, et dedit illi contra inimicos potentiam :
text_el: ἐν πάσῃ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ὕμνησεν καὶ ἠγάπησεν τὸν ποιήσαντα αὐτόν

text_en: And he set singers before the altar , and by their voices he made sweet melody.
text_la: et stare fecit cantores contra altare, et in sono eorum dulces fecit modos.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν ψαλτῳδοὺς κατέναντι τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ἐξ ἠχοῦς αὐτῶν γλυκαίνειν μέλη

text_en: And to the festivals he added beauty, and set in order the solemn times even to the end of his life, that they should praise the holy name of the Lord , and magnify the holiness of God in the morning.
text_la: Et dedit in celebrationibus decus, et ornavit tempora usque ad consummationem vitæ, ut laudarent nomen sanctum Domini, et amplificarent mane Dei sanctitatem.
text_el: ἔδωκεν ἐν ἑορταῖς εὐπρέπειαν καὶ ἐκόσμησεν καιροὺς μέχρι συντελείας ἐν τῷ αἰνεῖν αὐτοὺς τὸ ἅγιον ὄνομα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ πρωίας ἠχεῖν τὸ ἁγίασμα

text_en: The Lord took away his sins , and exalted his horn for ever: and he gave him a covenant of the kingdom, and a throne of glory in Israel .
text_la: Dominus purgavit peccata ipsius, et exaltavit in æternum cornu ejus : et dedit illi testamentum regni, et sedem gloriæ in Israël.
text_el: κύριος ἀφεῖλεν τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνύψωσεν εἰς αἰῶνα τὸ κέρας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ διαθήκην βασιλέων καὶ θρόνον δόξης ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: After him arose up a wise son, and for his sake he cast down all the power of the enemies.
text_la: Post ipsum surrexit filius sensatus, et propter illum dejecit omnem potentiam inimicorum.
text_el: μετὰ τοῦτον ἀνέστη υἱὸς ἐπιστήμων καὶ δι' αὐτὸν κατέλυσεν ἐν πλατυσμῷ

text_en: Solomon reigned in days of peace, and God brought all his enemies under him, that he might build a house in his name , and prepare a sanctuary for ever: O how wise were you in your youth!
text_la: Salomon imperavit in diebus pacis, cui subjecit Deus omnes hostes, ut conderet domum in nomine suo, et pararet sanctitatem in sempiternum. Quemadmodum eruditus es in juventute tua,
text_el: Σαλωμων ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν ἡμέραις εἰρήνης ᾧ ὁ θεὸς κατέπαυσεν κυκλόθεν ἵνα στήσῃ οἶκον ἐπ' ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἑτοιμάσῃ ἁγίασμα εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And you were filled as a river with wisdom, and your soul covered the earth.
text_la: et impletus es, quasi flumen, sapientia, et terram retexit anima tua.
text_el: ὡς ἐσοφίσθης ἐν νεότητί σου καὶ ἐνεπλήσθης ὡς ποταμὸς συνέσεως γῆν ἐπεκάλυψεν ἡ ψυχή σου

text_en: And you multiplied riddles in parables : your name went abroad to the islands far off, and you were beloved in your peace.
text_la: Et replesti in comparationibus ænigmata : ad insulas longe divulgatum est nomen tuum, et dilectus es in pace tua.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέπλησας ἐν παραβολαῖς αἰνιγμάτων εἰς νήσους πόρρω ἀφίκετο τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ ἠγαπήθης ἐν τῇ εἰρήνῃ σου

text_en: The countries wondered at you for your canticles, and proverbs, and parables , and interpretations,
text_la: In cantilenis, et proverbiis, et comparationibus, et interpretationibus, miratæ sunt terræ :
text_el: ἐν ᾠδαῖς καὶ παροιμίαις καὶ παραβολαῖς καὶ ἐν ἑρμηνείαις ἀπεθαύμασάν σε χῶραι

text_en: and at the name of the Lord God , whose surname is, God of Israel .
text_la: et in nomine Domini Dei, cui est cognomen Deus Israël.
text_el: ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐπικεκλημένου θεοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: You gathered gold as copper, and multiplied silver as lead,
text_la: Collegisti quasi auricalcum aurum, et ut plumbum complesti argentum :
text_el: συνήγαγες ὡς κασσίτερον τὸ χρυσίον καὶ ὡς μόλιβον ἐπλήθυνας ἀργύριον

text_en: and you bowed yourself to women : and by your body you were brought under subjection.
text_la: et inclinasti femora tua mulieribus : potestatem habuisti in corpore tuo.
text_el: παρανέκλινας τὰς λαγόνας σου γυναιξὶν καὶ ἐνεξουσιάσθης ἐν τῷ σώματί σου

text_en: You have stained your glory , and defiled your seed so as to bring wrath upon your children, and to have your folly kindled,
text_la: Dedisti maculam in gloria tua, et profanasti semen tuum, inducere iracundiam ad liberos tuos, et incitari stultitiam tuam :
text_el: ἔδωκας μῶμον ἐν τῇ δόξῃ σου καὶ ἐβεβήλωσας τὸ σπέρμα σου ἐπαγαγεῖν ὀργὴν ἐπὶ τὰ τέκνα σου καὶ κατανυγῆναι ἐπὶ τῇ ἀφροσύνῃ σου

text_en: that you should make the kingdom to be divided, and out of Ephraim a rebellious kingdom to rule.
text_la: ut faceres imperium bipartitum, et ex Ephraim imperare imperium durum.
text_el: γενέσθαι δίχα τυραννίδα καὶ ἐξ Εφραιμ ἄρξαι βασιλείαν ἀπειθῆ

text_en: But God will not leave off his mercy, and he will not destroy, nor abolish his own works, neither will he cut up by the roots the offspring of his elect : and he will not utterly take away the seed of him that loves the Lord .
text_la: Deus autem non derelinquet misericordiam suam : et non corrumpet, nec delebit opera sua, neque perdet a stirpe nepotes electi sui, et semen ejus qui diligit Dominum non corrumpet.
text_el: ὁ δὲ κύριος οὐ μὴ καταλίπῃ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ μὴ διαφθείρῃ ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ μὴ ἐξαλείψῃ ἐκλεκτοῦ αὐτοῦ ἔκγονα καὶ σπέρμα τοῦ ἀγαπήσαντος αὐτὸν οὐ μὴ ἐξάρῃ

text_en: Wherefore he gave a remnant to Jacob , and to David of the same stock.
text_la: Dedit autem reliquum Jacob, et David de ipsa stirpe.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ιακωβ ἔδωκεν κατάλειμμα καὶ τῷ Δαυιδ ἐξ αὐτοῦ ῥίζαν

text_en: And Solomon had an end with his fathers.
text_la: Et finem habuit Salomon cum patribus suis.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεπαύσατο Σαλωμων μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he left behind him of his seed, the folly of the nation,
text_la: Et dereliquit post se de semine suo, gentis stultitiam,
text_el: καὶ κατέλιπεν μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτοῦ λαοῦ ἀφροσύνην

text_en: even Roboam that had little wisdom, who turned away the people through his counsel:
text_la: et imminutum a prudentia, Roboam, qui avertit gentem consilio suo :
text_el: καὶ ἐλασσούμενον συνέσει Ροβοαμ ὃς ἀπέστησεν λαὸν ἐκ βουλῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who caused Israel to sin , and showed Ephraim the way of sin , and their sins were multiplied exceedingly.
text_la: et Jeroboam filium Nabat, qui peccare fecit Israël, et dedit viam peccandi Ephraim : et plurima redundaverunt peccata ipsorum.
text_el: καὶ Ιεροβοαμ υἱὸς Ναβατ ὃς ἐξήμαρτεν τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ἔδωκεν τῷ Εφραιμ ὁδὸν ἁμαρτίας καὶ ἐπληθύνθησαν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι αὐτῶν

text_en: They removed them far away from their land.
text_la: Valde averterunt illos a terra sua.
text_el: σφόδρα ἀποστῆσαι αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν

text_en: And they sought out all iniquities , till vengeance came upon them, and put an end to all their sins .
text_la: Et quæsivit omnes nequitias, usque dum perveniret ad illos defensio, et ab omnibus peccatis liberavit eos.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσαν πονηρίαν ἐξεζήτησαν ἕως ἐκδίκησις ἔλθῃ ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And Elias the prophet stood up, as a fire, and his word burnt like a torch.
text_la: Et surrexit Elias propheta quasi ignis, et verbum ipsius quasi facula ardebat.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Ηλιας προφήτης ὡς πῦρ καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ ὡς λαμπὰς ἐκαίετο

text_en: He brought a famine upon them, and they that provoked him in their envy , were reduced to a small number, for they could not endure the commandments of the Lord .
text_la: Qui induxit in illos famem : et irritantes illum invidia sua pauci facti sunt : non enim poterant sustinere præcepta Domini.
text_el: ὃς ἐπήγαγεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς λιμὸν καὶ τῷ ζήλῳ αὐτοῦ ὠλιγοποίησεν αὐτούς

text_en: By the word of the Lord he shut up the heaven , and he brought down fire from heaven thrice.
text_la: Verbo Domini continuit cælum, et dejecit de cælo ignem ter.
text_el: ἐν λόγῳ κυρίου ἀνέσχεν οὐρανόν κατήγαγεν οὕτως τρὶς πῦρ

text_en: Thus was Elias magnified in his wondrous works. And who can glory like to you?
text_la: Sic amplificatus est Elias in mirabilibus suis. Et quis potest similiter sic gloriari tibi?
text_el: ὡς ἐδοξάσθης Ηλια ἐν θαυμασίοις σου καὶ τίς ὅμοιός σοι καυχᾶσθαι

text_en: Who raised up a dead man from below, from the lot of death, by the word of the Lord God .
text_la: qui sustulisti mortuum ab inferis de sorte mortis, in verbo Domini Dei :
text_el: ὁ ἐγείρας νεκρὸν ἐκ θανάτου καὶ ἐξ ᾅδου ἐν λόγῳ ὑψίστου

text_en: Who brought down kings to destruction, and broke easily their power in pieces, and the glorious from their bed.
text_la: qui dejecisti reges ad pernicem, et confregisti facile potentiam ipsorum, et gloriosos de lecto suo :
text_el: ὁ καταγαγὼν βασιλεῖς εἰς ἀπώλειαν καὶ δεδοξασμένους ἀπὸ κλίνης αὐτῶν

text_en: Who heard judgment in Sina , and in Horeb the judgments of vengeance.
text_la: qui audis in Sina judicium, et in Horeb judicia defensionis :
text_el: ἀκούων ἐν Σινα ἐλεγμὸν καὶ ἐν Χωρηβ κρίματα ἐκδικήσεως

text_en: Who anointed kings to penance , and made prophets successors after you.
text_la: qui ungis reges ad pœnitentiam, et prophetas facis successores post te :
text_el: ὁ χρίων βασιλεῖς εἰς ἀνταπόδομα καὶ προφήτας διαδόχους μετ' αὐτόν

text_en: Who was taken up in a whirlwind of fire, in a chariot of fiery horses.
text_la: qui receptus es in turbine ignis, in curru equorum igneorum :
text_el: ὁ ἀναλημφθεὶς ἐν λαίλαπι πυρὸς ἐν ἅρματι ἵππων πυρίνων

text_en: Who is registered in the judgments of times to appease the wrath of the Lord , to reconcile the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob .
text_la: qui scriptus es in judiciis temporum, lenire iracundiam Domini, conciliare cor patris ad filium, et restituere tribus Jacob.
text_el: ὁ καταγραφεὶς ἐν ἐλεγμοῖς εἰς καιροὺς κοπάσαι ὀργὴν πρὸ θυμοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι καρδίαν πατρὸς πρὸς υἱὸν καὶ καταστῆσαι φυλὰς Ιακωβ

text_en: Blessed are they that saw you, and were honoured with your friendship.
text_la: Beati sunt qui te viderunt, et in amicitia tua decorati sunt.
text_el: μακάριοι οἱ ἰδόντες σε καὶ οἱ ἐν ἀγαπήσει κεκοιμημένοι

text_en: For we live only in our life, but after death our name shall not be such.
text_la: Nam nos vita vivimus tantum : post mortem autem non erit tale nomen nostrum.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ἡμεῖς ζωῇ ζησόμεθα

text_en: Elias was indeed covered with the whirlwind, and his spirit was filled up in Eliseus : in his days he feared not the prince, and no man was more powerful than he.
text_la: Elias quidem in turbine tectus est, et in Eliseo completus est spiritus ejus : in diebus suis non pertimuit principem, et potentia nemo vicit illum :
text_el: Ηλιας ὃς ἐν λαίλαπι ἐσκεπάσθη καὶ Ελισαιε ἐνεπλήσθη πνεύματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐσαλεύθη ὑπὸ ἄρχοντος καὶ οὐ κατεδυνάστευσεν αὐτὸν οὐδείς

text_en: No word could overcome him, and after death his body prophesied .
text_la: nec superavit illum verbum aliquod, et mortuum prophetavit corpus ejus.
text_el: πᾶς λόγος οὐχ ὑπερῆρεν αὐτόν καὶ ἐν κοιμήσει ἐπροφήτευσεν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ

text_en: In his life he did great wonders, and in death he wrought miracles .
text_la: In vita sua fecit monstra, et in morte mirabilia operatus est.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ζωῇ αὐτοῦ ἐποίησεν τέρατα καὶ ἐν τελευτῇ θαυμάσια τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ

text_en: For all this the people repented not, neither did they depart from their sins till they were cast out of their land, and were scattered through all the earth.
text_la: In omnibus istis non pœnituit populus, et non recesserunt a peccatis suis, usque dum ejecti sunt de terra sua, et dispersi sunt in omnem terram :
text_el: ἐν πᾶσιν τούτοις οὐ μετενόησεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ οὐκ ἀπέστησαν ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν ἕως ἐπρονομεύθησαν ἀπὸ γῆς αὐτῶν καὶ διεσκορπίσθησαν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: And there was left but a small people, and a prince in the house of David .
text_la: et relicta est gens perpauca, et princeps in domo David.
text_el: καὶ κατελείφθη ὁ λαὸς ὀλιγοστός καὶ ἄρχων ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Δαυιδ

text_en: Some of these did that which pleased God : but others committed many sins .
text_la: Quidam ipsorum fecerunt quod placeret Deo : alii autem multa commiserunt peccata.
text_el: τινὲς μὲν αὐτῶν ἐποίησαν τὸ ἀρεστόν τινὲς δὲ ἐπλήθυναν ἁμαρτίας

text_en: Ezechias fortified his city, and brought in water into the midst thereof, and he digged a rock with iron, and made a well for water.
text_la: Ezechias munivit civitatem suam, et induxit in medium ipsius aquam : et fodit ferro rupem, et ædificavit ad aquam puteum.
text_el: Εζεκιας ὠχύρωσεν τὴν πόλιν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰσήγαγεν εἰς μέσον αὐτῆς ὕδωρ ὤρυξεν σιδήρῳ ἀκρότομον καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν κρήνας εἰς ὕδατα

text_en: In his days Sennacherib came up, and sent Rabsaces, and lifted up his hand against them, and he stretched out his hand against Sion, and became proud through his power.
text_la: In diebus ipsius ascendit Sennacherib, et misit Rabsacen, et sustulit manum suam contra illos : et extulit manum suam in Sion, et superbus factus est potentia sua.
text_el: ἐν ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ ἀνέβη Σενναχηριμ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ραψακην καὶ ἀπῆρεν καὶ ἐπῆρεν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Σιων καὶ ἐμεγαλαύχησεν ἐν ὑπερηφανίᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then their hearts and hands trembled, and they were in pain as women in travail.
text_la: Tunc mota sunt corda et manus ipsorum : et doluerunt quasi parturientes mulieres.
text_el: τότε ἐσαλεύθησαν καρδίαι καὶ χεῖρες αὐτῶν καὶ ὠδίνησαν ὡς αἱ τίκτουσαι

text_en: And they called upon the Lord who is merciful, and spreading their hands, they lifted them up to heaven : and the holy Lord God quickly heard their voice.
text_la: Et invocaverunt Dominum misericordem, et expandentes manus suas extulerunt ad cælum : et Sanctus, Dominus Deus, audivit cito vocem ipsorum.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεκαλέσαντο τὸν κύριον τὸν ἐλεήμονα ἐκπετάσαντες τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ταχὺ ἐπήκουσεν αὐτῶν

text_en: He was not mindful of their sins , neither did he deliver them up to their enemies, but he purified them by the hand of Isaiah , the holy prophet .
text_la: Non est commemoratus peccatorum illorum, neque dedit illos inimicis suis : sed purgavit eos in manu Isaiæ sancti prophetæ.
text_el: καὶ ἐλυτρώσατο αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ Ησαιου

text_en: He overthrew the army of the Assyrians , and the angel of the Lord destroyed them.
text_la: Dejecit castra Assyriorum, et contrivit illos angelus Domini :
text_el: ἐπάταξεν τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν Ἀσσυρίων καὶ ἐξέτριψεν αὐτοὺς ὁ ἄγγελος αὐτοῦ

text_en: For Ezechias did that which pleased God , and walked valiantly in the way of David his father, which Isaiah , the great prophet , and faithful in the sight of God , had commanded him.
text_la: nam fecit Ezechias quod placuit Deo, et fortiter ivit in via David patris sui, quam mandavit illi Isaias, propheta magnus, et fidelis in conspectu Dei.
text_el: ἐποίησεν γὰρ Εζεκιας τὸ ἀρεστὸν κυρίῳ καὶ ἐνίσχυσεν ἐν ὁδοῖς Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἃς ἐνετείλατο Ησαιας ὁ προφήτης ὁ μέγας καὶ πιστὸς ἐν ὁράσει αὐτοῦ

text_en: In his days the sun went backward, and he lengthened the king's life.
text_la: In diebus ipsius retro rediit sol, et addidit regi vitam.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ ἀνεπόδισεν ὁ ἥλιος καὶ προσέθηκεν ζωὴν βασιλεῖ

text_en: With a great spirit he saw the things that are to come to pass at last, and comforted the mourners in Sion.
text_la: Spiritu magno vidit ultima, et consolatus est lugentes in Sion usque in sempiternum.
text_el: πνεύματι μεγάλῳ εἶδεν τὰ ἔσχατα καὶ παρεκάλεσεν τοὺς πενθοῦντας ἐν Σιων ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: He showed what should come to pass for ever, and secret things before they came.
text_la: Ostendit futura, et abscondita antequam evenirent.
text_el: ὑπέδειξεν τὰ ἐσόμενα καὶ τὰ ἀπόκρυφα πρὶν ἢ παραγενέσθαι αὐτά

text_en: The memory of Josias is like the composition of a sweet smell made by the art of a perfumer:
text_la: Memoria Josiæ in compositionem odoris facta opus pigmentarii.
text_el: μνημόσυνον Ιωσιου εἰς σύνθεσιν θυμιάματος ἐσκευασμένον ἔργῳ μυρεψοῦ

text_en: His remembrance shall be sweet as honey in every mouth, and as music at a banquet of wine.
text_la: In omni ore quasi mel indulcabitur ejus memoria, et ut musica in convivio vini.
text_el: ἐν παντὶ στόματι ὡς μέλι γλυκανθήσεται καὶ ὡς μουσικὰ ἐν συμποσίῳ οἴνου

text_en: He was directed by God unto the repentance of the nation, and he took away the abominations of wickedness .
text_la: Ipse est directus divinitus in pœnitentiam gentis, et tulit abominationes impietatis.
text_el: αὐτὸς κατευθύνθη ἐν ἐπιστροφῇ λαοῦ καὶ ἐξῆρεν βδελύγματα ἀνομίας

text_en: And he directed his heart towards the Lord , and in the days of sinners he strengthened godliness .
text_la: Et gubernavit ad Dominum cor ipsius, et in diebus peccatorum corroboravit pietatem.
text_el: κατεύθυνεν πρὸς κύριον τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἡμέραις ἀνόμων κατίσχυσεν τὴν εὐσέβειαν

text_en: Except David , and Ezechias and Josias , all committed sin .
text_la: Præter David et Ezechiam et Josiam, omnes peccatum commiserunt :
text_el: πάρεξ Δαυιδ καὶ Εζεκιου καὶ Ιωσιου πάντες πλημμέλειαν ἐπλημμέλησαν

text_en: For the kings of Juda forsook the law of the most High , and despised the fear of God .
text_la: nam reliquerunt legem Altissimi reges Juda, et contempserunt timorem Dei.
text_el: κατέλιπον γὰρ τὸν νόμον τοῦ ὑψίστου οἱ βασιλεῖς Ιουδα ἐξέλιπον

text_en: So they gave their kingdom to others, and their glory to a strange nation,
text_la: Dederunt enim regnum suum aliis, et gloriam suam alienigenæ genti.
text_el: ἔδωκαν γὰρ τὸ κέρας αὐτῶν ἑτέροις καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν ἔθνει ἀλλοτρίῳ

text_en: they burnt the chosen city of holiness , and made the streets thereof desolate according to the prediction of Jeremiah .
text_la: Incenderunt electam sanctitatis civitatem, et desertas fecerunt vias ipsius in manu Jeremiæ.
text_el: ἐνεπύρισαν ἐκλεκτὴν πόλιν ἁγιάσματος καὶ ἠρήμωσαν τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῆς ἐν χειρὶ Ιερεμιου

text_en: For they treated him evil , who was consecrated a prophet from his mother's womb, to overthrow, and pluck up, and destroy, and to build again, and renew.
text_la: Nam male tractaverunt illum qui a ventre matris consecratus est propheta, evertere, et eruere, et perdere, et iterum ædificare, et renovare :
text_el: ἐκάκωσαν γὰρ αὐτόν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν μήτρᾳ ἡγιάσθη προφήτης ἐκριζοῦν καὶ κακοῦν καὶ ἀπολλύειν ὡσαύτως οἰκοδομεῖν καὶ καταφυτεύειν

text_en: It was Ezechiel that saw the glorious vision, which was shown him upon the chariot of cherubims .
text_la: Ezechiel, qui vidit conspectum gloriæ quam ostendit illi in curru cherubim.
text_el: Ιεζεκιηλ ὃς εἶδεν ὅρασιν δόξης ἣν ὑπέδειξεν αὐτῷ ἐπὶ ἅρματος χερουβιν

text_en: For he made mention of the enemies under the figure of rain, and of doing good to them that showed right ways.
text_la: Nam commemoratus est inimicorum in imbre, benefacere illis qui ostenderunt rectas vias.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ἐμνήσθη τῶν ἐχθρῶν ἐν ὄμβρῳ καὶ ἀγαθῶσαι τοὺς εὐθύνοντας ὁδούς

text_en: And may the bones of the twelve prophets spring up out of their place: for they strengthened Jacob , and redeemed themselves by strong faith .
text_la: Et duodecim prophetarum ossa pullulent de loco suo : nam corroboraverunt Jacob, et redemerunt se in fide virtutis.
text_el: καὶ τῶν δώδεκα προφητῶν τὰ ὀστᾶ ἀναθάλοι ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῶν παρεκάλεσαν γὰρ τὸν Ιακωβ καὶ ἐλυτρώσαντο αὐτοὺς ἐν πίστει ἐλπίδος

text_en: How shall we magnify Zorobabel? For he was as a signet on the right hand;
text_la: Quomodo amplificemus Zorobabel? nam et ipse quasi signum in dextera manu :
text_el: πῶς μεγαλύνωμεν τὸν Ζοροβαβελ καὶ αὐτὸς ὡς σφραγὶς ἐπὶ δεξιᾶς χειρός

text_en: in like manner Jesus the son of Josedec who in their days built the house, and set up a holy temple to the Lord , prepared for everlasting glory .
text_la: sic et Jesum filium Josedec, qui in diebus suis ædificaverunt domum, et exaltaverunt templum sanctum Domino, paratum in gloriam sempiternam.
text_el: οὕτως Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ιωσεδεκ οἳ ἐν ἡμέραις αὐτῶν ᾠκοδόμησαν οἶκον καὶ ἀνύψωσαν ναὸν ἅγιον κυρίῳ ἡτοιμασμένον εἰς δόξαν αἰῶνος

text_en: And let Nehemias be a long time remembered, who raised up for us our walls that were cast down, and set up the gates and the bars, who rebuilt our houses.
text_la: Et Nehemias in memoriam multi temporis, qui erexit nobis muros eversos, et stare fecit portas et seras, qui erexit domos nostras.
text_el: καὶ Νεεμιου ἐπὶ πολὺ τὸ μνημόσυνον τοῦ ἐγείραντος ἡμῖν τείχη πεπτωκότα καὶ στήσαντος πύλας καὶ μοχλοὺς καὶ ἀνεγείραντος τὰ οἰκόπεδα ἡμῶν

text_en: No man was born upon earth like Henoch : for he also was taken up from the earth.
text_la: Nemo natus est in terra qualis Henoch, nam et ipse receptus est a terra :
text_el: οὐδεὶς ἐκτίσθη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τοιοῦτος οἷος Ενωχ καὶ γὰρ αὐτὸς ἀνελήμφθη ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Nor as Joseph , who was a man born prince of his brethren, the support of his family , the ruler of his brethren, the stay of the people:
text_la: neque ut Joseph, qui natus est homo princeps fratrum, firmamentum gentis, rector fratrum, stabilimentum populi :
text_el: οὐδὲ ὡς Ιωσηφ ἐγεννήθη ἀνὴρ ἡγούμενος ἀδελφῶν στήριγμα λαοῦ

text_en: And his bones were visited, and after death they prophesied .
text_la: et ossa ipsius visitata sunt, et post mortem prophetaverunt.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ αὐτοῦ ἐπεσκέπησαν

text_en: Seth and Sem obtained glory among men : and above every soul Adam in the beginning,
text_la: Seth et Sem apud homines gloriam adepti sunt, et super omnem animam in origine Adam.
text_el: Σημ καὶ Σηθ ἐν ἀνθρώποις ἐδοξάσθησαν καὶ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ζῷον ἐν τῇ κτίσει Αδαμ

text_en: Simon the high priest , the son of Onias , who in his life propped up the house, and in his days fortified the temple .
text_la: Simon, Oniæ filius, sacerdos magnus, qui in vita sua suffulsit domum, et in diebus suis corroboravit templum.

text_en: By him also the height of the temple was founded, the double building and the high walls of the temple .
text_la: Templi etiam altitudo ab ipso fundata est, duplex ædificatio, et excelsi parietes templi.

text_en: In his days the wells of water flowed out, and they were filled as the sea above measure.
text_la: In diebus ipsius emanaverunt putei aquarum, et quasi mare adimpleti sunt supra modum.

text_en: He took care of his nation, and delivered it from destruction.
text_la: Qui curavit gentem suam, et liberavit eam a perditione :

text_en: He prevailed to enlarge the city, and obtained glory in his conversation with the people: and enlarged the entrance of the house and the court .
text_la: qui prævaluit amplificare civitatem, qui adeptus est gloriam in conversatione gentis, et ingressum domus et atrii amplificavit.

text_en: He shone in his days as the morning star in the midst of a cloud, and as the moon at the full.
text_la: Quasi stella matutina in medio nebulæ, et quasi luna plena, in diebus suis lucet :

text_en: And as the sun when it shines, so did he shine in the temple of God .
text_la: et quasi sol refulgens, sic ille effulsit in templo Dei.

text_en: And as the rainbow giving light in bright clouds, and as the flower of roses in the days of the spring, and as the lilies that are on the brink of the water, and as the sweet smelling frankincense in the time of summer.
text_la: Quasi arcus refulgens inter nebulas gloriæ, et quasi flos rosarum in diebus vernis, et quasi lilia quæ sunt in transitu aquæ, et quasi thus redolens in diebus æstatis :

text_en: As a bright fire, and frankincense burning in the fire.
text_la: quasi ignis effulgens, et thus ardens in igne :

text_en: As a massy vessel of gold, adorned with every precious stone .
text_la: quasi vas auri solidum, ornatum omni lapide pretioso :

text_en: As an olive tree budding forth, and a cypress tree rearing itself on high, when he put on the robe of glory , and was clothed with the perfection of power.
text_la: quasi oliva pullulans, et cypressus in altitudinem se extollens, in accipiendo ipsum stolam gloriæ, et vestiri eum in consummationem virtutis.

text_en: When he went up to the holy altar , he honoured the vesture of holiness .
text_la: In ascensu altaris sancti gloriam dedit sanctitatis amictum.

text_en: And when he took the portions out of the hands of the priests , he himself stood by the altar . And about him was the ring of his brethren: and as the cedar planted in mount Libanus ,
text_la: In accipiendo autem partes de manu sacerdotum, et ipse stans juxta aram : et circa illum corona fratrum : quasi plantatio cedri in monte Libano,

text_en: and as branches of palm trees, they stood round about him, and all the sons of Aaron in their glory .
text_la: sic circa illum steterunt quasi rami palmæ : et omnes filii Aaron in gloria sua.

text_en: And the oblation of the Lord was in their hands, before all the congregation of Israel : and finishing his service, on the altar , to honour the offering of the most high King,
text_la: Oblatio autem Domini in manibus ipsorum coram omni synagoga Israël : et consummatione fungens in ara, amplificare oblationem excelsi Regis,

text_en: he stretched forth his hand to make a libation, and offered of the blood of the grape.
text_la: porrexit manum suam in libatione, et libavit de sanguine uvæ.

text_en: He poured out at the foot of the altar a divine odour to the most high Prince.
text_la: Effudit in fundamento altaris odorem divinum excelso Principi.

text_en: Then the sons of Aaron shouted, they sounded with beaten trumpets, and made a great noise to be heard for a remembrance before God .
text_la: Tunc exclamaverunt filii Aaron, in tubis productilibus sonuerunt : et auditam fecerunt vocem magnam in memoriam coram Deo.

text_en: Then all the people together made haste, and fell down to the earth upon their faces, to adore the Lord their God , and to pray to the Almighty God the most High .
text_la: Tunc omnis populus simul properaverunt, et ceciderunt in faciem super terram, adorare Dominum Deum suum, et dare preces omnipotenti Deo excelso.

text_en: And the singers lifted up their voices, and in the great house the sound of sweet melody was increased.
text_la: Et amplificaverunt psallentes in vocibus suis, et in magna domo auctus est sonus suavitatis plenus.

text_en: And the people in prayer besought the Lord the most High , until the worship of the Lord was perfected, and they had finished their office.
text_la: Et rogavit populus Dominum excelsum in prece, usque dum perfectus est honor Domini, et munus suum perfecerunt.

text_en: Then coming down, he lifted up his hands over all the congregation of the children of Israel , to give glory to God with his lips, and to glory in his name :
text_la: Tunc descendens, manus suas extulit in omne congregationem filiorum Israël, dare gloriam Deo a labiis suis, et in nomine ipsius gloriari :

text_en: And he repeated his prayer , willing to show the power of God .
text_la: et iteravit orationem suam, volens ostendere virtutem Dei.

text_en: And now pray to the God of all, who has done great things in all the earth, who has increased our days from our mother's womb, and has done with us according to his mercy.
text_la: Et nunc orate Deum omnium, qui magna fecit in omni terra, qui auxit dies nostros a ventre matris nostræ, et fecit nobiscum secundum suam misericordiam :

text_en: May he grant us joyfulness of heart, and that there be peace in our days in Israel for ever:
text_la: det nobis jucunditatem cordis, et fieri pacem in diebus nostris in Israël per dies sempiternos :

text_en: That Israel may believe that the mercy of God is with us, to deliver us in his days.
text_la: credere Israël nobiscum esse Dei misericordiam, ut liberet nos in diebus suis.

text_en: There are two nations which my soul abhors: and the third is no nation, which I hate:
text_la: Duas gentes odit anima mea : tertia autem non est gens quam oderim :
text_el: ἐν δυσὶν ἔθνεσιν προσώχθισεν ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ τὸ τρίτον οὐκ ἔστιν ἔθνος

text_en: They that sit on mount Seir, and the Philistines , and the foolish people that dwell in Sichem .
text_la: qui sedent in monte Seir, et Philisthiim, et stultus populus qui habitat in Sichimis.
text_el: οἱ καθήμενοι ἐν ὄρει Σαμαρείας καὶ Φυλιστιιμ καὶ ὁ λαὸς ὁ μωρὸς ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν Σικιμοις

text_en: Jesus the son of Sirach, of Jerusalem , has written in this book the doctrine of wisdom and instruction, who renewed wisdom from his heart.
text_la: Doctrinam sapientiæ et disciplinæ scripsit in codice isto Jesus, filius Sirach, Jerosolymita, qui renovavit sapientiam de corde suo.
text_el: παιδείαν συνέσεως καὶ ἐπιστήμης ἐχάραξεν ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Σιραχ Ελεαζαρ ὁ Ιεροσολυμίτης ὃς ἀνώμβρησεν σοφίαν ἀπὸ καρδίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: Blessed is he that is conversant in these good things and he that lays them up in his heart, shall be wise always.
text_la: Beatus qui in istis versatur bonis : qui ponit illa in corde suo, sapiens erit semper.
text_el: μακάριος ὃς ἐν τούτοις ἀναστραφήσεται καὶ θεὶς αὐτὰ ἐπὶ καρδίαν αὐτοῦ σοφισθήσεται

text_en: For if he do them, he shall be strong to do all things: because the light of God guides his steps.
text_la: Si enim hæc fecerit, ad omnia valebit, quia lux Dei vestigium ejus est.
text_el: ἐὰν γὰρ αὐτὰ ποιήσῃ πρὸς πάντα ἰσχύσει ὅτι φῶς κυρίου τὸ ἴχνος αὐτοῦ

text_en: A prayer of Jesus the son of Sirach. I will give glory to you, O Lord, O King, and I will praise you, O God my Saviour.
text_la: Oratio Jesu filii Sirach. Confitebor tibi, Domine rex, et collaudabo te Deum salvatorem meum.
text_el: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι κύριε βασιλεῦ καὶ αἰνέσω σε θεὸν τὸν σωτῆρά μου

text_en: I will give glory to your name : for you have been a helper and protector to me.
text_la: Confitebor nomini tuo, quoniam adjutor et protector factus es mihi,
text_el: ἐξομολογοῦμαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου

text_en: And have preserved my body from destruction, from the snare of an unjust tongue, and from the lips of them that forge lies, and in the sight of them that stood by, you have been my helper.
text_la: et liberasti corpus meum a perditione : a laqueo linguæ iniquæ, et a labiis operantium mendacium : et in conspectu astantium factus es mihi adjutor.
text_el: ὅτι σκεπαστὴς καὶ βοηθὸς ἐγένου μοι καὶ ἐλυτρώσω τὸ σῶμά μου ἐξ ἀπωλείας καὶ ἐκ παγίδος διαβολῆς γλώσσης ἀπὸ χειλέων ἐργαζομένων ψεῦδος καὶ ἔναντι τῶν παρεστηκότων ἐγένου βοηθὸς

text_en: And you have delivered me, according to the multitude of the mercy of your name , from them that did roar, prepared to devour.
text_la: Et liberasti me, secundum multitudinem misericordiæ nominis tui, a rugientibus præparatis ad escam :
text_el: καὶ ἐλυτρώσω με κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος ἐλέους καὶ ὀνόματός σου ἐκ βρυγμῶν ἕτοιμον εἰς βρῶμα

text_en: Out of the hands of them that sought my life, and from the gates of afflictions, which compassed me about:
text_la: de manibus quærentium animam meam, et de portis tribulationum quæ circumdederunt me;
text_el: ἐκ χειρὸς ζητούντων τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ πλειόνων θλίψεων ὧν ἔσχον

text_en: From the oppression of the flame which surrounded me, and in the midst of the fire I was not burnt.
text_la: a pressura flammæ quæ circumdedit me, et in medio ignis non sum æstuatus;
text_el: ἀπὸ πνιγμοῦ πυρᾶς κυκλόθεν καὶ ἐκ μέσου πυρός οὗ οὐκ ἐξέκαυσα

text_en: From the depth of the belly of hell, and from an unclean tongue, and from lying words, from an unjust king, and from a slanderous tongue:
text_la: de altitudine ventris inferi, et a lingua coinquinata, et a verbo mendacii, a rege iniquo, et a lingua injusta.
text_el: ἐκ βάθους κοιλίας ᾅδου καὶ ἀπὸ γλώσσης ἀκαθάρτου καὶ λόγου ψευδοῦς βασιλεῖ διαβολὴ γλώσσης ἀδίκου

text_en: My soul shall praise the Lord even to death.
text_la: Laudabit usque ad mortem anima mea Dominum,
text_el: ἤγγισεν ἕως θανάτου ἡ ψυχή μου

text_en: And my life was drawing near to hell beneath.
text_la: et vita mea appropinquans erat in inferno deorsum.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ζωή μου ἦν σύνεγγυς ᾅδου κάτω

text_en: They compassed me on every side, and there was no one that would help me. I looked for the succour of men , and there was none.
text_la: Circumdederunt me undique, et non erat qui adjuvaret : respiciens eram ad adjutorium hominum, et non erat.
text_el: περιέσχον με πάντοθεν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ βοηθῶν ἐνέβλεπον εἰς ἀντίλημψιν ἀνθρώπων καὶ οὐκ ἦν

text_en: I remembered your mercy, O Lord , and your works, which are from the beginning of the world.
text_la: Memoratus sum misericordiæ tuæ Domine, et operationis tuæ, quæ a sæculo sunt :
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθην τοῦ ἐλέους σου κύριε καὶ τῆς ἐργασίας σου τῆς ἀπ' αἰῶνος

text_en: How you deliver them that wait for you, O Lord , and save them out of the hands of the nations.
text_la: quoniam eruis sustinentes te, Domine, et liberas eos de manibus gentium.
text_el: ὅτι ἐξαιρῇ τοὺς ὑπομένοντάς σε καὶ σῴζεις αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν

text_en: You have exalted my dwelling place upon the earth and I have prayed for death to pass away.
text_la: Exaltasti super terram habitationem meam, et pro morte defluente deprecatus sum.
text_el: καὶ ἀνύψωσα ἀπὸ γῆς ἱκετείαν μου καὶ ὑπὲρ θανάτου ῥύσεως ἐδεήθην

text_en: I called upon the Lord , the father of my Lord , that he would not leave me in the day of my trouble, and in the time of the proud without help.
text_la: Invocavi Dominum patrem Domini mei, ut non derelinquat me in die tribulationis meæ, et in tempore superborum, sine adjutorio.
text_el: ἐπεκαλεσάμην κύριον πατέρα κυρίου μου μή με ἐγκαταλιπεῖν ἐν ἡμέραις θλίψεως ἐν καιρῷ ὑπερηφανιῶν ἀβοηθησίας

text_en: I will praise your name continually, and will praise it with thanksgiving, and my prayer was heard.
text_la: Laudabo nomen tuum assidue, et collaudabo illud in confessione : et exaudita est oratio mea,
text_el: αἰνέσω τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐνδελεχῶς καὶ ὑμνήσω ἐν ἐξομολογήσει καὶ εἰσηκούσθη ἡ δέησίς μου

text_en: And you have saved me from destruction, and have delivered me from the evil time.
text_la: et liberasti me de perditione, et eripuisti me de tempore iniquo.
text_el: ἔσωσας γάρ με ἐξ ἀπωλείας καὶ ἐξείλου με ἐκ καιροῦ πονηροῦ

text_en: Therefore I will give thanks, and praise you, and bless the name of the Lord .
text_la: Propterea confitebor, et laudem dicam tibi, et benedicam nomini Domini.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι καὶ αἰνέσω σε καὶ εὐλογήσω τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου

text_en: When I was yet young, before I wandered about, I sought for wisdom openly in my prayer .
text_la: Cum adhuc junior essem, priusquam oberrarem, quæsivi sapientiam palam in oratione mea.
text_el: ἔτι ὢν νεώτερος πρὶν ἢ πλανηθῆναί με ἐζήτησα σοφίαν προφανῶς ἐν προσευχῇ μου

text_en: I prayed for her before the temple , and unto the very end I will seek after her, and she flourished as a grape soon ripe.
text_la: Ante templum postulabam pro illis, et usque in novissimis inquiram eam : et effloruit tamquam præcox uva.
text_el: ἔναντι ναοῦ ἠξίουν περὶ αὐτῆς καὶ ἕως ἐσχάτων ἐκζητήσω αὐτήν ἐξ ἄνθους ὡς περκαζούσης σταφυλῆς

text_en: My heart delighted in her, my foot walked in the right way, from my youth up I sought after her.
text_la: Lætatum est cor meum in ea : ambulavit pes meus iter rectum : a juventute mea investigabam eam.
text_el: εὐφράνθη ἡ καρδία μου ἐν αὐτῇ ἐπέβη ὁ πούς μου ἐν εὐθύτητι ἐκ νεότητός μου ἴχνευον αὐτήν

text_en: I bowed down my ear a little, and received her.
text_la: Inclinavi modico aurem meam, et excepi illam.
text_el: ἔκλινα ὀλίγον τὸ οὖς μου καὶ ἐδεξάμην

text_en: I found much wisdom in myself, and profited much therein.
text_la: Multam inveni in meipso sapientiam, et multum profeci in ea.
text_el: καὶ πολλὴν εὗρον ἐμαυτῷ παιδείαν προκοπὴ ἐγένετό μοι ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: To him that gives me wisdom, will I give glory .
text_la: Danti mihi sapientiam dabo gloriam:
text_el: τῷ διδόντι μοι σοφίαν δώσω δόξαν

text_en: For I have determined to follow her: I have had a zeal for good , and shall not be confounded.
text_la: consiliatus sum enim ut facerem illam. Zelatus sum bonum, et non confundar.
text_el: διενοήθην γὰρ τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτὴν καὶ ἐζήλωσα τὸ ἀγαθὸν καὶ οὐ μὴ αἰσχυνθῶ

text_en: My soul has wrestled for her, and in doing it I have been confirmed.
text_la: Colluctata est anima mea in illa, et in faciendo eam confirmatus sum.
text_el: διαμεμάχισται ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἐν ποιήσει νόμου διηκριβασάμην

text_en: I stretched forth my hands on high, and I bewailed my ignorance of her.
text_la: Manus meas extendi in altum, et insipientiam ejus luxi;
text_el: τὰς χεῖράς μου ἐξεπέτασα πρὸς ὕψος καὶ τὰ ἀγνοήματα αὐτῆς ἐπένθησα

text_en: I directed my soul to her, and in knowledge I found her.
text_la: animam meam direxi ad illam, et in agnitione inveni eam.
text_el: τὴν ψυχήν μου κατεύθυνα εἰς αὐτὴν

text_en: I possessed my heart with her from the beginning: therefore I shall not be forsaken.
text_la: Possedi cum ipsa cor ab initio : propter hoc, non derelinquar.
text_el: καὶ ἐν καθαρισμῷ εὗρον αὐτήν καρδίαν ἐκτησάμην μετ' αὐτῆς ἀπ' ἀρχῆς διὰ τοῦτο οὐ μὴ ἐγκαταλειφθῶ

text_en: My entrails were troubled in seeking her: therefore shall I possess a good possession.
text_la: Venter meus conturbatus est quærendo illam : propterea bonam possidebo possessionem.
text_el: καὶ ἡ κοιλία μου ἐταράχθη τοῦ ἐκζητῆσαι αὐτήν διὰ τοῦτο ἐκτησάμην ἀγαθὸν κτῆμα

text_en: The Lord has given me a tongue for my reward: and with it I will praise him.
text_la: Dedit mihi Dominus linguam mercedem meam, et in ipsa laudabo eum.
text_el: ἔδωκεν κύριος γλῶσσάν μοι μισθόν μου καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ αἰνέσω αὐτόν

text_en: Draw near to me, you unlearned, and gather yourselves together into the hours of discipline.
text_la: Appropiate ad me, indocti, et congregate vos in domum disciplinæ.
text_el: ἐγγίσατε πρός με ἀπαίδευτοι καὶ αὐλίσθητε ἐν οἴκῳ παιδείας

text_en: Why are you slow and what do you say of these things? Your souls are exceeding thirsty.
text_la: Quid adhuc retardatis? et quid dicitis in his? animæ vestræ sitiunt vehementer.
text_el: τί ὅτι ὑστερεῖσθαι λέγετε ἐν τούτοις καὶ αἱ ψυχαὶ ὑμῶν διψῶσι σφόδρα

text_en: I have opened my mouth, and have spoken: buy her for yourselves without silver,
text_la: Aperui os meum, et locutus sum : Comparate vobis sine argento,
text_el: ἤνοιξα τὸ στόμα μου καὶ ἐλάλησα κτήσασθε ἑαυτοῖς ἄνευ ἀργυρίου

text_en: and submit your neck to the yoke, and let your soul receive discipline: for she is near at hand to be found.
text_la: et collum vestrum subjicite jugo : et suscipiat anima vestra disciplinam : in proximo est enim invenire eam.
text_el: τὸν τράχηλον ὑμῶν ὑπόθετε ὑπὸ ζυγόν καὶ ἐπιδεξάσθω ἡ ψυχὴ ὑμῶν παιδείαν ἐγγύς ἐστιν εὑρεῖν αὐτήν

text_en: Behold with your eyes how I have laboured a little, and have found much rest to myself.
text_la: Videte oculis vestris, quia modicum laboravi, et inveni mihi multam requiem.
text_el: ἴδετε ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ὑμῶν ὅτι ὀλίγον ἐκοπίασα καὶ εὗρον ἐμαυτῷ πολλὴν ἀνάπαυσιν

text_en: Receive discipline as a great sum of money, and possess abundance of gold by her.
text_la: Assumite disciplinam in multo numero argenti, et copiosum aurum possidete in ea.
text_el: μετάσχετε παιδείας ἐν πολλῷ ἀριθμῷ ἀργυρίου καὶ πολὺν χρυσὸν κτήσασθε ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: Let your soul rejoice in his mercy and you shall not be confounded in his praise.
text_la: Lætetur anima vestra in misericordia ejus, et non confundemini in laude ipsius.
text_el: εὐφρανθείη ἡ ψυχὴ ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ ἐλέει αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ αἰσχυνθείητε ἐν αἰνέσει αὐτοῦ

text_en: Work your work before the time, and he will give you your reward in his time.
text_la: Operamini opus vestrum ante tempus, et dabit vobis mercedem vestram in tempore suo.
text_el: ἐργάζεσθε τὸ ἔργον ὑμῶν πρὸ καιροῦ καὶ δώσει τὸν μισθὸν ὑμῶν ἐν καιρῷ αὐτοῦ
